description.zh: 練習設計構想草圖速繪法；從基本幾何形體至複雜產品、空間循序漸進；常用材質（木質、金屬、透明材質、石材及皮革等）之表現技法；產品精描、透視圖法、三視圖、爆炸圖、組立圖等之精描，說明圖板及各種畫材（麥克筆、粉彩、色鉛筆及水彩）等之應用。
description.en: This course put emphasis on offering students having enough skills on :1.Abilities to sketch their idea visible to the others.2.Coloring design sketches to let the drawings have better comprehensibility.3.Good skill for Renderings. Medias for this course shall include markers, pastels water colors and color pencils.

syllabi.outline:
藉由大量的人物寫生，從人性關懷的角度速寫記錄人生百態，速寫重點要「神」、「形」兼備。下一步是靜態單人速寫練習，體態美見於動、靜、張、弛的表現，且比例要正確。下筆速、簡、精、準、是練習重點。接下來是靜態雙人、多人速寫練習。除了依循單人速寫練習要點，並加入空間透視感，使畫面構成更生動有趣。
The course begins with a lot of figure sketching. You have to care about all walks of life, and actively observe and record their figures. Try to master both the charm and the form of the model.  Next focusing on static mono-figure sketching, you have to demonstrate your techniques in presenting either the static or the dynamic, the state of tension or looseness. You also have to be precise in proportion when you do your sketch. Stress definitely on the practice of speediness, simplicity, accuracy, and preciseness. Also work on static twin-figure and multi-figure sketching. Besides incorporating guidelines from the previous activity, you have to add the sense of spatial perspective to make your sketch more vivid and

description.zh: 傢俱塗裝為傢俱外觀重要的製程，本課程教導學生了解傢俱塗裝專業知識與生產規劃，主要包括: 1.傢俱塗料的種類。例如: 刷塗、噴塗、滾筒塗佈、簾幕式塗佈 2.傢俱塗裝方式的選擇。 3.傢俱塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。 4.不同塗裝方式在外觀與維護上之影響。 5.塗膜缺陷與對策。 6.塗裝線規劃。

Furniture coatings category. ex: brushing、spraying、roller coating、curtain coating… 2. How to choose best way of coating process. 3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 5. Coating defects and solution. 6. Production planning.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control. In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided. This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
美學宗師朱光潛《談文學》：「文學是一種與人生最密切相關的藝術」；古希臘哲學家亞里斯多德《詩學》：「人的描寫居於文學的首要地位；而人生，勢必成為文學表現的主要對象，或文學表現的核心問題」。作家透過文字書寫，分享經過歲月積澱的生命經驗，反映時代現實，譜出喜怒哀樂之生命樂章；吾人透過閱讀，徜徉在文學世界當中，與作品中傳達的哲思、情感、人生故事共鳴，開拓視野，增加閱歷，思考生命存在的價值與意義。由此可知，文學與吾人現實人生誠習習相關。
本「國語文實務應用」課程，擬擷選中國古今文學作品，引領修課同學感受文學之美，體悟在塵世的繁華裡，古今情感、哲思的傳遞是有時空隔閡，是可以心心相映。由於是一學年課程，因此上學期課程內容，首先以文字與音樂交會之旅、詩歌的遊戲與創作此二單元，引領修課同學感受文字有何力量，以及詩情、詩意之況味。爾後，將擷選古今文史哲作品，引領同學認識文學中的愛情、文學中的親情。待下學期，接續引領修課同學認識文學中的友情、文學中的家國情、文學中的山水情。由此，再進一步思考如何擁抱幸福美好的人生、如何尋找讓自身幸福的青鳥。課堂中，將以講授與問題討論方式，對上課文本作深度的探討與詮釋。希冀修課同學們能掘發文學作品要義，探討文學與人生的關係，並進一步回歸吾人生命本身意義之探索。此外，並希冀修課同學能藉由閱讀、思考、書寫、討論，內觀自己的生命情境與思路，外觀蒼穹宇宙，自在悠遊於成長之道路。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 各種壓縮機起動控制、順序控制、溫度控制、濕度控制、水流量控制、外氣控制、焓值控制、氣壓控制、電動控制、電子控制等實習。
description.en: To familiarize students with practice of compressor control, sequence control, temperature control, humidity control, flow control, outdoor air control, enthalpy control, and pneumatic control, electric control, electronic control on HVAC systems.

description.zh: 本課程實習內容主要包含冷凍空調節能技術；動態節能模擬分析；無塵室節能技術；潔淨能源(諸如太陽能、風能、燃料電池等)技術。
description.en: This practice course mainly contains: energy-saving technology in refrigeration and air conditioning, dynamic energy simulation, energy-saving technology in cleanrooms and clean energy (such as solar energy, wind energy, and fuel cell, etc).

description.zh: 以套裝軟體學習電腦輔助繪圖，及如何將此技術應用於冷凍空調領域。
description.en: Computer Aided Drawing For HVAC & R Engineering by using package software.

description.zh: 本課程講授工業電子相關之原理，包含:1.基本元件簡介、2.電晶體開關裝置及其應用、 3.電子元件及其應用、 4. SCR 與TRIAC、 5.感測器原理與應用。本課程並包含下列實習單元:R-L-C 元件, 諧振電路, 濾波電路與變壓器, 零件運用與電路檢修, 感測器應用。
description.en: This course provides design-oriented approach to the understanding of electronic devices, circuits, and system used in industry. Both lectures and laboratory exercises are provided.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電磁之基本原理及定律，並講解各種電機、變壓器之特性、理論、及控制方法，透過實習課程使同學明瞭機器驅動所用之動力其電功與機械功之轉換原理與控制進而可自行操作及維護。
description.en: An introduction of the basic principles of the electro-magnetic theories. Topics include the characteristics, theories and control algorithms of the various electrical equipment and transformers.

description.zh: 商用冷凍系統電路元件介紹、商用冷凍冷藏設備電路裝配、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除。
description.en: Introduction of electric circuits of commercial refrigeration systems, electric circuit of commercial refrigeration facilities, installation of refrigerant piping system and trouble shooting.

description.zh: 箱型空調機電路裝配、冷卻水管路施工安裝、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除、冷媒更換。恆溫恆濕空調系統控制電路配線、中央空調系統試陣調整、水量與風量平衡調整、TAB操作。
description.en: Electric circuit of air handler, installation of coolant piping, installation of coolant pipe system, trouble shooting, refrigerant replacement, constant electric circuit of air-conditioner control for constant temperature and humidity, test and balance of central units, test and balance of water and air flow.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class.  This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要介紹資訊系統在目前數位時代的公司所扮演的角色，課程介紹內容涵蓋：資訊系統基本理論與實務、電子商務、ERP、供應鏈管理系統、顧客管理系統、資訊安全、資料探勘、商業智慧、人工智慧、工業4.0等熱門趨勢議題。資訊服務被廣泛應用在各個不同領域以及產業，本課程適合任何想對資訊系統有進一步瞭解的同學。上課方式為教師授課、實務操作，並兼以同學分組課堂報告及討論為主。

本課程目的有三：
(一)	訓練學生畢業後從事資訊管理相關領域之執行、導入及開發的工作。
(二)	建立學生對總體數位科技環境的認知，提升未來職場技術能力及觀念性技能的開發。
(三)透過分組討論、實務操作及資料分析，學習基礎知識以及評估未來更多創新的資訊應用模式。

description.zh: 本課程將針對英語授課 (English as a medium of instruction, EMI)及學科與語言整合教學 (Content and Language Integrated Learning , CLIL)兩大領域範疇進行深入探究，本課程將探討不同主題包含：EMI/CLIL不同的理論架構、EMI/CLIL於不同學科上之應用、以及EMI/CLIL於不同教育階段的應用等主題，並透過課堂討論、小組活動、個案研究以及專題提案討論，提升學生對相關主題的知識建構與教學能力，建立其對EMI/CLIL主題於文獻探討之掌握及相關研究方法，並期將所學之知能應用在課堂教學中。
description.en: This course in an introductory course for English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) and Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL). This course aims to cultivate students’ knowledge about EMI and CLIL and their applications in different disciplines across different educational levels. The elements of teaching subject areas in English will be discussed in class to equip students with the basic concepts and techniques for EMI and CLIL. Through various class activities such as lectures, discussions, case studies, group work, and larger projects, students will explore not only the theorical foundations for EMI and CLIL but also classroom pedagogy and methodological approaches related to EMI and CLIL. The promises and challenges of EMI and CLIL and emerging issues will also be discussed in this course.

name.en: Legends in Movies: Anime and Games

description.zh: 亞瑟王與圓桌武士、聖杯、龍和公主一直以現代書籍及電影的方式流傳至今。本課程將探討弔詭的現代中世紀現象，亦即現代西方如何以多樣的手段去詮釋、改寫或紀念中古世紀，使得這種千年前的文化在現代重生。本課程同時也將討論日本動畫家及漫畫家是如何以動漫的方式將西方中世紀故事及元素巧妙的融合進現代日本流行文化。
description.en: Stories of Arthur and his knights, the Holy Grail, dragons and princesses – continue to be retold and enjoyed in modern books and films. This course will examine the paradoxical phenomenon of modern medievalism, looking at the varied ways the modern West has borrowed, celebrated, and rewritten its medieval past, a culture strangely as alive now as it was a thousand years ago. We will consider, too, how western medieval stories and images are also being cleverly adapted and transformed in modern Japanese pop culture by anime and manga artists.

syllabi.outline: In literary studies, when we encounter the term "legend", it is often understood as stories that center on human protagonists rather than supernatural beings - as differentiated from "myth" - such as the stories of King Arthur and his knights, the search for the Holy Grail, and the dragon-slaying in medieval literature. This course, however, will not be limited by the scope of the Middle Age and will extend the definition of "legend" by examining the prominent archetypes in Western literature. The course will explore how these archetypes not only form the basis of classic literature, but also pervade and enrich our popular culture including films, operas, anime, and video games.

description.en: The objective of this course is to develop the management abilities of entrepreneurship, brand, and intellectual property for students. description.zh: 介紹化工廠廢棄物對安全、健康、環境之影嚮及化工產品之生命週期評估。舊程序之製程改善及建立完整的廢棄物管理體系，以達廢棄物最少化之目的，新程序之設計則對反應器、分離程序、熱交換器之程序整合及公用設施等，實施源頭減廢及回收，以達潔淨生產之目的。
description.en: Introduction to the safety, health and environmental impact of wastes of chemical process industries and life cycle assessment of chemical engineering products. Waste minimization of existing process through changes in industrial process and setup of waste management hiarachy. For the new process, focus are on the source reduction and recycle of reactors, separators, heat exchange networks and utilities, etc.

syllabi.outline: 介紹科技廠與化工廠的減碳程序(包含碳捕捉)，以及廢棄物對安全、健康、環境之影嚮及化工產品之生命週期評估。舊程序之製程改善及建立完整的廢棄物管理體系，以達廢棄物最少化與減少碳足跡之目的，新程序之設計則對反應器、分離程序、熱交換器之程序整合及公用設施等，實施源頭減廢及回收，以達潔淨生產之目的。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹語言測驗和評量的基本概念和原則。本課程將討論語言測驗和評量相關的基本理論概念、並將探討如何在實踐中應用這些理論概念。本課程結束前，學生將能夠將這些原則應用於評估學習者的表現、並設計評量來適切對應學習者需求。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the basic concepts and principles of language testing and assessment. Fundamental theoretical concepts related to language testing and assessment will be discussed before the class moves on to how these theoretical concepts can be applied in practice. By the end of this course, students would be able to apply these principles in the evaluation of their students’ performances and in the design of assessments which will appropriately address the needs of their learners.

name.en: Theories and Practice in English for Professional Purposes

description.zh: 本課程旨在研討專業英文研究及應用, 課程包括專業領域英語文之語域分析, 探討各領域中的語法及詞彙特點,並進一步分析不同領域中之修辭及言語萹章使用,進而研討語言溝通目標功能分析並結合策略研究,以將理論應用於專業實務及研究中。
description.en: This course is intended for graduate students who are pre-experienced in working in specific fields of professions. For other students who are inexperienced in the workplace are required to have consolidated knowledge and observations of the world industries. It aims to address the applicability of theories in EPP and the plethora of situations raised from such applications. The course will provide theoretical studies for applications in respect to register analysis, rhetorical and discourse analysis, functionality analysis and skills and strategies. It is also expected that the course will describe other models in EPP studies.

description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and pr92tical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of inter92tive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and appro92hes, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

syllabi.outline:
This course covers fundamentals of mathematics in matrix theory and linear algebra. Emphasis is given to topics that will be useful in other disciplines, including systems of equations, vector spaces, determinants, eigenvalues, 
and similarity.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Overview; Systems of Linear Equations
Week 2-3: Row Reduction and Echelon Forms; Vector and Matrix Equations
Week 4: Solution Sets of Linear Systems
Week 5-6: Linear Independence
Week 7-8: Matrix Algebra 01: Basic Operations, invertible theorem 
Week 9: Midterm
Week 10: Matrix Algebra 02: Matrix Partition, Factorization 
Week 11: Linear Transformation and Characteristics of Invertible Matrices
Week 12-13: Determinants; Vector Spaces and Coordinate Systems; Change of Basis
Week 14: Eigenvectors and Eigenvalues; The Characteristic Equation
Week 15: Diagonalization; Orthogonal Sets; Orthogonal Projections
Week 16: Final *
Week 17: Principal Component Analysis (Online)
Week 18: Machine Learning and Linear Models (Online)

description.zh: 本課程適合所有對於如何向自然取經的創新設計策略有興趣的學生。學生將探索這個將功能、性能和美學從生物學轉換成科技的過程，及如何增進設計創造力和產生比傳統技術更好的解決方案，包括講授從原始科學突破到創業初創企業的仿生設計過程，從壁虎式粘合劑到可跑步、飛行和游泳的機器人等案例分析，以及跨領域學生團隊合作進行原創的生物啟發設計專題。
description.en: Bioinspired design views the process of how we learn from Nature as an innovation strategy translating principles of function, performance and aesthetics from biology to human technology. This course gives an overview of how bioinspired design can lead to more design creativity and to better solutions than with conventional technology. Lectures will address the biomimicry design process from original scientific breakthroughs to entrepreneurial start-ups using cases studies that include gecko-inspired adhesives and robots that run, fly and swim, Interdisciplinary teams of students will collaborate on, create, and present original bioinspired design projects.

syllabi.outline:
本課程適合所有對於如何向自然取經的創新設計策略有興趣的學生。學生將探索這個將功能、性能和美學從生物學轉換成科技的過程，及如何增進設計創造力和產生比傳統技術更好的解決方案，包括講授從原始科學突破到創業初創企業的仿生設計過程，從壁虎式粘合劑到可跑步、飛行和游泳的機器人等案例分析，以及跨領域學生團隊合作進行原創的生物啟發設計專題。

description.zh: 數位通訊系統簡介，數位調變及偵測，數據譯碼及錯誤更正碼，同步(載波及時刻訊號的還原)，多工技術，通訊網路技術。
description.en:
introduction to design communication systems, digital
modulation and detection, data signaling and error correction codes, synchronization,multiplexing techniques,
communiation networks.

syllabi.outline:
數位通訊可謂目前行動通訊的基礎，隨著行動通信的技術演進，從第三代通訊(3G)、第四代通訊(4G)、以至於目前的第五代通訊(5G)，甚至是接下來的6G高速時代，均是以數位訊號調變技術來增加資料傳輸速率，致使行動通信及無線網路使用更為便利。
本課程將涵蓋：
1.	數位訊號基礎理論：信號、頻率、帶寬、信噪比、數位訊號和模擬訊號等
2.	數位信號的傳輸：時域和頻域的數位信號表示法、錯誤檢測和糾正（error detection and correction）
3.	數位通訊系統：標準協定（如：Wi-Fi、Ethernet、3G、4G、5G等）、數位信號處理（digital signal processing）、訊號濾波（signal filtering）、多頻道通訊（multichannel communication）等。

並詳細介紹通訊技術之發展-多種規格之演進與比較，以及OFDM正交分頻多工技術。能使學生了解數位通訊常用的基本原理與觀念、充分瞭解通訊技術及發展。


I. Introduction to Digital Communication
Definition and historical background of digital communication
Types of digital communication (e.g. email, instant messaging, social media)
Advantages and disadvantages of digital communication
II. Digital Communication Technologies
Data transmission techniques (e.g. analog-to-digital conversion, modulation, multiplexing)
Networking technologies (e.g. LAN, WAN, Internet)
Wireless communication technologies (e.g. Wi-Fi, cellular networks)
III. Conclusion and Future Trends
Recap of key concepts and technologies
Discussion of future trends in digital communication (e.g. artificial intelligence, virtual and augmented reality)
Preparing for a career in digital communication.

name.zh: 化工類專利分析與策略運用
name.en: Analysis and strategic application of chemical engineering patents

description.zh: 專利文件是最具價值的技術研發資訊。課程除了介紹專利相關基礎知識之外，並以有效的專利檢索分析技藝洞悉未來技術趨勢，特別是針對化學工程、生物科技、生醫材料、智能程序工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米材料等系所研究發展領域的專利文件。透過有系統的分析及視覺化的圖示呈現企業有用的專利情報(intelligence)，並找到其中潛在的商業利益。
description.en: Patent documents are the most valuable technology research and development information. In addition to introducing the basic knowledge of patents, the course also uses effective patent retrieval and analysis techniques to gain insight into future technological trends. The technical fields of patent documents are especially aimed at chemical engineering, biotechnology, biomedical materials, chemical process and intelligent engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductors and nanomaterials. Present the useful patent intelligence of enterprises through systematic analysis and visual diagrams, and try to find the potential commercial benefits.

syllabi.outline:
專利文件是最具價值的技術研發資訊。課程除了介紹專利相關基礎知識之外，並以有效的專利檢索分析技藝洞悉未來技術趨勢，特別是針對化學工程、生物科技、生醫材料、智能程序工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米材料等系所研究發展領域的專利文件。透過有系統的分析及視覺化的圖示呈現企業有用的專利情報(intelligence)，並找到其中潛在的商業利益。
Patent documents are the most valuable technology research and development information. In addition to introducing the basic knowledge of patents, the course also uses effective patent retrieval and analysis techniques to gain insight into future technological trends. The technical fields of patent documents are especially aimed at chemical engineering, biotechnology, biomedical materials, chemical process and intelligent engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductors and nanomaterials. Present the useful patent intelligence of enterprises through systematic analysis and visual diagrams, and try to find the potential commercial benefits.
syllabi.schedule:
Course Syllabus
1 week：Scope of intellectual property rights 智慧財產權的範圍
2 week：Introduction to basic concepts of patents 介紹專利基本概念
3 week：How to read the patent specification and patent claims如何閱讀專利說明書&申請專利範圍怎麼看
4 week：Patent requirements for substantive examination實體審查之專利要件
5 week：Patent Search Techniques, Strategies and Processes專利檢索技巧、策略與流程
6 week：The Importance and Purpose of Patent Analysis專利分析的重要性及其目的
7 - 8 weeks：Patent map analysis practice專利地圖分析實務
9 -14 weeks：Patent analysis case 專利分析案例分享(化學工程、生物科技、生醫材料、智能程序工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米材料、電動車、電池…..)
15 week：Patent Application Strategies and Strategy Applications專利申請策略與策略運用
16 week：Quality and value of patents專利的品質與價值
17 week：Enterprise patent management strategy and execution企業之專利管理策略與執行
18 week：Final Exam期末測驗

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重介紹電腦輔助製造技術的概念與實作。內容包含圖面繪製、圖面匯入、刀路設定、刀路轉存G代碼、設備介紹及數位設備上機實作等等，落實了CNC從無到有的步驟。課程包含介紹兩套熱門CAD/CAM軟體，降低了未來接軌數位製造的門檻。
This course focuses on the concepts and implementation of computer-aided manufacturing techniques. The content includes drawing practicie, drawing import, toolpath setting, toolpath transform G-code, digital manufacture introduction and computer implementation of digital equipment, etc., implementing the steps of CNC from scratch. The course includes the introduction of two popular CAD/CAM software, which lowers the threshold for connecting with digital manufacturing in the future.

description.en: The data mining (DM), which involves in Statistics, Database and Artificial Intelligence fields, prospects to seek Useful information from a great deal of data. This course emphasizes at the view of the database, besides go deeply into several data mining techniques. Finally, the practical case studies will also be discussed. The topic includes the concept of DM, the function of DM, the step of DM, data warehouse, Decision Trees Analysis, Clustering Analysis, Association Rule and Basket Analyzes, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Scope: This course is to introduce useful data mining techniques for students. We hope that students can learn more fundamental and advanced skills in the competitive mobile commerce world.
“Necessity is the mother of invention”—Data mining—Automated analysis of massive data sets.
Data mining (knowledge discovery from data) : Extraction of interesting (non-trivial, implicit, previously unknown and potentially useful) patterns or knowledge from huge amount of data.

syllabi.outline: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論					  本課程架構為探討技術及職業教育相關領域之理論應用與研究方法，藉由「多元化」研究主題之專題課程初探之操作並結合技職教育相關學術研究的基本特質與科學方法的傳統等進行課程內容之整合、系統化及融合式教學；本課程旨在熟悉技職教育的重要理論與概念、培養熱心探究教學與研究問題的態度以及訓練閱讀、摘要、報告、展演技職教育專題文獻之能力，並探討各種研究方法的特質與限制，引導學生以策略性的思考進行文獻探討並架構適當的設計研究策略，進而得以研擬具可行性的研究計劃以提昇研究者自我獨立研究及撰寫論文之能力之目標。

description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

syllabi.outline:
互動設計專注於使用情境相關課題，包括多元感覺的產品語意、資訊與功能的整體設計。顧及使用者的需求、使用者的心理和使用者的認知特性；將所有參與互動的操作及顯示單元，透過視覺、觸覺及聽覺等多元感覺的整合設計。使得使用者容易理解。
This course provides study of interaction design related topics on Product Semantics, Information and Function. With emphasis on User Interface integration and Usability Testing, psychology and cognitive proactive, the course will be characterized by inter-disciplinary on multi-median. This is where the user easy understanding applies and interacts with the product.
syllabi.schedule: Each student is responsible for presenting an usability excerpt from the text Designing with the Mind in Mind (DMiM). These are five-minute presentations, only five slides. They will be scheduled throughout the semester, and the calendar will be posted in advance on the Blackboard.Include website examples that refer to specific useful guidelines in the designated chapter.
syllabi.assessment:
1. As a lecture course, attendance is essential. The learning environment is the collaborative work of the creative process, with regular feedback. The role of the teacher is to guide you through this process. Outside work is sometimes necessary during the research phases, but apart from that, you are expected to attend each class for the entire class time. Plagiarism is dealt with in accordance with NTUTs academic standards and policies on fraud and plagiarization. Any copy of the work of another student or of information without proper citation is unacceptable. The student manual details the acts considered to be plagiarism, the channels through which they are treated, and their consequences.
2. Your final rating will be calculated on the basis of the scale below; the scoring criteria listed in the course syllabus. 
Discovery 5 Points 
Exploration; Generation + 10 Points 
Evaluation Phase with wireframes; documentation + 10 Points 
Test Plan; Validation + 20 Points Final Design + 15 Points 
Final Documentation & Presentation + 10 Points 
5 Slides 5 Minutes Presentations + 5 Points 
Participation, Quiz, Homework + 15 points = 100 Points 
No grades will be discussed by e-mail. No extensions will be granted unless a medical note or an email from your academic advisor is provided. In general, incomplete course grades are not granted without the agreement of the academic dean. Three absences will result in the loss of a final class; six absences will result in failure.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

開源軟體 (open-source software)對於資訊世界的發展極其重要，尤其是系統軟體與中介軟體。在1990年代快速發展的GNU/Linux，1990年代末期進入互連網時代，世界上最多伺服器使用的開源碼網頁伺服器Apache HTTP Server應運而生，之後更衍生出傳奇性的開源碼Apache Project。迄今，各個開源碼社群持續改進、優化既有的軟體，並且不斷地開發出有巨大影響力的新計畫，包括廣泛用於建構雲端服務與巨量資料運算的 OpenStack、Hadoop和Spark，世界上最多人使用在智慧手機和平板的Android作業環境。開源系統軟體與中介軟體更成為物聯網和巨量資料分析時代的重要基礎，高效率、即時性、機器與機器之間良好的溝通與合作是這個時代應用開發的關鍵，除了需要有高效率、穩定、安全的作業系統之外，還需要更多高品質、優化度高的系統軟體與中介軟體。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Open-source software is extremely important to the development of the information world, especially system software and middleware. GNU/Linux developed rapidly in the 1990s and entered the Internet era in the late 1990s. The open-source web server Apache HTTP Server, which is used by the most servers in the world, came into being, and then the legendary open-source Apache Project was born. So far, various open-source communities have continued to improve and optimize existing software, and continue to develop new projects with great influence, including OpenStack, Hadoop and Spark, which are widely used to build cloud services and massive data computing. The most widely used Android work environment on smartphones and tablets. Open-source system software and intermediary software have become an important foundation in the era of Internet of Things and massive data analysis. High efficiency, immediacy, and good communication and cooperation between machines are the keys to application development in this era. In addition to high efficiency, In addition to a stable and secure operating system, more high-quality, highly optimized system software and middleware are needed.

description.zh: 本課程介紹機器視覺之基本概念、原理及衍生應用，同時輔助以開放的影像函式庫來實作訓練；課程中由基礎的基本影像分析入門，並逐步導入機器視覺理論與方法，二維影像校正與立體視覺等內容；課程中將介紹機器視覺系統的相關資源與實作能力的培養，並進一步延伸至影像量測、機器學習與機器人領域的範例應用。
description.en: The field of machine vision has been growing at a fast pace. As in most developing fields, not all aspects of machine vision that are of interest to active researchers are useful to the designers and users of a vision system for a specific application. This course is intended to provide a balanced introduction to machine vision. Basic concepts are introduced with only essential mathematical elements. The details to allow implementation and use of vision algorithms in practical applications are provided, and engineering aspects of techniques are emphasized.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術(作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心)已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統(如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

syllabi.outline:
資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

name.zh: 自然語言處理與文件探勘
name.en: Natural Language Processing and Text Mining

description.zh: 在各種應用領域中，非結構化的文件相當普遍。如何精確有效地從文件中擷取出重要資訊並分析語意，將有助於彙整不同想法。本課程介紹基本的自然語言處理技術，包括: 語彙組成、語法分析、語意分析等，以及常見的文件探勘方法。除了介紹詞性標註 (POS tagging)、關鍵詞擷取 (keyterm extraction)、中文斷詞 (word segmentation)之外，也將探討不同的字詞與文件表達方式，並應用深度學習方法進行有效的語意分析，如: 情緒分析、意見探勘等。
description.en: Unstructured text docuemnts are very common in various applicaton domains. How to extract important information from texts and analyze their meanings is very helpful to aggregate various ideas. In this course, we are going to introduce the basic techniques in Natural Language Processing including: lexical, syntactic, and semantic anlaysis, and common text mining methods. In addition to POS tagging, keyterm extraction, and word segmentation, we are going to discuss different word and document representations, and apply deep learning methods in effective semantic analysis such as sentiment analysis and opinion mining.

description.zh: 本課程之主旨在於加強學生對薄膜處理程序之深入了解，以作為進一步對水質管理應用之基礎。薄膜的種類介紹包括薄膜逆滲透、奈米薄膜、超過濾、微過濾、前驅滲透、電透析以及薄膜生物處理。基本理論包括薄膜前處理、質量傳輸、積垢、結構、薄膜阻塞及清理、後處理及實務應用。
description.en: This class will provide graduate student authoritative information on the current knowledge of membrane process for water treatment, including reverse osmosis, nanofiltration, ultrafiltration, microfiltration, forward osmosis, electrodialysis and membrane bioreactor. The theories include pretreatment, mass transfer, fouling, scaling, membrane cleaning, post treatment and practical application.

description.zh: 本課程介紹統計學、計量經濟學之基本概念，旨在培養學生理解數據、進而分析數據能力。課程理論與實務並重，採理論講授、上機實作交替方式進行，確保學生在實務上應用統計理論之能力。透過修習本課程，學生可將統計概念應用於自然科學領域之實驗數據整理，或社會科學領域之巨量資料分析，培養具備跨領域問題分析能力之學生。
description.en: This course aims to develop the ability to understand and analyze environmental problems through the basic concept of statistics and econometrics. Both lectures regarding theories and practical lessons on computer are included in this course to make sure students’ ability of application in the future. Skills taught in this course can be applied in both natural science and social science, thus enhancing students’ interdisciplinary potential.

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹各種再生能源的原理與發展現況，包括太陽能、風能、波浪能、潮汐能、海流能、海洋熱能、鹽差能、生物能、水力能、地熱能、氫與燃料電池等，其有關的主要技術和成本、對環境造成的衝擊、來源的規模潛力及其未來前景。並檢視各種傳統能源如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等之使用現況及其衍生的環境議題。
Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.

description.en: It may also be called as Solid-state Devices and "functional ceramics" because of the special function applied in practical circuits; through the responses caused by pressure, force, sound, moisture, temperature and different gas, the fine electronic ceramics may also be called "sensing ceramics". In this course, the dielectric ceramics, piezoelectric ceramics, pyroelectric ceramics, semiconducting ceramics and magnetic ceramics will be introduced with their applications.

description.zh: 本課程內容目的在介紹電化學之原理與其應用.一、在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡,電解質之導電性質,界面現象,電極電位,電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容.二、在應用方面則涵蓋溶液化學參數測量,電化學分析技術,電鍍,表面處理,金屬腐蝕防治,電池應用,和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

syllabi.outline:
電化學工程的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
Electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electroanalytical sensors and batteries devices, the electroplating of metals, and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on applying electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 粉末冶金是工業先進國家積極發展的重點科技之一，其內容涵蓋粉末製造、粉末成形固結以及燒結體的後處理等範圍，本課程即安排包括粉末製造、粉末特性與其測定、粉末混合與造粒、成形、燒結理論與實務、燒結體性質與其測定、燒結體的後處理等基礎項目。另外，再講述利用粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品的實務應用項目等，以期讓學生能對粉末冶金技術能有基本上的認識。
description.en: Powder metallurgy is one of the most important highlighted high-tech in the developed countries, its content includes powder making,powder formation and condensing,and the final treatment of sintered body,etc.Thus, this course includes the fundamental items such as powder manufacturing, powder characteristics and its test, powder mixing and granulation, formation, sintering theory and practice, the property of sintering body and its test, the post-treatment of sintering body. Besides, it also lectures practice method like using powder metallurgy to manufacture material and product, in order to let students have basic knowledge about powder metallurgy.

description.zh: 半導體晶片封裝及微電子元件構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
description.en: Semiconductor chip packaging and microelectronic packaging is the critical technology to allow the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multichip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology.

syllabi.outline:
半導體構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
Semiconductor packaging facilitates the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multi-chip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology. It covers the topics in any electronic system, including electrical design for power, signal, and EMI; thermal design by conduction, convection, and radiation heat transfer; thermo-mechanical failures and reliability; advanced packaging materials at micro and nano-scales; ceramic, organic, glass, and silicon substrates.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

syllabi.outline:
薄膜科技是當今各式高科技製造業最不可或缺的技術之一，相關技術影響範疇包含電子、光電、半導體製造業、表面工程、高硬度高強度、耐磨抗腐蝕、裝飾與保護等等。薄膜技術種類與相關配合技術繁多，隨產業發展各項技術亦不斷進化，本課程涵蓋相關薄膜成長概論與原理，並搭配實作課程，期望讓學生認識薄膜在科技產業上的應用，並了解其重要性及未來的發展。
本課程包含以下主題：
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)


Thin film science and technology have gone through a thorough development which results in numerous new materials and advanced applications. Thin film research shares the knowledge from multi-disciplines, such as materials science, chemistry, solid state physics, mechanics and etc.. This course is an introductory class for students who are interested in thin film technology. Lab or tour session(s) will be provided to promote teaching and learning.

The topics will cover:
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)

description.zh: 基於學生畢業後的生涯發展，本課程目標旨在提供學生清楚認知未來的生涯發展，進而規劃自己的進路。針對設計學生畢業後的發展可以從學術界與實務界兩方面考量，學術界以直升研究所或工作後再修讀在職專班，而實務界則以可從事的相關職場做介紹與分析各行業的特色與前途，可擔任的職務名稱包括：互動設計師、互動程式設計師、使用者介面設計師、互動廣告企劃等，以供學生參考。
description.en: Based on the personal career development,  the course aims to provide a clearly scope and knowledge of future career development. This career can be analyzed in two categories, one is academic field that provide the master program and in-job training program; the another is practical field which concerns about more related design job, such as interaction designer, interactive programmer, user interface designer and interactive advertisement planner. This course not only introduces the design-related job, but also analyzes their characteristics and future development route.

description.zh:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。

未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?

In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

syllabi.outline:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?
In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

Overview
Futures Research is a survey course about the methods and tools that professional futurists use to help people anticipate and influence the future. It is a core course in the Futures Studies program. It covers methods and tools used by forecasters in general as well as by professional futurists. It also covers the techniques that futurists use more than others to forecast the future, particularly creating scenarios of the future, and the techniques used by futurists and consultants alike to help people influence the future, particularly visions, strategic plans, and change management programs.
Objectives

The student will understand and become familiar with: 
•	the framework approach to forecasting
•	critical thinking and other approaches to challenging assumptions
•	leading creativity tools and approaches and how they apply to futures
•	how to develop and evaluate scenarios
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction 
•	Become familiar with course objectives, expectations, and procedures
•	Become familiar with the learning platform. 
•	Introduce yourself to your classmates. 
•	State of the Art in Strategic Foresight

UNIT 1 FRAMEWORK FORECASTING: (Weeks 2 –5) 

Week 2 Environmental Scanning
•	Understand an approach to environmental scanning
•	Practice that approaches and assess how well each we and others are using it

Week 3 Research
•	Understand the futures forecasting process, including frameworks, monitoring, and scanning 
•	Present futures information in a logical order for forecasting alternative futures using the framework process 

Week 4 Interviews & Questionnaires 
•	List how people find out about other people's information, attitudes, expectations, and preferences for the future. 
•	Understand the differences among those ways, including the advantages and disadvantages of each. 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from an open-ended interview. 
•	Learn about questionnaire design and construction 
•	Learn about related topics, such as measurement, sampling, and the Delphi survey technique 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from a structured questionnaire. 

Week 2 Forecasting
•	Understand the nature of forecasting, its assumptions, its utility, and its difficulties

UNIT 2 CHALLENGING ASSUMPTIONS: (Weeks 6 –7) 

Week 6 Causal Layered Analysis
•	Understand and apply the causal layered analysis method
•	Become familiar with the concept of "depth" in futures work

Week 7 Critical Thinking
•	Learn a process for investigating the support for an inference, such as a forecast 
•	Conduct a critical analysis of a forecast in the published literature 
UNIT 3 CREATIVITY: (Weeks 8 –9) 
Week 8  Creativity Approaches
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and approaches to creativity
Week 9 Creativity Tools
•	Learn a standard approach to creative problem solving
•	Become familiar with a variety of creativity techniques
•	Practice applications of two principal creativity tools
UNIT 4 SCENARIOS: (Weeks 10 –12) 
Week 10  Scenario Theory
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and criteria of scenarios 

Week 11  Scenario Methods
•	Compare the strengths and weaknesses of various scenario approaches
•	Learn how to analyze and evaluate scenarios

Week 12 Scenario Cases 
•	Acquire an in-depth understanding of a leading practitioners approach to scenarios

UNIT 5 CONCLUSION: (Weeks 13 –15) 
Week 13 Draft Portfolio
•	Prepare draft portfolio for instructor feedback

Week 15 - 18 Final Portfolio
•	Submit the final portfolio

Students will learn how to use computer imaging and the technology and techniques of multi-media to make an interactive advertisement.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的形式、影響及其未來可能發展，課程內容包括互動式媒體的特性、社群媒體廣告類型、互動式廣告的創意策略、互動設計科技如何融入互動式廣告，使用者的回饋預設等互動式廣告所需的相關概念。本課程亦將導引同學透過廣告主的策略需求分析，運用多媒體科技與技術，來製作符合行銷目標的互動式廣告並參與競賽。
This course is designed to teach the form and impact of interactive advertising and its possible future development. The course covers the characteristics of interactive media, types of social media advertising, creative strategies for interactive advertising, how interactive design technology is integrated into interactive advertising, user feedback presets, and other related concepts required for interactive advertising. The course will also guide students to analyze the strategic needs of advertisers and use multimedia technology and techniques to create interactive advertisements that meet marketing objectives and participate in competitions.

description.zh: 有鑒於國內的教育制度主張男女擁有平等的權利，但實際結果卻是女學生在理工科系方面成為少數族群，本課程以增進女性參與人機互動為主要目標，結合一連串的研習營教學與展示技術的引入，教導有關互動科技技術等相關應用，並透過了解性別研究的主要流派與其理論，來確認性別研究與互動設計的性質與功能，期待學生能再了解性別研究的主要理論後，能把它應用於互動設計以及創意發想上，以因應未來女性經濟力的快速掘起。
description.en: The education system of Taiwan claims that men and women are equal. The truth is that female students are only a minority of the department of the science and engineering, not to mention the percentage of the further education in this field. Based on this concept, we plan the interactive curriculum. We will go to give instruction about the interactive technology. In order to test the spot reaction and track the reaction after the exhibition when the exhibition is ongoing, we will apply Radio-frequency identification. The outdoor education and the indoor education; the two complement each other and expecting this exhibition to encourage more female students to discovery the science and have better achievements in this field.

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的理論、企劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告專案製作之掌握、發揮互動式媒體特性的方法，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程透過課堂中關於互動式廣告原理的講授、相關的個案研究以及文獻導讀使學生能具備互動式廣告之企劃與研究分析能力。學生評量方式包含報告繳交以及分組討論與發表。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theory, planning and techniques of interactive advertisement, which includes the characteristics of interactive media, project management of advertisement, techniques of developing the interactive media, and the way to construct, design, create and maintain the interactive advertisement. The course is preceded by means of lecturing related theory, case studies and literature review to allow students to be capable of interactive advertisement planning and analysis. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於未來智慧互動城市發展的理論、方法、技術應用與案例分析。在智慧城市中，民眾透過主動、被動、自主和社群平台進行交流和合作，以實現不同的生活目標。學生將獲得有關智慧互動城市領域主要研究主題和實驗實踐的知識，培養她/他在建設智慧互動城市方面的技能。課程內容主要將從互動和設計的角度介紹和討論不同的範例，例如普適計算、環境智能、增強和虛擬現實、環境智能、可適化人機介面、操作性介面、物聯網、智慧家居、社會規範、及空間感知…等的應用情境與案例分析。與課程中，也將帶入不同的社會挑戰，並於學生分組專題，透過跨領域共作的模式，提出未來互動設計應用與智慧城市的方案。本課程將分為理論部分和實踐部分。理論部分涵蓋了開發和評估智慧互動系統的理論架構和方法，以及其實踐與應用方法。理論部分的部分內容將透過分組專題，同時學習理論的內容及其應用實踐的實務。

syllabi.outline: The main theme of the course is theories, methods, technologies, and case studies for the development of future smart interactive cities where humans and proactive, reactive, autonomous, and social platforms communicate and cooperate to reach goals. The student will acquire knowledge about main research themes and experimental practices in the field of smart interactive cities as well as develop her/his skills in constructing smart interactive cities. Different paradigms will be introduced and discussed, primarily from an interaction and design perspective such as ubiquitous computing, ambient intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, intelligent and adaptive user interfaces, tangible interfaces, persuasive technology, decision-support systems, Internet of Things, smart homes, social norms, and spatial awareness. Different societal challenges will also be addressed through cross-disciplinary collaboration in student projects. The course is divided into theoretical parts and practical parts. Course topic response reports, a midterm project proposal report, and a 4000 words final project report should be submitted in this course.
syllabi.schedule:
Unit One: Image of the City (Kevin Lynch)

Unit Two: A Pattern language (Christopher Alexander, Sara Ishikawa, Murray Silverstein)

Unit Three: Form follow Function or Function follow Form?

Unit Four: What is a Smart City? How "Smart" a city can be?

Unit Five: Space Syntax Analysis of a City.

Unit Six: Human-Centered City with Human Behavior Observation.

Unit Seven: City with Sensors and Network Technology.

Unit Eight: City with Big Data and Computing Technology.

Unit Nine: City Intelligence for planning, management, and decision making.
syllabi.assessment:
1. Attend all class sessions. (10%)
2. Actively engage in class discussions.
3. Submit a written assignment: During the semester, you are responsible for writing four 500-750 word reflection that responds to the course section topics and 
presentation. You must include an analysis of the topic (not simply summarizing the talk), including questions you may have or future areas of research that you would like to be involved with. (30%)
4. Design and complete an independent research project throughout the semester, such as providing a detailed case study of a smart city; conducting informational interviews with a smart city practitioner or researcher; or producing a literature review exploring aspects of the smart city. Prepare a midterm paper describing your research topic and proposal. (20%)
5. Write a 4,000-word paper (in Chinese or English,15 pages, double-spaced) and give a brief presentation about your research project to the class. (40%)

description.zh: 本課程將以問題導向學習(Problem-based Learning)的模式，學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心分析、問題定義、創意發想、雛型發展、驗證評估。並透過實際案例的分析與操作，學習互動設計跨領域創新的方法。本課程的主要目標在於提供學生：1. 了解互動設計的方法與步驟；2. 探討互動設計跨領域創新的方法與操作模式；3. 透過實務案例的操作累積互動設計的執行經驗。
description.en: This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

syllabi.outline:
Design thinking is a powerful approach to new product development that begins with understanding unmet customer needs. It’s a human-centered design process that approaches problem-solving with understanding the user needs. Design thinking encompasses concept development, applied creativity, prototyping, and experimentation. When design thinking approaches are applied to business, the success rate for innovation has been seen to improve substantially.

Design-driven companies such as Apple, Coca-Cola, IBM, Nike, Procter & Gamble, and Whirlpool have outperformed the S&P 500 over the past 10 years by an accumulated 211% in what's called the Design Value Index—a portfolio of 16 publicly traded companies that integrate design thinking into corporate strategy. According to a 2016 report from the Design Management Institute, this marks the third consecutive year the index has shown an excess of 200% over the S&P 500.

The Design Thinking course will lead participants through a step by step, design thinking process. To be considered successful, innovations have to solve the three key dimensions of Desirability, Feasibility, and Viability.

Desirability: Is this product or service addressing a real customer need?
Feasibility: Can we develop a solution that is technically feasible and better than competitors?
Viability: Is there a viable business model around this product or service?

This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如飛行模擬器、醫療檢測設備、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容包含幾何式虛擬實境、影像式虛擬實境、混合式虛擬實境等。
Virtual reality (VR) is an integration of art and technology. It is widely used in fields that are very different in nature such as aviation simulator, medical inspection equipment, preview of finished products, etc. This course will focus on the impact of VR application in the future technology and lifestyles as well as explore the relationships among engrossment, imagination, interaction, and human psychological cognition. The course content includes graphic-based VR, imaged-based VR, and hybrid VR.

description.zh:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。

未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?

In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

syllabi.outline:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?
In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

Overview
Futures Research is a survey course about the methods and tools that professional futurists use to help people anticipate and influence the future. It is a core course in the Futures Studies program. It covers methods and tools used by forecasters in general as well as by professional futurists. It also covers the techniques that futurists use more than others to forecast the future, particularly creating scenarios of the future, and the techniques used by futurists and consultants alike to help people influence the future, particularly visions, strategic plans, and change management programs.
Objectives

The student will understand and become familiar with: 
•	the framework approach to forecasting
•	critical thinking and other approaches to challenging assumptions
•	leading creativity tools and approaches and how they apply to futures
•	how to develop and evaluate scenarios
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction 
•	Become familiar with course objectives, expectations, and procedures
•	Become familiar with the learning platform. 
•	Introduce yourself to your classmates. 
•	State of the Art in Strategic Foresight

UNIT 1 FRAMEWORK FORECASTING: (Weeks 2 –5) 

Week 2 Environmental Scanning
•	Understand an approach to environmental scanning
•	Practice that approaches and assess how well each we and others are using it

Week 3 Research
•	Understand the futures forecasting process, including frameworks, monitoring, and scanning 
•	Present futures information in a logical order for forecasting alternative futures using the framework process 

Week 4 Interviews & Questionnaires 
•	List how people find out about other people's information, attitudes, expectations, and preferences for the future. 
•	Understand the differences among those ways, including the advantages and disadvantages of each. 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from an open-ended interview. 
•	Learn about questionnaire design and construction 
•	Learn about related topics, such as measurement, sampling, and the Delphi survey technique 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from a structured questionnaire. 

Week 2 Forecasting
•	Understand the nature of forecasting, its assumptions, its utility, and its difficulties

UNIT 2 CHALLENGING ASSUMPTIONS: (Weeks 6 –7) 

Week 6 Causal Layered Analysis
•	Understand and apply the causal layered analysis method
•	Become familiar with the concept of "depth" in futures work

Week 7 Critical Thinking
•	Learn a process for investigating the support for an inference, such as a forecast 
•	Conduct a critical analysis of a forecast in the published literature 
UNIT 3 CREATIVITY: (Weeks 8 –9) 
Week 8  Creativity Approaches
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and approaches to creativity
Week 9 Creativity Tools
•	Learn a standard approach to creative problem solving
•	Become familiar with a variety of creativity techniques
•	Practice applications of two principal creativity tools
UNIT 4 SCENARIOS: (Weeks 10 –12) 
Week 10  Scenario Theory
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and criteria of scenarios 

Week 11  Scenario Methods
•	Compare the strengths and weaknesses of various scenario approaches
•	Learn how to analyze and evaluate scenarios

Week 12 Scenario Cases 
•	Acquire an in-depth understanding of a leading practitioners approach to scenarios

UNIT 5 CONCLUSION: (Weeks 13 –15) 
Week 13 Draft Portfolio
•	Prepare draft portfolio for instructor feedback

Week 15 - 18 Final Portfolio
•	Submit the final portfolio

description.en: This course presents fundamentals of Hybrid Electric Vehicles: HEV concepts and design, energy analysis, unified modeling approach, optimization and control.  The power consumption side of vehicles. Conventional power generation: IC engine overview, concepts of hybridization, general model of energy form and energy flows, on-board energy storage (fuels and batteries). Overview of electrochemical converters: motors, transmissions for HEVs, principles of fuel cells, HEV application. Principles of energy optimization in HEVs.

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills.  Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

name.zh: 節能車輛模擬與嵌入式系統
name.en: Energy-saving vehicle simulation and embedded system

description.zh: 建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。
description.en: Establish the energy-saving vehicle simulation platforms are developed in this study to evaluate performance and response between main system and subsystems. The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

syllabi.outline:
建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。
Establish the energy-saving vehicle simulation platforms are developed in this study to evaluate performance and response between main system and subsystems. The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將企業教育訓練的專精、實務、效益特質融入學校實務課程。企業教育訓練講究課程要專精、內容要具體針對需求、以實務技術做講解、要能有具體成效、講求時間效率。本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，並實務教導開發AI瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。另外，本課程特別加強AI瑕疵檢測技術與應用，導入產業AI技術搭配教學。今年的課程將加入生成式AI，教導學生應用及開發生成式AI應用。
This course integrates the specialization, practice, and benefit characteristics of corporate education and training into the school's practical courses. Enterprise education and training emphasizes that the curriculum should be specialized, the content should be specific to the needs, the explanation should be based on practical skills, it should be able to have specific results, and it should pay attention to time efficiency. This course is based on the theme of landing industrial application technology, and introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German Technical University. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one webpage control program to implement a factory CPS production and marketing war situation information management system, and connect factories in series. Man-machine material and production line and quality control, and practical teaching to develop AI defect detection model, and then use man-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and carry out information connection of the whole factory. In addition, this course especially strengthens AI defect detection technology and application, and introduces industrial AI technology for teaching.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的進階基礎課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由先進智慧鐵道系統的介紹，使修課學生能夠清楚瞭解鐵道產業的未來發展方向，並引領學生積極投入各種先進智慧鐵道應用系統之研究。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請智慧鐵道系統相關、學有專精的技術研發人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時進行實作系統的展示，並邀請鐵道產業專家擔任評審。修習本課程前，不同學系之學生須先修習的課程清單另訂定之。
description.en: This course is one of the advanced core courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The aim of this course is, via the introduction of advanced intelligent rail system, to have the students realize thoroughly the development trend of futuristic rail industry, and subsequently, to encourage the students into the research and development of various application systems for intelligent railway. This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include R&D experts from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In their term reports, the students will have to demonstrate the prototypes of their projects and to be reviewed by the invited senior professionals from rail industry. The prerequisites for taking this course will be determined based on the background of students with different majors.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。使學生瞭解如何由自動控制理論與概念,轉化成控制系統的實務設計與實踐。課程內容包括: 機構、致動器、感測器、與控制器等元件及其整合技術介紹, 配合LabView + myRIO及周邊設備進行控制系統實務設計與測試,使同學由實驗中體會與培養控制系統的實務設計能力。
description.en: The object of the course is to let students understand how to transform the theory and concept of automatic control into a design and practice for a control system. Course contents include: introduction to mechanism, sensors actuator and controller elements, as well as the needed integration technique. LabView + myRIO and peripheral devices are used in the course to design a practically useful controller and to verify its effectiveness. Students therefore can gain the practical controller design experience via this learning by doing approach。

syllabi.outline: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程主要說明如何應用自動控制理論與概念於機電一體化控制系統之實務設計；課程內容包括：控制設計基本概念、頻率域控制設計、常用控制系統架構、以及傳動機構與致動器/感測器等機電一體化控制系統之關鍵與整合。本課程進行控制系統模擬與實驗，同學們可體會控制系統之實務設計與應用，培養與建立機電一體化控制系統分析與設計之基礎能力。

description.zh: 化學是富挑戰性且具教學難度之科目，使這個複雜的學科讓學生易於接受化學教育家的挑戰，特別是基礎化學。嘗試推展關鍵的化學概念，並以觀察現象為主，再討論理論模式，並用以解釋所觀測的現象是本課程的重點。希望學生實踐"如同一個化學家的思考方式"來仔細觀察，而不是跳入公式或模型中。此外，舉例證明化學在現實生活中的重要性與最新的應用及發展並以簡易明瞭的方式呈現於授課內容。
description.en:
Chemistry is fascinating and important subject that is challenging to teach and even more challenging to learn. Marking this complex subject accessible to students without distortion is challenge of the chemical educator, especially at the introductory level.
In this lecture I try to develop key chemical concept in the same way to show the observations first and then discuss the models that have been constructed to explain the observed behavior. I hope students will practice "thinking like a chemist" by carefully studying the observation to see if they can follow the thought process, rather than just jumping head to the equation or model that will follow.
In addition, to demonstrate the importance of chemistry in real life, I have incorporated throughout the book a number of applications and recent advances in essay form.
