name.en: Taguchi Method on the Quality Design

description.zh:
(1)「田口方法」介紹
(2)完整的「田口方法」，包含以下三個主題：
(a) S/N比之理論基礎及進階應用；
(b)直交表之理論基礎及進階應用；
(c)變異分析。
(3)應用「田口方法」進行專案研究，並繳交專案主題與報告。
description.en:
(1) The course gives step-by-step to explaining the "Taguchi Method" for the students.
     (2) The course gives the fully "Taguchi Method" for the students during a short time, which including three topical subjects:
  (a) The basic theory of S/N ratio and its advanced applications.
  (b) The basic theory of Orthogonal Arrays and its advanced applications.
  (c) Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
  (3) Students will use the "Taguchi Method" to proceeding a project study, and hand over their theme and report of project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的學習目標是要讓學生學習「田口方法」的基本觀念，並且以實際案例做說明，讓學生學習專有名詞的定義及應用。課程內容包含：直交表實驗、品質計量方法(品質損失、S/N比之理論基礎及應用)、變異分析、案例說明。在學期結束時，應用「田口方法」進行專案主題研究，並繳交期末報告。
The learning goal of this course is to enable students to learn the basic concepts of the Taguchi Method. In addition, actual cases are used to explain, so that students can learn the definition and application of proper nouns. The course content includes: experiment with orthogonal arrays, quality measurement methods (theoretical basis and application of quality loss, S/N ratio), analysis of variance, and case description. At the end of the semester, apply the "Taguchi Method" to conduct project thematic research and submit the final report.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程經由研究、分享、討論，瞭解科技創新轉型發展之趨勢，進行科技創新之思維與實例教學，使學生能瞭解創新之模式及相關理論，以啟發學生之創意，促進學術與產業之互動與交流。內容包含科技未來趨勢和創新挑戰，企業核心技術、來源和取得，科技管理與風險，國家科技政策之影響，企業發展生存之道，全球創新產品之開發與技術策略與戰略。
Through research, sharing, and discussion, this course aims to understand the trend of technological innovation, its transformation and development, to tell technological innovation, thought and examples, to enable students to understand the mode of innovation and related theories. The course will inspire students' creativity, and will promote the interaction between academia and industry. The course content includes the future trend of science, technology and innovation challenges, enterprise core technology with its source and acquisition. It also includes the science and technology management and risk which impact the national science and technology policy for enterprise development and survival, and the development of global innovative products and technology strategies and tactics.

name.zh: 非線性光纖光學與應用

description.zh: 利用光纖來製造雷射與光放大器已經廣泛的應用在各領域，由於光纖具有小的纖核，且光在此介質傳播時，通常具有相當長的傳播距離，此外利用各種鎖模技術所產生的短脈衝或是藉由光放大器，使得在光纖中傳播的光具有相當高的功率或是峰值功率，因此許多非線性光學的現象在光纖中被產生，近來更種新穎的光纖包括利用微結構光纖或稱為光子晶體光纖被廣泛的應用，使得光纖所產生非線性效應更為顯著，本課程將介紹在光纖中各種非線性光學現象產生的原理與其應用。
description.en: Fiber laser and amplifier have been widely used in various fields.  Due to  its small core and relative long propagation length of fiber and relative large  power and peak power light source is used, that is generated from mode-locked technique and amplifier, various nonlinear optical phenomena can be observed through propagation of the fiber.  Recently, many novel optical fibers including the microstructured fiber or termed photonic crystal fiber are widely used to cause the advance of the generated nonlinear phenomena.  In this course, it will introduce the principle of the generated nonlinear effects and its applications.

syllabi.outline: Owing to the relatively small fiber core, many third order nonlinearity effect including self-phase modulation, four wave mixing, stimulated Raman scattering will be excited as high intensity pulsed light propagation in fiber.  In addition, the nonlinearity will be enhanced by means of novel fiber such as photonics crystal fiber or tapered fiber.  In this course, it will introduce the principle of optical fiber and propagation theory (Nonlinear Schrödinger equation) to simulate different kind of nonlinear optical phenomenon.  In addition, it will introduce the principle of the mode-locked fiber laser and variety soliton dynamics.

description.zh: 逆向工程已成為電腦輔助產品開發技術重要的一環，透過三次元量測或掃瞄技術，取得工件表面的點資料，據以建構3D CAD幾何模型(Geometric model)，以供後續設計、電腦輔助工程分析(CAE)與電腦輔助製造(CAM)之應用。逆向工程的程序分為三個階段：(1)擷取工件表面的點資料；(2)點資料的前置處理；以及(3)建構或更新幾何模型。依此流程，本課程首先講述各類運用於逆向工程中的量測與掃瞄技術，並以設計應用觀點為基礎，討論其間的差異與優缺點，隨著運用領域的不同，而採取不同的量測技術；其次介紹點資料前置處理的理念與方法，從現有文獻中，解析的相關的技術，因量測技術與策略的差異，而發展出不同的處理技術；至於，重建或更新原有的幾何模型的部分，將著重設計實務的應用，並與現有的CAD系統整合的策略。課程之目標，為使修習本課程之學生能對逆向工程的相關理論與技術，有全盤的認識與瞭解，並透過實際案例的操作，訓練學生能具備實務作業能力。
description.en: Reverse engineering has become an important tool for geometric model construction in 3D CAD based on the data points, digitized from an existing part, for the downstream applications such as CAE and CAM. The process of reverse engineering can usually be subdivided into three stages, i.e. (1) part digitization for capturing the data points; (2) data point pre-processing; and (3) CAD modeling and/or updating. In this course, the relevant techniques in the three stages of reverse engineering procedure are introduced firstly. Through the project practice, the student is able to adept to the techniques of reverse engineering.

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

Attendance policy
Attendance is taken by your class rep at a time of her or his choice during the class. Your attendance will be recorded in the University system. You will automatically receive a grade of zero for the course with 16 or more unexcused absences from Week 2 onwards. You may get an excused absence only upon presentation of a note of approval for leave from the university system to the Class Rep no later than 7 days after the date of the class.

Group Presentation

Organize into 10 to 11 groups. 
Visit the Taipei Biennale before March 24.  Here is the website: https://www.taipeibiennial.org/2023/list/participants).
Pick ONE artwork. Send a message in the LINE group containing the following information: the title of the artwork, the artist, your group number, your group members’ names and student IDs.
Once an artwork is chosen by a group, no other group can pick the same artist or artwork. 

In Week 8, your group will present for 15 min on the following:
1.	Describe the artwork.
2.	Analyze the artwork (What are the themes? How are these themes expressed? What is the artist’s point? syllabi.outline:
透過每週的閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀技能。 在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將專注於理解西方語言和文化的核心理念，從而理解西方文化中的人（他們的價值觀、動機、原則）的核心理念。 [本課程過去的主題包括：怪物與人類； 喜劇和幽默； 善與惡的本質； 西方英雄； 棒球與社會； 美的理念和重要性； 探索與發現]。 透過審視圍繞這一主題的文章和電影，我們將思考這個重要的想法告訴我們關於西方社會及其人民的哪些資訊。
Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

本課程以英文時事為教材，訓練學生英文新聞時事字彙，並藉由增加詞彙量與練習重要句型，使學生進而能閱讀與理解國際時事英文新聞。教材將選自報紙/雜誌（如China Post與Taipei Times雙語新聞）或線上新聞（如VOA Special English）中適合學生之各類新聞（如政治、經濟、科技、娛樂與時尚新聞等），以有效提升其英文閱聽能力。  

English Description:

News reports suitable for basic-level students will be selected from newspapers or news magazines (e.g. bilingual news from China Post and Taipei Times) and online news websites (e.g. VOA Special English) to effectively enhance students’ fundamental reading skills.

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過各種英語新聞媒體如電視新聞（如CNN, BBC, NBC）、英文雜誌（如The Economist, Scientific American ）、英文報紙（New York Times, Washington Post, the Guardian等）等，來培養學生的批判性閱讀能力．並同時提升其宏觀視野與多元知識。課堂中將藉由分析英語新聞的用字遣詞、報導角度的取捨、標題與議題的呈現方式等，使學生學習如何思考報導背後之立場，從而進行批判性閱讀。此外，亦將剖析英語新聞中所含括之英美文學典故與文化傳統，帶領學生瞭解新聞英文的豐富意涵。
description.en: This course aims to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, reporting angles and the selection and presentation of headlines or quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to develop students’ reading and speaking abilities in the fields of science, technology and engineering. The course will be focusing on reading strategies, communication skills and vocabulary building. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering. Class activities include class discussion, group discussion, presentation and so on. Students are required to express their thoughts in English during the class.

description.zh: 本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。

This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

Centered around the fields of science, technology and engineering, the materials and activities in the course are designed to prepare students to understand and discuss the topics of the fields.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生學術英文能力，課堂將引導學生透過不同的學術聽力訓練、閱讀學術文章、學術寫作練習、與學術口語訓練等，來增進學生於大學英語授課課堂中的課堂參與，以及整體學術能力的展現，並為未來專業職場上語言能力奠定良好基底。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在帶領學生閱讀、理解並分析文章結構,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型，學術用語等，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升閱讀理解、寫作與口說能力。
This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality reading and listening material including journals, and speech podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key academic English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, science & technology, business and health. Students learn to listen, read, write, and discuss different subjects through diverse forms of activities.

description.zh: 本課程將閱讀並討論聯合國2030年持續發展議程的議題，主題和做法。 藉由對全球繁榮，社會平等和環境可持續性共同藍圖的認識，學生能進一步參加全球活動，並在本地和跨域發展共同夥伴關係，以參與持續發展目標的行動。 此外，學生將能夠通過批判性閱讀和討論來強化英語能力，並為與可持續發展目標有關的更深入的交流做好準備。
description.en: This course will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed for the second-year, non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in various topics on "Sustainability."

By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

Different activities (listening practice, role-play, group discussion, and oral presentation) are designed to facilitate students’ English learning.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service design students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

Attendance policy
Attendance is taken by your class rep at a time of her or his choice during the class. Your attendance will be recorded in the University system. You will automatically receive a grade of zero for the course with 8 or more unexcused absences from Week 2 onwards. You may get an excused absence only upon presentation of a note of approval for leave from the university system to the Class Rep no later than 10 days after the date of the class. 

Group presentation:
You will form groups of three and present a book chapter or article selected by the lecturer for 20 minutes followed by a Q&A session. Sign-up with the Class Rep is on a first-come first-serve basis.

Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh:
本課程介紹了創新的本質、企業創新的原因以及如何管理創新。課程內容程涵蓋有關創新管理的一系列主題，包括創新動機、企業如何利用知識產權（如專利和商標）保護其創新、“研究與開發”（R&D )、創意人員、流程和團隊的管理，產品、服務和體驗創新的管理，“開放式創新”的採用和使用，以及創新中模塊化的採用和使用。
本課程在科技管理的部分主要介紹科技管理廠商層次(micro-level)與總體層次(macro-level)的相關理論，研究的領域與相關學術期刊。廠商層次介紹開放式創新、創業管理、智慧財產管理、資源論、技術搜尋、產業組織論等。在總體層次介紹科技政策的範疇與相關理論，包括技術典範與軌跡、國家、產業與區域創新系統、服務創新、科技計量與指標與產學合作政策等。
課程內容包括以案例研究為重點的討論，其中混合使用虛實的公司來討論管理創新的各個面向。這些討論與課程中涵蓋的主題互補，並以加強用予實際應用的想法。透過本課程，學生可以對碩/博士論文的研究課題，能有正確且有效地構建文獻探討的能力。
description.en:
This course introduces the nature of innovation, why firms innovate, and how innovation can be managed. The lectures cover a range of topics concerning the management of innovation, including motivations for innovating, how firms can protect their innovations using intellectual property rights (such as patents and trademarks), the nature and organization and management of “research and development” (R&D), the management of creative people, processes and teams, the management of product, service and experience innovations, the adoption and use of “open innovation”, and the adoption and use of modularity in innovation.  
This course introduces the micro-level and macro-level of technology management with respect to related theories, research field and academic journal. description.zh:
中文概述
Chinese Description 	(1).本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種經營管理領域的科技應用，包括：預測分析、客戶關係管理、資源優化、行銷和廣告、智慧客服、決策支援。
(2).學生能夠學到正確學習商業智能與資料科學的3個步驟：A.使用pandas模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。B.用numpy，sklearn模組來處理迴歸分析等機器學習問題。C.用keras深度學模組進行商業預測。
(3).本課程將讓著重在培養學生具有基礎的資料科學與數據分析能力，有能力使用python來做商業分析與視覺化，精通包括pandas與matplotlib模組。
(4).訓練學生精通商業數據程式分析，有能力處理資料的一體化分析，包括：數據採集、清洗、查詢與計算、分析與挖掘、可視化。
(5).訓練學生有能力處理採集各種大數據資料，包括：網頁爬取，json，xml，csv, excel，mySQL，noSQL
(6).本課程將探討各種案例，例如『業務銷售分析，淘寶電商數據分析，市場佔有率分析，系所生源分析，股票市場分析，問卷資料分析』。
description.en:
(1). This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business management fields.
(2). Students can learn 3 steps to correctly learn business intelligence and data science: A. data analysis and visualization. B. machine learning. C. deep learning business forecasting applications.
(3). This course will focus on basic data science and data analysis in modules including pandas and matplotlib.
(4). Train students  have the ability to process integrated analysis of data, including: data collection, data cleaning, data query and calculation, data analysis and mining, and data visualization.
(5). Train students to be able to process and collect various big data, including: web crawling, json, xml, csv, excel, mySQL, noSQL

syllabi.outline:
課程目標：
本課程旨在深入教授Pandas在經營管理領域的商業數據分析中的應用，讓學生掌握如何使用Pandas進行高效的數據處理與分析。學生將學習Pandas的基本操作，包括資料結構的建立、操作、數據清理技巧，以及如何使用Pandas進行高級數據分析技術。期末會讓學生自行實作2個實際商業數據分析的side project，學生將能夠獨立進行商業數據的分析，並解決實際商業問題。

課程描述：
這是一門針對經營管理領域的商業數據分析的高級Pandas課程。從Python的基礎知識開始，本課程將引導學生逐步熟悉Pandas的核心功能，包括Series和DataFrame的操作，數據清理技巧，以及數據分析方法。學生將學習如何處理缺失值、合併數據、進行分群分析，以及應用高級函數處理數據。透過實際案例分析，如系所生源分析和業務銷售分析，學生將能夠將理論知識應用於實際問題。課程強調實際操作和案例研究，旨在提高學生的數據分析技能，為未來職場中的數據分析工作做好準備。
Course Objectives:
This course is designed to provide an in-depth teaching of Pandas in business data analysis within the field of business management, enabling students to master efficient data processing and analysis using Pandas. Students will learn the basics of Pandas operations, including the establishment and manipulation of data structures, data cleaning techniques, and the application of advanced data analysis techniques with Pandas. By the end of the course, students will be expected to independently undertake two side projects on practical business data analysis, equipping them with the skills to analyze business data and solve real-world business problems.

Course Description:
This advanced Pandas course focuses on business data analysis in the field of business management. Starting with the fundamentals of Python, the course will guide students through the core functionalities of Pandas, including the manipulation of Series and DataFrames, data cleaning techniques, and data analysis methods. Students will learn how to handle missing values, merge data, perform cluster analysis, and apply advanced functions for data processing. Through practical case studies, such as departmental student source analysis and business sales analysis, students will be able to apply theoretical knowledge to practical issues. The course emphasizes hands-on practice and case studies, aiming to enhance students' data analysis skills and prepare them for future data analysis roles in the workplace.

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學生熟悉零售策略的基本概念，了解目前的零售產業之環境分析及零售趨勢之分析，探討零售行銷之區隔與定位，進而將零售策略如何應用於管理理論與實務分析。零售業包含百貨業、連鎖店、超市、超商等，與人們的關係極切，本課程主在探討如何經由零賣出使顧客滿意的商品。 內容：零售業概論、配銷通路、行銷研究、產品管理策略、定價策略、促銷策略、賣場規劃、零售業經營策略、顧客滿意 1.具備零售管理學相關知識與概念。 2.掌握零售業環境與趨勢之分析能力。 3.具備零售業行銷區隔與定位的分析能力。 4.具備零售策略應用於理論與實務之分析能力。
description.en: This masters-level course is designed to provide the student with a deeper understanding of retailing strategic management. description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。另外，為了讓企業經理人了解衍生性金融商品，本課程亦以深入淺出方式介紹選擇權之基本觀念、交易實務與決策應用。本課程目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識，培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才

The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. In addition, in order to let corporate managers understand the derivatives, this course introduces the basic concept of option, transaction practice and decision-making applications. The purpose of this course is to provides knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value, so as to cultivate financial management talents with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

description.zh: 隨著新冠肺炎的疫情，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，經營數位行銷的需求，已經是每個公司所必需的。從新產品的開發、行銷、到售後服務均受影響。網路電子商務已經成為傳統行銷實體通路以外的一個新興通路。使得電子商務明顯的成為未來商業發展的主流。因此，如何經營數位行銷已是現代企業具有競爭力重要課題。這個課程幫助企業在充分瞭解顧客信息的基礎上，針對客戶喜好，針對性地進行產品行銷，幫助企事業單位在激烈的市場競爭中取得競爭優勢。

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，必須具備宏觀的投資理財知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資理財之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，期望能制訂出最適的長短期投資決策，以獲取合理的投資報酬或超越市場績效表現。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of comprehensive investment management, this course combines information and software tools to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can provide students with skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting students to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market by working out the optimal short- and long-term investment decisions.

syllabi.outline:
公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh:
近年來企業為面對市場的競爭與快速改變，其多以大型專案方式同時來執行幾個專案，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造及教育訓練等專案活動。大型專案管理要如何才能在企業統一的願景和策略下展開，來提升企業的競爭優勢與創造價值。因大型專案的時程較長且範圍較多，其不確定性和混淆性也較高，以致其成功的關鍵除須具備專案的執行的效率外，還須具有在於對變化的反應能力。
本課程內容將著重於介紹大型專案規劃流程中所使用的技能與工具說明外，並安排學生企業內大型專案實務案例做為課堂內探討。其目的在訓練學生如何面對高混淆性和高不確定性的大型專案，使企業內大型專案管理有系統的方法執行與圓滿完成。
description.en:
Recently, in order to face the challenges and rapid changes of the competition, enterprises often need have a large-scale project to execute several projects at the same time, such as product development, marketing planning, manufacturing, and education and training. How can large-scale project management be carried out under the unified vision and strategy of the enterprise? New capabilities and cultural consensus are needed to enhance the enterprise's competitive advantage and create value. Due to the long duration and large scope of large-scale project, its uncertainty and confusion are also high, so that the key to its success must be not only the efficiency of project execution, but also the ability to respond to changes.

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，必須具備宏觀的投資理財知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資理財之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，期望能制訂出最適的長短期投資決策，以獲取合理的投資報酬或超越市場績效表現。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of comprehensive investment management, this course combines information and software tools to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can provide students with skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting students to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market by working out the optimal short- and long-term investment decisions.

description.zh: 先修課程：電磁學、工程數學、近代物理。 由電磁學之理論推展光波之運行，並經由近代物理之量子論推導出之原子及分子能階與固態晶體之能帶理論，加以說明電磁波與物質間之作用。介紹共振腔、活化性介質及各種雷射之激發形式等雷射三個基本組成。並針對雷射光之種類、特性及其應用，加以說明。
description.en: Combining the propagation of optical wave been deduced from the electromagnetic theory and the quantum theory introduced by modern physics such as energy level of atom and molecular and the energy band of solid state, the interaction between electromagnetic wave and matter is introduced. The three fundamental components of laser: resonator, active medium, and pumping method are explained. Also the types, characteristics, and applications of various laser are introduced.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的經典著作 (包括建築理論、文學、電影、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，並結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

本課程希望修課者以研究者、創作者和建築學者的三種身份，從(形而下)到非物質面(形而上)的互文關係，且具有相互指涉互為一體的角度來理解、洞察和探索建築，培養建築學上的抽象性思考和創作觀點，並藉此建構建築視野的哲思；另一方面，做為創作型論文的設計方法論的基礎養成。

課程以非授課形式進行，修課者每周進行指定、和延伸性閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

透過整學期指定的多重文本閱讀，以具有個人意識的主題進行交叉比較和探討，期望修課者最終能建立個人思辯和申論式的建築書寫。

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解世界地域文化中，因人、因時、因地制宜的建築生產過程，及其涉入空間行為因時間積累而呈現的特殊環境型態、類型與結構；即在探討地方自然地理環境，如何經由人類行為的涉入，呈現出富鄉土涵構的人文景觀。
description.en: This course is to understand the relations between human, behavior, material and the environment of architecture in the world. And try to introduce the vernacular characters of the World architecture by the discussion of some special architectural themes.

syllabi.outline: 台灣原住民為南島語系（Austronesian linguistics）的一支，其他所屬地域包括南太平洋幾個小島，如Austrelia、Indonesia、Malaysia、Borneo、Melanesia、Micronesia、New Guinea、Philippine、Polynesia、New Zealand等所謂南島族群。本課程的設計，擬以風土建築的學理分析開始，並由宗教學、人類學及建築學等跨領域學科理論，分就原住民所屬的原始社會予以介紹，依信仰、象徵、儀式行為、儀式空間、儀式建築的表徵分別討論，期使修課同學對於原初建築形式的出現及來由，有一深刻的認識。其次，由修課同學就世界風土建築進行資料收集，除介紹世界不同地域所生產的建築文化外，亦就其社會組織、生活文化特色及象徵系統進行討論。

name.en: Theory and Practice of Landscape Ecological Design

description.zh:
景觀生態學是以生態學理論來理解並建立一套可以認知景觀與其中的生物﹑非生物環境關係的學科。有關景觀的生態設計理論基本上是將這一系列景觀生態學模型或原理作為設計指標而形成的一套設計操作理論。景觀生態原理在景觀學科中具有極其根本的角色，不僅在景觀資源保育與管理上提供極具價值的參考；對於景觀規畫與設計實務者更提供了在不同尺度範疇狀況下三向度空間設計的形態準則。
因此，課程涵蓋了從區域、基地和細部設計三種尺度的設計內涵，講述及操作在基於不同目的的需求時，人為景觀如何介入自然環境，以及導入的人為景觀的設計準則。
1. 景觀生態與形態理論
2. 景觀生態設計理論
3. 景觀生態設計理論的應用 
   a. 都市地區和鄉村地區     
   b. 區域、基地和細部設計尺度
description.en:
Landscape ecology seeks for principles and models that contribute to dealing with conservation, management, and design in landscape practice. The course "Landscape Theory and Practice of Ecological Design" refers to those principles and models established in landscape ecology and then applies to landscape planning and design. Issues relates to this courses are listed as follows;
1. Landscape Ecology and landscape morphology
2.  Ecological design theory
3.  The application of ecological theory in landscape         practice 
    a. Urban region and countryside     
    b. Macro-sale, meso-sale, and micro-scale

syllabi.outline:
本課程係以生物多樣性保育及其對現代設計理念的跨領域思考為主軸，說明地表重要生態體系的功能與結構，及其所蘊育的生物，在物種演化、環境適應與生活史策略上的特色，輔以國內外案例介紹，探討如何將生態體系的運轉模式與永續理念，有效整合到人為工程的規劃、設計、施作、乃至後續監測維護過程中。此外，並將深入剖析近代動物園與水族館設計理念的發展，及討論既有公共工程，如道路、橋樑、護坡、農田水圳、攔水堰等設計，對環境與生物的影響，另搭配臺北近郊的生態工法案例介紹與研擬討論，期能激發同學對相關議題的興趣與實務經驗。
	This course will be focusing on biodiversity conservation and multidisciplinary thinking on modern design concepts. The functions and structures of important ecological systems on earth, and the organisms inhabit with their evolution, adaptation and life history strategies will be introduced. With domestic and foreign cases, how to effectively integrate the operation mode and sustainable concept of the ecological system into the planning, design, construction, and subsequent monitoring and maintenance of human engineering will be discussed. In addition, the development of modern zoo and aquarium design concepts, or the impact of existing public construction works, such as roads, bridges, slope protection, farmland canals, and weirs, to our environment will also be involved in a hope to stimulate students' interest in related topics and practical experience.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的經典著作 (包括建築理論、文學、電影、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，並結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

本課程希望修課者以研究者、創作者和建築學者的三種身份，從(形而下)到非物質面(形而上)的互文關係，且具有相互指涉互為一體的角度來理解、洞察和探索建築，培養建築學上的抽象性思考和創作觀點，並藉此建構建築視野的哲思；另一方面，做為創作型論文的設計方法論的基礎養成。

課程以非授課形式進行，修課者每周進行指定、和延伸性閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

透過整學期指定的多重文本閱讀，以具有個人意識的主題進行交叉比較和探討，期望修課者最終能建立個人思辯和申論式的建築書寫。

name.en: Special Topics on Indoor Environment Quality

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；
2.探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；
3.進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；
4.學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.
Contents :
1. The indoor environment of single type of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.
4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.
5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。
本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。

name.en: Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage

description.zh:
我國古蹟與歷史建築之文化遺產防災計畫實施現況，至今因欠缺有系統之調查研究，因此難以了解問題點所在。此外台灣現有之古蹟與歷史建築多為日治時期所遺留下來，而日本至今已有相當多具有良好防災計畫之古蹟與歷史建築案例，應可作為我國相關研究參考，但國內對此課題亦缺少有系統之調查。
本課程的授課內容如下：1.概論 2.文化遺產防災之重要性3.文化遺產防災之基本策略4. 文化遺產防災之進行方式5.文化遺產之災害種類與對策。
description.en:
Due to the lack of systematic research work carried out in Taiwan, it is difficult to find out the problems of the current disaster prevention plans for the cultural heritage. Taiwan has many existing vestiges and relics from Japanese colonial period at the moment. Despite the fact that there are numerous excellent examples of disaster prevention plans in Japan for us to consult and to research, little systematic work regarded the subject can be found in the literature in our own country. 
The course content about followings: 
1. Introduction
2. Importance of disaster prevention of cultural heritage
3. Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage 
4. Approach of disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage
5. Type of cultural heritage disaster and guideline

name.zh: 都市土地使用計畫與成長管理
name.en: Urban Land Use Planning and Growth Management

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在強化有關都市土地使用規劃與成長管理的理論與經驗，以及增進對都市整體建成環境未來的瞭解。因此，本課程將藉由對都市土地使用規劃與成長管理經驗特有與一般課題、對策及創新作法的基礎瞭解，以培養理論與實務的知能。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、都市成長對土地的需求。 二、土地使用管制與倫理。三、都市變遷與規劃。四、都市成長管理與政府的角色。 五、達到都市成長管理的可能途徑。 六、都市成長管理體系內的必要措施：例如環境、交通運輸、住宅、財政、風險、信託、組織等。 七、結論。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to further our knowledge about current theories and experiences with urban land use planning and growth management, and the struggle to define the collective future of our built environment. By identifying unique as well as common issues, problems, and innovations in urban growth management experiences, our hope is to improve planning practice. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Land needs for urban growth. 2. Land use control and ethics. 3. Urban change and planning. 4.Growth management and the role of government. 5. Alternative approaches to growth management. 6. Balancing planning needs in growth management systems: environmental, transportation, housing, financing, risk, trust and organization concerns. 7. Conclusions

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

2.	Detail of "Participation"
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)
(Week 03) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)
(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China
(Week 11) Japanese architecture after WWII 
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII
(Week 13) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (from 1940s to 1960s)
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism
(Week 16) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world

3.	Detail of "	Mid-term presentation": proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in certain approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex. Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex. Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.

4.	Detail of "	Research thesis": 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by 6/20 12:00pm to Dr. Wu. The words of the thesis should not be less than 3000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的經典著作 (包括建築理論、文學、電影、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，並結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

本課程希望修課者以研究者、創作者和建築學者的三種身份，從(形而下)到非物質面(形而上)的互文關係，且具有相互指涉互為一體的角度來理解、洞察和探索建築，培養建築學上的抽象性思考和創作觀點，並藉此建構建築視野的哲思；另一方面，做為創作型論文的設計方法論的基礎養成。

課程以非授課形式進行，修課者每周進行指定、和延伸性閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

透過整學期指定的多重文本閱讀，以具有個人意識的主題進行交叉比較和探討，期望修課者最終能建立個人思辯和申論式的建築書寫。

name.zh: 土木與防災之低碳管理
name.en: Low Carbon Management of Civil Engineering and Disaster Prevention

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR等)於土木與防災之低碳管理。擇採綠色與數位雙軸科技(如數位碳盤查與減碳之智化物聯網AIoT)作為課程雙核心編排，介紹內容如碳-水-環境足跡之盤查與減碳策略、綠-智-健康之數位雲平台、無線感測與低工耗遠域網路等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Carbon-Water-Environmental inventory associated with Artificial Intelligent/Internet of Things (AIoT) to meet sustainable development of civil engineering and disaster adaptation/mitigation. The contents in this class include sustainable development goals such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR briefly, green-intelligent-healthy construction/maintenance and resilient projects, WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network), e-Cloud Management.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

description.zh: 本課程預計透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點社區議題並研擬對策，建構城鄉空間的形成與社會族群的關係，並進行城鄉空間再造的提案。
description.en: This course is aimed to involve the students into the project of University Social Responsibility. By means of inventory on issues in communities and through project-based learning, this course will provide students an opportunity to understand the relationship between formation of urban spaces and social groups, then to draft a social plan, a facility plan or even a strategic guidance for further execution. From urban space reconstruction to place-making (regional revitalization), the students are expected to explore the diverse values of architectural profession and to practice the social responsibility by applying their expertise to solve real-world problems.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求BIM技術之整合運用。本課程針對BIM運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對BIM軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en:
Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.
In recent years, Taiwan has asked the public works bidding integrate and use of BIM technology. This course focuses on the introduction and effective life cycle of BIM for architectural industry, examples of sharing.  Guidance to students in courses based tool for BIM software.

name.zh: 文化故事與英語教學應用
name.en: Using Cultural Stories in ESL/EFL Classrooms

description.zh: 為增強ESL/EFL學生的整體的語文能力與跨文化溝通的軟實力，流傳各國的有名故事可採用來作為學生研讀、討論與從事再次創造的素材。這些故事包括人們鍾愛幾世紀的老故事，它們後來幾世代的版本，現代的改寫，與時尚的扭曲變種。依照不同主題被歸納成組(例如：灰姑娘情結，哀怨邪惡的後母，攀龍附鳳的赤貧男子等等)並以多媒體教學方法，藉由閱讀跨文化與跨世代的故事裡強化英語的教與學。
description.en: In both ESL and EFL classrooms, English serves not only as a means to conduct daily communication but also as a media to explore diversified subjects and fields. To build up students’ communicative competence, famous stories and popular tales prove to be resourceful because of their richness in linguistic, cultural, and psychological significance. In this course, multi-cultural stories (including archetypal tales, classic fairy tales, their modern counterparts, and their twisted revisions) are carefully selected and organized according to their main theme. For future teachers taking this course, the instructor will demonstrate how this approach can be actually practiced to best benefit ESL/EFL students. In the practicum section, future teachers are required to try their hands in using these stories.

syllabi.outline:
一. 人類各文化族群都流傳著歷久不衰的故事,有的表現出人類共同的主題、有的呈現本族獨有的特色,在外語教學的現場可用來增進全球視野、學習文化語文差異、以及磨練英語文的全方位的基本能力。老師們如何在教學上運用這些故事?這是本課程要探索的目標。
一.本課程所選擇之研習教材(1)了解當今正在流行的英語小說(或長短篇故事)與其改編的電影,分析該故事與其他世界各地有名故事的關聯,目標是充實碩士生本身的語文程度與跨文化涵養,(2)探索在教學現場如何將這些流行故事的內容轉化為教材與學習活動,以促進學生學習語言文化的興趣與效能.
二. 課程進行內容為(1)教授每周導讀並引介一本(或一套)流行小說,帶領碩士生閱讀原文小說精彩節選並觀賞改編電影精彩片段,(2)教授介紹相關教學法,帶領碩士生演練教材的編寫與教學活動的設計,(3)每位碩士生選擇一本自己喜歡的流行小說,期中考前與期末考前作兩次口頭報告,並在期末報告呈現自己改編的教材.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程無須任何前導知識，且系統性強化同學學術研究的能力，歡迎各系同學及研究生選修。

三個承諾：
1. 同學只要每週準時來上課，絕對不會被當，好好的跟課給分也很甜。
2. 課外不會有過多或太難的作業，也沒有考試，以淨零壓力為目標。
3. 會讓同學確實提升能力，客製化每位同學的學習內容，學你覺得有用的東西。

請同學用學校的Microsoft365登入課程Teams:
帳號: 學號@cc.ntut.edu.tw
密碼: 同入口網站

電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

本課程依循探究式教學的架構，分兩階段進行：

第一階段先簡介工程模擬的概念，引導同學思考自身專業裏需要解決的問題，以及如何以工程模擬輔助問題的解決。每週會分組進行Journal Club的討論，選讀各專業裡工程模擬論文，並批判性思考論文提供資訊的可信度和影響性。最終將會提出一個簡短的報告書，說明個人(組)想要研究的題目，需要使用的模擬軟體，預計要進行的分析和結果。

第二階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。接著就進行各組所決定之特定的模擬軟體，以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。

註、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但同學可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

本課程依循探究式教學的架構，分兩階段進行：

第一階段先簡介工程模擬的概念，引導同學思考自身專業裏需要解決的問題，以及如何以工程模擬輔助問題的解決。每週會分組進行Journal Club的討論，選讀各專業裡工程模擬論文，並批判性思考論文提供資訊的可信度和影響性。最終將會提出一個簡短的報告書，說明個人(組)想要研究的題目，需要使用的模擬軟體，預計要進行的分析和結果。

第二階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。接著就進行各組所決定之特定的模擬軟體，以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。

註、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但同學可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。

數據無處不在。隨著真實世界和數位世界交互影響，越來越多的設計決策有望得到數據分析的支持。本課程旨在培養設計師的數據素養技能。首先介紹對個性化產品和服務的需求，是如何從認知及情感面來創造更好的使用者經驗，並將數據資訊轉換為產品知識/服務設計/系統決策。大部分課堂時間將以研究導向的設計專題方式進行。完成本課程後，您將能夠：

description.en:
Data is everywhere. As the physical and digital worlds have become intertwined, more and more design decisions are expected to be supported by data analytics. Hence, this course aims to build your data literacy skills as a designer. The course will begin by introducing the need for personalized products and services to create a better user experience. This concerns not only the cognitive but also affective aspects. The insights obtained from the data can then be translated to determine product/service/system requirements. Students will spend the majority of the class time on research-oriented projects.
Upon completing this course, you will be able to:
1.Distinguish the difference between mass production and personalization 
2.Gain a better understanding of how data science can be incorporated into the design process 
3.Describe the characteristics and forms of data generated by different sources such as humans, machines, or environments 
4.Apply suitable tools/software to interpre

syllabi.outline:
This course immerses industrial design students in the world of generative AI. Each week, students will explore a different aspect or tool of generative AI, understanding how to integrate artificial intelligence into the design process to create innovative, data-driven solutions. Through hands-on experience, collaborative projects, and peer teaching, students will become adept at leveraging AI for design ideation, development, and execution. By the end of the course, students will have a comprehensive portfolio showcasing their proficiency in using generative AI to push the boundaries of industrial design.

這門課主要探索生成式人工智慧的不同面向和工具對工業設計的影響，透過實際操作和教學觀摩，學生將更深入了解如何將生成式人工智慧整合進設計過程中，創造數據驅動的創新解決方案。

以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

syllabi.outline:
由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.
syllabi.schedule:
Material Chemistry
Allotropes of carbon-fullerene (C60), 1D, 2D, and 3D carbon nanostructure, and graphene. Boron materials: borophene, and borospherene, Metals alloys, delafossite material, zeolites, Microporous, and mesoporous materials: Structure, properties, and application. semiconductors, superconductors, insulators, ceramics, and glass. 
Electrochemistry
Voltammetry: Cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep voltammetry, differential pulse voltammetry, amperometry, chronopotentiometry, oxidations, and reductions. Types of electrode and electrode reactions: Standard Electrode Potentials, Standard Hydrogen Electrode, Calomel electrode, Carbon electrodes, Microelectrodes, Ultra-micro electrodes, Ion-selective electrodes, porous electrodes, Semiconductor electrodes, Hydrodynamic/Rotating disk electrodes. Electrolytes, classification of electrolytes, liquid, solid electrolytes. Reversible, quasi-reversible, and Irreversible electrode processes, Characteristics of commonly used working electrodes such as glassy carbon, pyrolytic graphite, platinum, and reference electrodes. Liquid junction potential, salt bridge, conductometric and potentiometric titrations (acid-base).
Modified electrodes and their application, Electrochemical sensor: Fundamentals of electrochemical sensors, Electrochemical sensor for food and water analysis, Electrochemical DNA sensors. Design of third-generation electrochemical sensors. Electroanalytical chemistry in neuroscience. Electrochemistry sensors of biological molecules like glucose, insulin, and cholesterol. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and their application. Electrochemical quartz crystal microbalance and its applications. Electrochemical cell-redox reaction, electrode potential, EMF. Corrosion: Basics, chemical, and electrochemical principles corrosion, and electrodeposition. Electrochemical CO2 reduction, Electrochemical detection of environmental pollutants.
Electrochemical devices and techniques: Fundamental concepts of electrochemical energy conversion and storage, irreversible systems. Supercapacitors and their working principle. Electrochemical energy systems, lithium batteries, photocathode.  Fuel cells: Electrode materials, fuel cell research. Batteries: Principles of operation of cells and batteries; Electrochemical principles and reactions; Factors affecting battery performance; Battery design; Fundamentals of Primary cells and batteries, secondary batteries, Advanced lead-acid, Ni-based and lithium-ion batteries, next-generation batteries, materials for batteries, batteries electrode preparation, cell assembly, electrochemical performance analysis. Fuel cells: Introduction to fuel cells: working principle, direct methanol fuel cells, proton exchange membrane fuel cells, alkaline fuel cells, phosphoric acid, solid oxide, molten carbonate Fuel cells. 
Debye - Huckel - Onsager Equation, Kinetics- over-potential, Butler Volmer equation, Tafel equation, Nernst equation. Electrochemical cells: Galvanic cell, Daniel cell, Half-cell, Overpotential, Oxidation potential, Reduction potential. The rate of charge transfer, Current density, Ionic equilibria, Electro Kinetic Phenomena, Electrical double layer potential, Zeta potential, electro-osmosis, and sedimentation potential.

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。

description.en: Organic Spectroscopy Special Topics is an essential knowledge for identification of organic molecular structures. It is also a very useful tool for researches on the behavior of organic molecules. This course is aimed to introduce the basic principles and applications of the organic spectroscopy to students. description.en:
This course covers optoelectronics combine with biomolecular of knowledge. We will focus on discussing how the DNA, RNA, protein or cells related with optoelectronic application.
Optoelectronics is the study and application of electronic devices that source, detect and control light, usually considered a subfield of photonics. The light often includes invisible forms of radiation such as gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, which is based on the quantum mechanical effects of light on semiconducting materials. A biomolecule is any organic molecule that is produced by a living organism, including large polymeric molecules such as proteins, polysaccharides, and nucleic acids as well as small molecules such as primary metabolites, secondary metabolites, and natural products. As organic molecules, biomolecules consist primarily of carbon and hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen, and, to a smaller extent, phosphorus and sulfur.

syllabi.outline: The objective of this course is to illustrate the biomedical applications of photoelectric detection instruments.  This course will cover the discussion of the basic principles of optoelectronics and the knowledge of molecular biology (such as the introduction of the basic structure of deoxyribonucleic acid, ribonucleic acid, protein, or cell).

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域製造及物流之應用
name.en: AI Applications in Manufacturing and Logistic

description.zh: 本課程旨在概述人工智慧的應用及其對製造業和物流業的影響。 隨機器學習、深度學習、啟發式演算法和其他人工智能方法的發展，相關新興技術的應用越來越多地被應用於製造和物流行業以提高決策能力。本課程將通過介紹人工智慧的基礎知識和實際應用之案例研究闡述使用人工智慧技術對於產業決策之幫助。學生將深入了解人工智慧技術及其在製造和物流領域如需求預測、生產計劃、調度、質量控製或運輸的潛在應用，課程內容亦將應用ChatGPT做為開發製造物流問題求解方法之輔助工具。通過本課程，學生將了解人工智慧對製造和物流系統之影響及現況，評估使用人工智慧之益處和局限性，並了解人工智慧對於相關產業之改善。
description.en: This course provides an overview of AI application and its impact on manufacturing and logistics. Emerging technologies like machine learning, deep learning, heuristics are being utilized to enhance decision-making capabilities. The course covers the fundamentals of AI, practical case studies, and its benefits. Latest AI technologies and their potential applications in manufacturing and logistics such as demand forecasting, production planning, scheduling, quality control, or transportation will be introduced. ChatGPT will be used as an auxiliary tool for developing problem-solving methods. The course develops the ability to analyze the impact of AI on manufacturing and logistics systems, assess benefits and limitations, and evaluate AI improvement for related industries.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在概述人工智慧的應用及其對製造業和物流業的影響。 隨機器學習、深度學習、啟發式演算法和其他人工智能方法的發展，相關新興技術的應用越來越多地被應用於製造和物流行業以提高決策能力。本課程將通過介紹人工智慧的基礎知識和實際應用之案例研究闡述使用人工智慧技術對於產業決策之幫助。學生將深入了解人工智慧技術及其在製造和物流領域如需求預測、生產計劃、調度、質量控製或運輸的潛在應用，課程內容亦將應用ChatGPT做為開發製造物流問題求解方法之輔助工具。通過本課程，學生將了解人工智慧對製造和物流系統之影響及現況，評估使用人工智慧之益處和局限性，並了解人工智慧對於相關產業之改善。
This course provides an overview of AI application and its impact on manufacturing and logistics. Emerging technologies like machine learning, deep learning, heuristics are being utilized to enhance decision-making capabilities. The course covers the fundamentals of AI, practical case studies, and its benefits. Latest AI technologies and their potential applications in manufacturing and logistics such as demand forecasting, production planning, scheduling, quality control, or transportation will be introduced. ChatGPT will be used as an auxiliary tool for developing problem-solving methods. The course develops the ability to analyze the impact of AI on manufacturing and logistics systems, assess benefits and limitations, and evaluate AI improvement for related industries.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh: 培養學生主動發現問題，或由企業所提出的問題，訓練學生思考如何運用專業知識與技能解決實驗問題。目前針對電子陶瓷相關的產業，對於具有產品的陶瓷製程與性質改良法的專業知識人才，急迫需要，故利用企業命題的問題導向課程方式，訓練學生具有解決產業實際問題與需求的能力。
description.en: Train students to discover problems proactively, or ask questions from companies to train students to think about how to apply professional knowledge and skills to solve experimental problems. At present, for professional knowledge talents with ceramic process and property improvement methods for products, there is an urgent need. Therefore, the problem-oriented curriculum method of the enterprise proposition is used to train students to have the ability to solve practical problems and needs of the industry.

syllabi.outline: 此課程主要是從陶瓷材料的觀點去看陶瓷產業之應用及趨勢。從基礎陶瓷製程實作及物理性質之分析，帶領大三及大四學生進入材料產業之領域，進而認知及領悟材料於產業之關聯，觸發大三及大四學生的學習及研究之動機與動力。

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

syllabi.outline:

This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, geothermal energy, bioenergy, hydrogen and fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The circular economy technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

description.zh: 本課程將延續財務工程導論的內容，將持續在債券與衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題上繼續深入探討；本學期將把焦點放在債券投資的避險、股票衍生性商品與利率衍生性商品的評價與避險上，並利用C(或C++)和Matlab兩種工具來執行樹狀結構，以評價選擇權的價值。
description.en: This course will still focus on the methods for bond and derivatives pricing and hedging, such as the evaluation of stock and bond options. description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

description.zh: 電腦稽核已廣泛的應用在金融交易，企業財務與進銷存流程與資訊系統的各項領域來協助找出瑕疵，降低與防範風險，並能做趨勢預測。本課程的目的將機器學習與人工智慧的技術應用在電腦稽核領域，主題包含: 電腦稽核的流程，大量資料的整理與萃取，監督式與非監督式學習在稽核的應用，資料視覺化技術等。
description.en: Computer auditing has been widely used in financial transactions, enterprise business processes, and information systems, which is to help find flaws and reduce risks, and be able to predict trends. The purpose of this course is to apply machine learning technology in the field of computer auditing. Topics include Computer auditing related processes, the extraction and manipulation of large-scaled data, supervised and unsupervised learning in auditing applications, data visualization technology.

description.zh:
企業常常是網路攻擊的主要目標，這門課程主旨在教育修課學生如何成功防禦常見的網路威脅並且確保自己的金融服務安全運作。
本課程首先提供網絡安全的總體描述，指導同學了解目前面臨網絡威脅風險的一些最重要的服務和技術。熟悉該主題後，您將根據案例研究和現實生活場景探索特定技術和威脅。隨著同學們學習模組的進展，將發現漏洞和錯誤（包括人為風險因素），從而獲得有關最新威脅的專家級視野。然後，同學們將探索有關如何實現資料和基礎架構保護的資訊。在總結模組中，同學們將獲得流程和配置的最新重大更新，以及與基於資訊技術的金融服務中的網絡安全研究和開發相關的重要細節。
在課程最後，同學們將接觸到並對未來資訊安全的技術有初步的了解，以及如何保護未來的金融服務與相關的基礎建設。
同學們將會學到：
?	了解企業所面臨之網路威脅
?	探索如何辨識攻擊者
?	呈現弱點評估、軟體測試、滲透測試
?	使用緩解技術與補救計畫捍衛自己的金融網路
?	實做加解密系統
?	了解人工智慧如何影響網路安全
description.en:
Enterprises have always been a target of cybercrime. This course teaches you how to successfully defend your system against common cyber threats, making sure your financial services are a step ahead in terms of security.
The course begins by providing an overall description of cybersecurity, guiding you through some of the most important services and technologies currently at risk from cyber threats. Once you have familiarized yourself with the topic, you will explore specific technologies and threats based on case studies and real-life scenarios. As you progress through the modules, you will discover vulnerabilities and bugs (including the human risk factor), gaining an expert-level view of the most recent threats. You'll then explore information on how you can achieve data and infrastructure protection. In the concluding modules, you will cover recent and significant updates to procedures and configurations, accompanied by important details related to cybersecurity research and deve

syllabi.outline:
金融產業已經大規模的使用金融科技技術來增加效益與商機，然而背後潛藏的資安問題仍是個棘手的課題，本課程的學習目標將以培養金融產業的資通科技安全架構思維為主，著墨IT基礎設施與應用服務的兩大資安架構主題。課程所包含的範圍如下: 金融資通環境的IT架構與應用，系統與網路IT架構下弱點的入侵與攻擊，網路各層的安全防禦，資通安全設備架構，應用服務的認證與授權，資料與系統的災難回覆，國際資安標準和認證，資安服務開發的安全架構，下一代的資安架構。
Fintech technology has already been used widely in the financial industry to increase cost-effectiveness and business opportunities. However, the hidden information security issues are still a thorny issue. The learning objectives of this course will focus on cultivating the security framework design thinking for IT systems and application for the financial industry , categorized into two major architecture themes of IT infrastructure and application services. The scope of the course is as follows: IT architecture and application of financing environment, penetration and attack of vulnerabilities under system and network IT architecture, Security defense at each layer of the computer network, cybersecurity equipment architecture, authentication and authorization of application services, Data and system disaster recovery, international information security standards and certification, security architecture for information security service development, and next-generation information security architecture.

description.zh:

本課程學習理工科系領域中常用之科學.工程用語以及圖、表、器具、裝置等日文。在暸解文法同時，學習以日文表達科學.工程領域中之特定文體敘述。本課程學習內容約在日本語檢定三級左右。
description.en: Prerequisites: Scientific and technical Japanese I or fundamental Japanese reading ability. Fundamental terminology of science and engineering are explained in Japanese together with expressions of charts, tables, equipment, devices and others. By learning the fundamental Japanese grammar, this lecture provides the framework for understanding the expression of scientific and technical matters in Japanese. The context of this lecture is about level 3 of JLPT.

* Basic HIRAGANA and KATAKANA writing and reading ability.
* Basic Japanese grammar explanation and self-introduction of the personal professional field by Japanese.
* How to explain the scientific and technical by Japanese.
* Search and study of Japanese technical materials, comparative explanation of technical KATAKANA language and English technical language. 
* Explanation of professional engineering field manual and Japanese technical report grammar explanation.

description.en:
This course is designed for graduate students and will provide a solid analytical and practical experience on a variety of aspects in robotics. Topics in the course are as follows.
1.         Spatial descriptions and transformations 
2.         Manipulation kinematics
3.         Inverse manipulator kinematics
4.         Jacobians: velocities and static forces
5.         Manipulator dynamics
6.         Trajectory generation
7.         Control of manipulators
8.         Machine vision
9.         Industrial automation applications
10.      Laboratory work: control of manipulators and mobile robots, automatic manipulation with vision sensors, navigation and control of mobile robots
Senior undergraduate students are allowed to take this course in case they are approved by the instructor.

syllabi.outline:
Advanced Robotics and Automation Applications (ARAA) course is offered only for up to 28 graduate students with programming experience. In addition to lectures on robotic manipulation, ARAA requires oral presentations and reports on robotics papers also focuses on projects with mobile robots and manipulators in the topics of interest related to:

1. Spatial descriptions and transformations  2. Manipulator kinematics  3. Manipulator inverse kinematics  4. Paper presentation and report  5. Project topics: manipulator and mobile robot control, and robot control system based on visual sensing

Course handouts will be available via iStudy web. In addition to homework assignments, a number of quizzes will be taken weekly during lectures. The quiz questions are based on problem sets in the textbook. Each student is required to make an oral presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper preferably related to proposed final project in related topics. All projects must be completed and evaluated in class under supervision of Professor and TA with particular attention to equipment operation safety.

description.zh: 本課程內容分二部分進行授課，第一個部份以小組進行校園建築進行實測後，繪製平、立、剖面圖，以加強學生團隊合作，並透過實際量測與繪製建築平、立、剖面圖，使學生感受實體與練習之關係；由於目前臺灣多以集合住宅建照申請居多，且住宅為空間尺度之根本；因此，第二個部份之課堂操作，依序為浴廁、臥室、廚房、餐廳、客廳單元等不同空間尺度練習後，聚焦於住宅平面圖之練習；接著，透過住宅平面圖之練習，衍伸至立面圖與剖面圖與透視圖練習。課程亦將藉由同學上述二個部分之練習，延續第一學期建築製圖基本常識、觀念與技法之傳授，以確實增進學生建築製圖能力。 本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生對西方(歐洲及西亞)認識歷史建築之演進過程與思考涵構，並使學生具備西方文化歷史與思想的相關知識，其主要授課內容如下：1.在範圍上--自古埃及、西亞、而收至古典建築、基督教建築、中世紀的大教堂時代以至文藝復興及17、18世紀的建築歷史。2.在思想上--自希臘的文化與哲學思想談起，以至各時代之政治、宗教與社會文明之演進，瞭解歷史涵構及其對建築的表現。3.在建築上─針對每一時期的建築表現，瞭解其構造方法、材料應用及相關細部特徵。
description.en: This course is mainly to teach students the evolution process and connotation of historical buildings in the West (Europe and West Asia), and to equip students with relevant knowledge of Western culture, history and thought. The main teaching contents are as follows: 1. In terms of scope-- From ancient Egypt, West Asia, and the collection to classical architecture, Christian architecture, medieval cathedral era, Renaissance and the architectural history of the 17th and 18th centuries. 2. In terms of ideology-from the Greek culture and philosophical thought, to the evolution of politics, religion and social civilization in various eras, understand the historical connotation and its expression on architecture. 3. In architecture—according to the architectural performance of each period, understand its construction method, material application and related detail features.

description.en: This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through collaborative research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

description.zh: 當 Lumiere 兄弟於 1895 年末在巴黎一家咖啡館,舉辦第一場售票的電影放映會時,也正是全球第二次工業革命如火如荼影響人們的生產方式與都市生活之際,透過紀錄當代都市活動與工業化機械美學的短片,他們讓電影技術與城市發展從最初就密不可分,共同作為歌頌現代性的重要媒介。然而,學術界要遲到約莫百年之後,從 1990 年代開始才逐漸形成專門探討電影與城市互動關係的跨學門領域。來自電影研究、都市研究、地理學、歷史學、比較文學、區域研究??等等領域的學者們,於過去三十數年間替電影城市研究貢獻心力。他們不只是藉由電影分析與相關史料爬梳來重新理解現代性、現代主義與當代都市的發展,也同時關注於二次大戰後流行的黑色電影(film noir)如何將當時的都市議題作為其創作主題,後續於 1970 年代起流行的各種近未來反烏托邦電影,又是怎麼進一步藉由預測人類都市的發展來反思當下,創造電影與城市間更為複雜的互文關係。千禧年之後,隨著電影工業與市場的全球化,電影逐漸成為具有都市行銷潛力的大眾媒體,電影場景更逐步發展成一個重要的觀光類型。同時因為電影技術門檻降低與社群媒體的發展,電影也不再只是電影公司或具有天份的獨立電影工作者的遊戲,更多難以分類的影像對都市空間進
description.en: While cinema has been invented over a hundred years and getting influential in shaping people’s perspectives to our environments, the studies of cinematic urbanism have only initiated since 1990s. During the past decades, this interdisciplinary field has developed upon the scholarships of various disciplines, including film and media studies, cultural studies, history, geography, urban studies, etc. This course intends to introduce this still young field through chronologically examining the relationships between cinema and cities, from both being used to celebrate and mediate the modern feelings,to film noir playing a crucial role to criticize and depict urban problems, and to cinematic urban imaginaries boosting tourism and intervening in urban process. Students will learn the theories and methodologies of cinematic urbanism studies, comprehending cinema and different urban spaces as powerful medium that could be manipulated to create, transmit, and perceive certain ideologies.
