name.en: Special Topics on Indoor Environment Quality

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；
2.探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；
3.進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；
4.學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.
Contents :
1. The indoor environment of single type of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.
4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.
5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。
本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生探討基本室內環境品質與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以各種類型的建築室內環境為主題；
2.探討人為環境與人體健康之關係；
3.探討建築材料、構造與設備對室內環境各項因子之影響；
4.學習室內環境品質量測儀器之操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善一般室內環境議題之相關專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is to discuss the relationship between Indoor Environment Quality and human healthy, and make sure our students can realize the knowledge of healthy environment and manage it.
Contents：
1. The indoor environment of different types of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Discuss the influence of the building material, construction and equipment on indoor environment.
4. Learn to use the instrument to measure indoor environment quality.
5. Learn to diagnose and improve indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。

課程內容涵蓋：電力電子元件 (二極體、電感器、電容器、功率開關)、切換式電源轉換原理、電力轉換器 (直流/直流轉換器、交流/直流功率因數校正器、直流/交流換流器)、軟切換技術、控制技術 (脈波寬度調變、頻率調變、電流調變)、迴授電路設計、感測元件介紹、PLECS電腦模擬軟體介紹與應用。
description.en: The applications of power electronics include electric vehicles, lighting, power systems, transportation, etc. The goal of this course is to help students understand the basic principles of power electronics and to integrate the comprehensive applications of electronic, circuit, and electromagnetic disciplines. The course content covers power electronic components (diodes, inductors, capacitors, power switches), switching mode power conversion principles, power converters (DC-DC converters, AC-DC power factor correctors, DC-AC inverters), soft switching technique, control technique (pulse width modulation, frequency modulation, current modulation), feedback circuit design, introduction of sensing components, introduction and application of PLECS computer simulation software.

description.zh: 透過自駕車理論與實務的課程講述，以及搭配業師實作經驗分享，除可以使修課同學對自駕車研究有基本概念之外，也可以藉本堂課引發對新興車輛技術研究領域與其實際應用之興趣。本課程涵蓋內容為自駕車軌跡規劃與控制、先進駕駛輔助控制設計、自駕車感知資料處理及物件偵測演算法、及AI技術應用於自駕車相關功能設計。本課程根據授課主題搭配實驗單元與期末專題，配合使用Matlab/Simulink、CarSim、Python、AI ToolBox等工具軟體，讓修課同學可應用課堂所學來進行自駕車演算法與技術開發，及透過模擬結果分析與驗證。
description.en: This course aims to teach the lessons of autonomous vehicle (AV) theory and practical applications. Moreover, with the experience sharing and cooperative lecturing from industrial experts, students can gain more knowledge about the fundamental concepts of AV research. The course introduces major contents including path planning and tracking control design, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), perception data processing and detection algorithms, and AI-based technologies in the applications of AV. The course will arrange some labs and the term project to provide students, through conducted simulation analysis and verification, with an in-depth understanding of the emerging technology of AV.

description.en: To provide an overview of Vehicle Dynamics and Control Systems of intelligent vehicles in ITS. Students will learn introduction to vehicle dynamics, driver modeling, driving simulation, engine/power-train control, cruise control, traction control/ABS, four-wheel steering, steer-by-wire, active/semi-active suspension, intelligent traffic systems, active safety technologies, and advanced power-train technologies. Upon completion of this course, students should be able to follow the literature on these subjects and perform independent design, research and development work in this field.

syllabi.outline:
本課程結合有機、紡織、化工等相關領域，邀請業師命題目前業界遇到之瓶頸，由授課教師帶領學生進行分組討論，目的在培養學生解決問題與論文期刊選讀之能力，每組學生必須針對專一之問題尋找最近相關的資料。業師命題，由授課老師協助學生資料之準備及練習口頭報告。且一學期至少須報告1次，與期末海報成果展，學期成績將以學生在課堂上參與的態度、報告資料及海報成果展決定。
Organic chemistry, textile, chemical engineering and other related fields are combined in the course. The invited industrial teachers propose the issues which encountered currently in the industry. Then, the teacher leads the students to conduct group discussions. The purpose is to cultivate students' ability to solve problems and read papers and periodicals. The invited industrial teachers provide questions. The teacher will assist student in the preparation of materials and practice oral reports. In addition, at least one report is required during a semester, and the final poster achievement exhibition. The scores will be determined based on the attitude of the students to participate in the classroom, the report materials and the poster achievement exhibition.

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程,其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。
description.en:
1.	熱傳導定律之推導
2.	一維及多維的穩態與暫態熱傳分析，
3.	散熱片之設計，利用數值方法解熱傳導問題，
4.	對流原理之推導
5.	強迫對流方面的分析及應用-層流邊界層，管道內層流熱傳
6.	自然對流方面的分析及應用-管道外與封閉空間內自然對流        熱傳
7.	紊流的基本性，紊流邊界層，管道內紊流
8.	具相變化的熱對流:凝結與沸騰
9.	熱交換器設計介紹
Advanced Heat Transfer  Credit: 3 

Course Outline
1.	Derivation of heat conduction principles 
2.	One and multi-dimentional steady and transient heat         conduction analysis
3.	Heat transfer from extended surfaces, numerical heat         conduction analysis
4.	Derivation of convection principles 
5.	Forced convection - laminar boundary layers and     laminar heat transfer in ducts
6.	Nature convection over external surfaces and in internal enclosures 
7.	Fundamentals of turbulence, turbulent boundary layers, turbulent flow in ducts
8.	Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation
9.	Introduction to heat-exchanger design

name.zh: 民生建設物聯網於綠智與韌性營建
name.en: Infrastructure IoT to Green-Intelligent and Resilient Construction

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR等)於民生基礎建設之因應；擇採相關物聯網數位科技作為課程編排，介紹內容如無線感測、低工耗遠域網路邊緣運算、雲端管理、數位平台、綠能蓄電、人工智能、低/無代碼等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and Innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Internet of Things (IoT) to social infrastructure development including green-intelligent construction/maintenance and resilient adaptation briefly. To aim at the initiate of sustainable development goals (such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR) applied to civil engineering, some vital issues in this course would be focused as follows,
WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network),
Edge Computing, e-Cloud Management, Digitized Platform (PaaS/IaaS/SaaS), Green Energy and Cell, Artificial Intelligences, Low- & No-code techniques, etc.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

description.zh: 土壤沖蝕與保育課程將深入探討土壤侵蝕的種類、原因、影響和防治方法。學生將了解各種類型的土壤侵蝕、導致其發生的因素以及可採用的保護策略，本課程將特別針對水蝕，探討降雨分佈、土壤性質、地形因素及地表植被覆蓋的重要性，以及介紹為促進土壤保育而制定的政策和計畫。經由此課程，學生將了解土壤沖蝕與保育的原理，並將具備在各類環境中制定和實施有效保護策略的知識和技能。此外，本課程將作為本校實現大學社會責任價值的一門課。
description.en: The Soil Erosion and Conservation course delves into the types, causes, impacts, and prevention methods of soil erosion. Students will learn about various types of soil erosion, the factors that lead to their occurrence, and the protective strategies that can be adopted. The course specifically focuses on water erosion, exploring the importance of rainfall distribution, soil properties, topographic factors, and surface vegetation cover. Additionally, policies and programs designed to promote soil conservation will be introduced. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the principles of soil erosion and conservation. They will possess the knowledge and skills necessary to develop and implement effective protective strategies in various environments. Furthermore, this course will serve as a course for our university to realize the core value of university social responsibility (USR).

description.zh: 給水及污水工程介紹自來水及汙水工程及其操作系統所需之原理、設計工具。其主要應用到流體力學、水文學、水處理及相關之設計及計算。主要的議題包含水質參數、地表水及地下水處理、自來水處理過程、汙染物移除、管網設計、汙水處理、生物處理、下水道建設、自來水及下水道操作及維護。
description.en: The Water Supply and Sewerage provides students with engineering principles and tools for designing and operating water and sewerage systems. It facilitates application of knowledge acquired in fluid mechanics, hydrology, water quality, design and computing. Key topics include water quality parameters; groundwater and surface water treatment; water treatment process technologies; nutrient removal; simplified sewerage; decentralised water and sanitation systems; biosolids management; and operation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation infrastructure.

syllabi.outline:
給水與污水工程是土木與環境工程中重要的基礎工程課程。給水工程為自來水工程，從水源取水、導水、淨水到配水，包含一連串的工程技術與方法。污水工程則是將廢污水淨化處理，至符合國家放流水標準後排出的過程。兩者處理對象與目的不同，但其中淨水處理有相似的技術與方法。本課程著重在淨水工程部分，也是兩者的核心技術。而給水工程中的取水與輸配水屬於水利工程，本課程僅簡要介紹。淨水處理包含物理、化學、生物處理技術，根據廢污水特性以及處理目的可選擇不同的淨水方法，或者相互搭配使用以達到效率與成本等要求。本課程將說明各種處理技術的核心理論以及計算，使學生未來具有污水處理設計之能力。
Water supply and wastewater treatment engineering is the core course in the civil and environmental engineering. Water supply engineering includes series technologies from water intake to allocate water to citizens. To determine the place to intake water, to transport water, to purify water and to allocate the clean water are the missions of water supply engineers. Wastewater treatment engineering is to treat wastewater to the required concentration standard. The two engineering have different subjects and different goals. However, the water purification and wastewater treatment has the similar methods, which is the core technology in the two engineering and also the core content in this course. The methods about water withdraw and transportation belong to hydraulic engineering and is briefly introduced in this course. The wastewater treatment methods can be divided to physical, chemical, and biological methods. The use of these methods to achieve legal requirement and minimum cost and high efficiency is the mission of engineers. In this course, the theorem of the treatment methods and the associated calculations will be explained, in order to equip the student to capable of designing wastewater treatment.

name.en: Introduction to Random Vibration and Time-Frequency-Domain Analysis

description.zh: 本門科目主要為介紹隨機震動學基本理論、頻譜分析與小波分析理論。主要的授課內容涵蓋基本統計理論、隨機訊號定義、期望值與相關函數、傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉、功率頻譜密度函數、頻譜分析、非定常訊號判斷、基礎小波分析等。配合結構動力學，本科目亦講授結構系統受到隨機外力作用而產生之結構反應的頻率域動力分析應用及小波分析應用等範例。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce the basics of random vibration, spectral and wavelet analysis. The schedule includes those topics such as fundamental theories of statistics, definition of random signals, expectation and correlation functions, Fourier transform and F.F.T., power spectral density, spectral analysis, non-stationarity judgement, and basic theories of wavelet analysis. To harmony with Dynamics of Structures, this course also introduces examples of dynamic analysis of structural systems excited by random loadings in the frequency domain and applications of wavelet analysis.

syllabi.outline: The subject is designed to include two professional realms – random vibration and time-frequency domain analysis. The fundamentals of random vibration include statistics, correlation analysis, spectrum estimation, spectral analysis of the SDF system, and so on. The time-frequency domain analysis includes the FFT technique, Hilbert Transform, short-time Fourier Transform, and Wavelet analysis, and so on.

description.zh:
數位影像科技的硬體快速進步與影像分析演算法普及化，使得電腦視覺與影像量測技術在工程量測、安全監測，與自動辨識具有相當高的潛力。電腦視覺與影像量測結合影像分析、空間原理、測量原理、誤差分析、機器學習，與工程應用等不同領域，是一個多領域整合的應用科目。

本課程訓練學生在電腦視覺與影像量測的基本理論與案例實作的能力。在理論方面，本課程介紹影像原理、空間量測原理、誤差原理、機器學習，以及國內外的發展現況。在實作方面，本課程利用小型結構實驗室，讓同學自行設定小型結構實驗與量測方法，或進而改良或開發分析程式。配合實驗實作與期末專案研究，本課程培養理論認知、資訊技術、實驗實作能力、外語閱讀能力，與簡報與報告編寫熟練度。
description.en:
The rapid development and population of digital imaging hardware and algorithms bring high potential of computer vision and image measurement on practical applications. These applications can include but not limited to measurement, structural health monitoring, and safety identification. 

This course not only introduces the theory of computer vision and image measurement, but also guides students to operate and implement structural experiments and measurement projects. Students are encouraged to bring up the concepts and theories, programming skills, experimental design and implementation, oral presentations, as well as experimental documentation and technical writing ability.

description.zh: 在現代的工程設計與分析中，普遍應用到相關的電腦模式。儘管大部份工程應用電腦模式均以定率式的物理關係作為基礎，但引用電腦模式進行設計，必須考慮隱含在模式輸入與控制參數的不確定性，及其所產生模式輸出的不確定性。因此，適當的評估模式輸出的不確定性應包含在基本的設計當中。
description.en: In modern engineering designs and analyses, computer models are frequently used. Despite the fact that deterministic relationships are used in most compiterized models for engineering,the model outputs are indeterministic due to the uncertain and stochastic nature of the model inputs and parameters. All the uncertainty may contribute to the stochsticity of the input parameters of a corresponding model which, in turn, result in output uncertainty. Therefore,proper assessment of model outout uncertainty is essential.

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR等)於民生基礎建設之因應；擇採相關物聯網數位科技作為課程編排，介紹內容如無線感測、低工耗遠域網路邊緣運算、雲端管理、數位平台、綠能蓄電、人工智能、低/無代碼等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and Innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Internet of Things (IoT) to social infrastructure development including green-intelligent construction/maintenance and resilient adaptation briefly. To aim at the initiate of sustainable development goals (such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR) applied to civil engineering, some vital issues in this course would be focused as follows,
WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network),
Edge Computing, e-Cloud Management, Digitized Platform (PaaS/IaaS/SaaS), Green Energy and Cell, Artificial Intelligences, Low- & No-code techniques, etc.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

description.zh: 土壤沖蝕與保育課程將深入探討土壤侵蝕的種類、原因、影響和防治方法。學生將了解各種類型的土壤侵蝕、導致其發生的因素以及可採用的保護策略，本課程將特別針對水蝕，探討降雨分佈、土壤性質、地形因素及地表植被覆蓋的重要性，以及介紹為促進土壤保育而制定的政策和計畫。經由此課程，學生將了解土壤沖蝕與保育的原理，並將具備在各類環境中制定和實施有效保護策略的知識和技能。此外，本課程將作為本校實現大學社會責任價值的一門課。
description.en: The Soil Erosion and Conservation course delves into the types, causes, impacts, and prevention methods of soil erosion. Students will learn about various types of soil erosion, the factors that lead to their occurrence, and the protective strategies that can be adopted. The course specifically focuses on water erosion, exploring the importance of rainfall distribution, soil properties, topographic factors, and surface vegetation cover. Additionally, policies and programs designed to promote soil conservation will be introduced. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the principles of soil erosion and conservation. They will possess the knowledge and skills necessary to develop and implement effective protective strategies in various environments. Furthermore, this course will serve as a course for our university to realize the core value of university social responsibility (USR).

description.zh: 工程進度規劃與控制是營建工程進行專案管理時之重要知識與技術，此課程包含ADM 及PDM網圖、要徑分析、PERT分析、趕工計畫、及實獲值分析等理論知識，同時也會結合工程進度控管軟體應用技術。本課程目標意在培養同學具備工程進度規劃與控制觀念知識，並透過專案練習及軟體操作讓同學具備工程進度規劃與控制能力。
description.en: Construction project scheduling and control is necessary and important for effective management of construction projects. The course introduces the major concepts and methods for construction project schedule scheduling and control. The course includes plan and analysis of ADM and PDM networks, analysis of critical paths,, plan for catch-up, introduction of PERT and earned value analysis methods. The course will teach students the major concept and methods of construction project scheduling and control. Furthermore, the course will enhance students abilities and techniques integrated with project practices and project schedule software uses.

description.zh: 水文系統監測主要目的為了解水文過程，其所收集到的水質與水量資料可作為水資源規劃及管理的主要依據。本課程的主要目的為介紹水文系統中所需觀次之項目、監測方法及觀測儀器的原理及使用方法，因此主要的主題包含大氣監測(溫度、濕度、壓力、日照、降水、風速、蒸散、蒸發散)、地表水監測(水位、流速、流量計算、泥沙、率訂曲線)及地下水(土壤濕度、入滲、地下水)。此外，亦將介紹相關的水質監測。
description.en: Hydrological measurements are made to obtain data on hydrological processes. They are essential for the interpretation of quality and quantity data for water resource planning and management. The main topics include: measurement of atmospheric water (temperature, pressure, moisture, precipitation, wind velocity, evaporation, evapotanspiration), measurement of surface water (water stage, flow velocity, discharge computation, sediment, rating curve), and measurement of subsurface water (soil moisture, infiltration, ground water). The water quality monitoring will also introduced in this course.

description.zh: 本課程介紹水文地質的一般原理、概念和分析方法及地下水在實用上的一些問題。主要內容有: 水的來、源分、佈與循環、地下水的賦存、地下水的物理性質及化學成分、地下水運動的基本規律、地下的地質作用、地下水的補給、排泄與徑流、地下水資源概況，與地下水有關的環境問題，地下水與工程開發的工程地質問題，水文地質調查概要等。
description.en: The content of this class includes general principles, concepts of hydrological geology and analyzing methods for practical problem related to this subject. It includes: origin of water, distribution and circulation, reserve of underground water, physical and chemical properties of underground water and the relationship between hydrology and engineering geology.  It also discuss environmental concerns of engineering to the hydrology system.

description.zh:
企業常常是網路攻擊的主要目標，這門課程主旨在教育修課學生如何成功防禦常見的網路威脅並且確保自己的金融服務安全運作。
本課程首先提供網絡安全的總體描述，指導同學了解目前面臨網絡威脅風險的一些最重要的服務和技術。熟悉該主題後，您將根據案例研究和現實生活場景探索特定技術和威脅。隨著同學們學習模組的進展，將發現漏洞和錯誤（包括人為風險因素），從而獲得有關最新威脅的專家級視野。然後，同學們將探索有關如何實現資料和基礎架構保護的資訊。在總結模組中，同學們將獲得流程和配置的最新重大更新，以及與基於資訊技術的金融服務中的網絡安全研究和開發相關的重要細節。
在課程最後，同學們將接觸到並對未來資訊安全的技術有初步的了解，以及如何保護未來的金融服務與相關的基礎建設。
同學們將會學到：
?	了解企業所面臨之網路威脅
?	探索如何辨識攻擊者
?	呈現弱點評估、軟體測試、滲透測試
?	使用緩解技術與補救計畫捍衛自己的金融網路
?	實做加解密系統
?	了解人工智慧如何影響網路安全
description.en:
Enterprises have always been a target of cybercrime. This course teaches you how to successfully defend your system against common cyber threats, making sure your financial services are a step ahead in terms of security.
The course begins by providing an overall description of cybersecurity, guiding you through some of the most important services and technologies currently at risk from cyber threats. Once you have familiarized yourself with the topic, you will explore specific technologies and threats based on case studies and real-life scenarios. As you progress through the modules, you will discover vulnerabilities and bugs (including the human risk factor), gaining an expert-level view of the most recent threats. You'll then explore information on how you can achieve data and infrastructure protection. In the concluding modules, you will cover recent and significant updates to procedures and configurations, accompanied by important details related to cybersecurity research and deve

syllabi.outline:
金融產業已經大規模的使用金融科技技術來增加效益與商機，然而背後潛藏的資安問題仍是個棘手的課題，本課程的學習目標將以培養金融產業的資通科技安全架構思維為主，著墨IT基礎設施與應用服務的兩大資安架構主題。課程所包含的範圍如下: 金融資通環境的IT架構與應用，系統與網路IT架構下弱點的入侵與攻擊，網路各層的安全防禦，資通安全設備架構，應用服務的認證與授權，資料與系統的災難回覆，國際資安標準和認證，資安服務開發的安全架構，下一代的資安架構。
Fintech technology has already been used widely in the financial industry to increase cost-effectiveness and business opportunities. However, the hidden information security issues are still a thorny issue. The learning objectives of this course will focus on cultivating the security framework design thinking for IT systems and application for the financial industry , categorized into two major architecture themes of IT infrastructure and application services. The scope of the course is as follows: IT architecture and application of financing environment, penetration and attack of vulnerabilities under system and network IT architecture, Security defense at each layer of the computer network, cybersecurity equipment architecture, authentication and authorization of application services, Data and system disaster recovery, international information security standards and certification, security architecture for information security service development, and next-generation information security architecture.

description.zh: 本課程介紹資金管理的理論與實務應用。如何判斷一個交易系統好壞，使其不斷產生利潤? 我們將從理論出發，套用在實務交易模擬上，包含單一策略、多商品、多市場、多策略的運用。本課程將以R語言搭配模擬。

We will start from the theory, applied to the simulation of real trading market, including single strategy, multi-commodities, multi-markets, multi-strategies. This course will be run with R language.

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

description.zh: 電化學的領域包羅萬象，舉凡電泳作用與腐蝕現象的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了講述基本的電化學原理外，將著重於電化學分析方法在化學系統研究上的應用。
description.en: The field of electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., electrophoresis and corrosion), devices (electro analytical sensors and batteries), and technologies (the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electrochemical methods to the study of chemical systems.

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.zh: 生物科技產品品質安全與管理法規
name.en: The Introduction to Quality,Safety and Regulation of Biology

description.zh:
生物科技產業已是二十一世紀世界各國的重要產業，我國亦視生技產業為繼電子產業後的新興產業，然而生物科技產業與其他科技產業的差異，在於用於人體或具醫療用途的生技產品，除了品質管理外，更須考慮安全與效能，我國與世界各國對於生技產品大都以建置相當程度的法規環境，以有效的管理生技產品並確保人之安全。因此，對於生技產品特有的管理制度以及安全與效能等特殊需求若無正確的認識，將非常不利產業發展。
本課程將以疫苗、血液製劑、基因工程製劑、診斷試劑、人體細胞組織產品等目前已研發成熟與正發展中的生技產品為例，從產品設計、品質與製程管制、效能與安全評估、法規環境與管理制度到我國管理方式，以深入淺出的方式做完整的介紹，此外，課程中也將針對生技產業面臨的生物安全問題及其需要的設施、生技產業的挑戰與機會等議題，進行充分的講述與討論。透過此課程，期望學生建立在生技產品品質管理、製程管制、安全評估及產品登記等方面的基本概念，以培養生技產業目前極度缺乏的製程規劃人材。
description.en:
In the 21th century, the bio-technological industry has been the important industry in the world.  It is also the most emergent sunrise industry following the electronics industry in Taiwan.  The bio-technological industry is very different from the other technological industries.  The biological products intended for human therapeutic use have to face the needs of safety and efficacy except product quality.  Taiwan government and other countries have established the regulatory framework for biological products to ensure their safety and efficacy.  Therefore, the realization of the management system for biological products is very useful to industry development.
This course uses the examples of vaccines, blood products,  recombinant DNA products, diagnostic devices and human cell and tissue-based products to introduce the design control, quality control, process control, evaluation for safety and efficacy and regulatory framework in Taiwan. syllabi.outline: 由於人口老化、國民所得提高、醫療支出增加與各種流行性傳染病等相關議題，生技相關產業已被世界公認為二十一世紀最具發展潛力之產業。下一波台灣的高科技產業應著重於以發明與創新為主的產業，而生技相關產業正是我國決定要發展之重大新興產業。由於生技相關產業應用範圍廣，附加價值高，故為提升其產業競爭力且加速進入國際市場，國內生技相關產業除了須提升產品品質、加強國際化的管理之外，亦須通過各國所採用的認證制度。此外，政府如何建構一健全完善的法規管理制度，更是生技相關產業發展成功的必要條件。目前國內醫藥產品相關法規，包括藥事法、醫療器材優良製造規範（GMP）及藥品優良製造規範（cGMP）等。由於近年國內外細胞療法之迅速發展，且人體細胞組織物之管理操作與傳統藥品並非完全相同之原因，我國特別訂定人體細胞組織優良操作規範（Good Tissue Practice，GTP），其目的為預防因使用人體細胞組織物而導入、傳播及擴散傳染病，並期望協助機構確保其人體細胞組織物未含有傳染病病原，在製造過程中未受污染，且不致因製造不當而影響人體細胞組織物效用與完整性。

name.zh: 建築與景觀都市主義研究
name.en: Studies in Architecture and Landscape Urbanism

description.zh: 都市主義(Urbanism)最早可追溯於十九世紀末建築工程師對於空間組織與城市關係的討論，其真正的崛起始於二十世紀初對於集中生產，空間組織網絡與政治經濟市民等都市中新興現象的討論。因日趨複雜化的都市發展與環境巨變的挑戰，九十年代開始陸續出現一系列以都市主義為基盤的跨學科整合性討論，而景觀都市主義(Landscape Urbanism, 1997)則在其中扮演相當關鍵的角色。不論是庫哈斯早期在S, M, L, XL (1995)中的批判，或瓦爾德海姆在《都市景觀主義讀本》(2006)中的宣言，皆引指建築、景觀建築、都市設計與都市計畫學門，已逐漸形成一種彼此跨越亦彼此更新的領域狀態。這般跨都市主義架構，使各學門在理論發展與專業實踐上具有更開展性的方法，介入當代與未來的都市環境與城市生活。然而此跨都市主義的學理多在景觀學門的教學範疇內，但在建築專業教育中卻鮮有足夠的涉及與含括。
description.en: The term "urbanism" originated in the late nineteenth century with a focus on spatial organization of the city. The emergence of urbanism in the early twentieth century was associated with the rise of industrial distribution, spatial networks and citizenship etc. in the city. After 90’s, there were a series of new academic terms referring to this idea which created a base for interdisciplinary studies amongst related spatial terrains. Landscape Urbanism is regarded as one of the significant design and planning ethos especially in the twenty-first century.  In Koolhaas’ early work S,M,L,XL(1995)and Waldheim’s representative collection The Landscape Urbanism Reader(2006), they both shared account that architecture, landscape architecture, urban design and planning are moving toward shared form of emerging ‘practice. The body of knowledge about Landscape Urbanism has been largely developed within landscape discipline, yet merely in the architectural discourse especially in Taiwan.

description.zh: 統計數據分析是一種利用數據對遇到問題進行適當推測的藝術(有時是最好)，本課程是一門以微積分為基礎的統計學分析的入門課程，旨在幫助學生學習描述性和推論性的統計程序，以及在不同領域中使用有用的數據分析。在回顧描述性統計和一些必要的概率分佈後，我們將討論區間估計、點估計、假說檢定方差分析、線性回歸分析、因子設計、聚類分析的基本概念、分類和支持向量機，並伴隨著實踐和理論練習。因此這些技能將為學生提供一個基礎，培養學生獨自進行分析和有效評估他人統計分析結果的能力。
description.en: ‘Statistical data analytics’ is the art of using data to make appropriate (sometimes, best!) conjectures about problems encountered. This course is a calculus-based introduction to statistics and data analytics, and so designed to help students learn the introductory descriptive and inferential statistical procedures, and useful data analytics that are used in diverse areas. After a review of descriptive statistics and some necessary probability distributions, we will discuss interval and point estimation, hypothesis tests, ANOVA, linear regression analysis, factorial designs, and basic concept of cluster analysis, classification, and support vector machines accompanying practical and theoretical exercises. Consequently, these skills will provide the student with a basis to conduct their own such analyzes and to evaluate critically others’ uses of statistical analysis results.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python. Python is widely used not only in the engineering but also in natural science, medicine, biology, physics, and business. This course will introduce you to a vibrant and growing community of open source data analysts that is pushing the state of the art in data analysis and presentation. (Another benefit to you as students is that open source software is free!) This course’s main objective is to: learn how to take raw data, explore it, and present the results in a useful way. Thus, in this course, you will learn all of the basic skills needed to do each of these steps with the statistical language Python.

description.zh: 本課程設計的是鏈結AOI與雷射加工產業，與智能廠接軌共同來解決產業實際應產業之問題與需求。設計課程分成三階段，分別為課程講授、業師實作討論、業師實務專題，三階段前後銜接，循序漸進課程讓學全接觸AOI與雷射加工技術。第一部分課程講授主要為基礎之理論傳授，訂立實驗目標、計畫實驗過程、課後評量，予以教學反饋；第二部分實作與討論，採讓學進雷射相關的實驗設計與操作，融會貫通所學理論，培育其實作技能，藉由組與業師討論，練習規劃實驗，實驗安排由簡入深，從認識機台種類系統之光路架設、最終參數的調整等，並藉由組討論記錄表，予以教學回饋；第三部分為企業命題之實務專題，請業師提供產業實務問題，並由產業負責專題內容，讓學了解前業界發展向、業界現況與製程瓶頸等，將理論課程更實務鏈結到雷射應，期末進實務成果發表展與評選，培育其解決實務問題之能。
description.en: The first part of the course, classroom instruction, primarily focuses on imparting foundational theory, setting experimental objectives, planning the experimental process, conducting post-assessments, and providing instructional feedback. The second part involves hands-on practical work and discussions. Students engage in experimental design and operations related to laser technology, integrating the theoretical knowledge acquired earlier. Through group discussions with industry experts, they learn to plan experiments, starting with understanding different types of machinery, optical path configurations, and parameter adjustments. Discussion records are used to provide instructional feedback. The third part consists of practical projects based on industry propositions. name.zh: 鐵道車輛技術與跨領域設計
name.en: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Design for Railway Vehicle

description.zh: 本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將鐵道車輛之工程技術與跨領域設計相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域人文設計之需求，並在人文設計面瞭解工程之規範與要求。本課程內容包括鐵道車輛之系統基本架構、鐵道車輛結構及動態之基本工程分析技術、鐵道車輛車廂之功能性設計、及鐵道人文文化；本課程並配合軌道單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、車輛系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
description.en: This course aims to provide students the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary design for railway vehicles.  Design of railway vehicles should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary cultural design at the same time.  A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of cultural design.  This course covers basic introduction of railway vehicle system, basic analysis of vehicle structures and dynamics, vehicle interior and exterior functional design, and railway culture.  The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of railway vehicles.  This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from Railway Vehicle Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。

syllabi.outline: This course is the deepening and broadening of linear algebra. In terms of deepening the theory, this course starts with the Gaussian elimination method, explaining the four vector spaces. Next, it explains the orthogonality and projection of matrices. In addition, this course explains the determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, powers and exponents of matrices, and spectral decomposition, finally concluding with singular value decomposition, which is the theorem that unifies all the contents in this semester. In terms of broadening applications, this course introduces scientific and engineering applications, such as regression analysis, linear programming, graph theory and networks, and principal component analysis.

本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體生物學及生物物理學？
人體生物學及生物物理學是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。

學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架：
1.根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。
2.展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。

在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程目標：
1.人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。

人體生物學及生物物理學課程的學習評估：
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程實踐體驗：
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！

本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

syllabi.outline:
Engineering problems always involve complicated mathematics. Traditionally, solving mathematical equations requires elaborating process of derivation and induction of formula which require students to spend a long time to learn and master the skills and still not every student can achieve the level of expertise to solve these complicated equations. Moreover, many of these equations are not able to solve analytically. With the advance of computing technologies, an ordinary student, when helped by suitable software, can solve those equations which only gifted students could solve before. Not only that, those equations not solvable analytically can be solved today numerically. The purpose of this course is to train undergraduate students to solve engineering problems by using computers. Students will learn not only the theoretical background of numerical methods but also the popular engineering software MATLAB in this class. The choice of MATLAB instead of programming language like FORTRAN, C, or C++ is because MATLAB not only provides an abundant repertoire of programs for solving all kinds of engineering problems but also is a programming language that students use to create his own programs. This will equip students with a powerful tool no matter for higher study or an engineering career in the future. The contents include the following topics.
1.	Introduction to numerical method and MATLAB: give introductory examples, useful background material, identification of some basic issues and an introduction of computation and programming with MATLAB.
2.	Roots of Equations: deals with finding the zeros of a nonlinear function of one variable, as well as methods for minimization of such a function.
3.	Linear Algebra and Matrices: treat topics from numerical linear algebra. Include solving systems of linear equations, factorization of matrices and matrix inversion.
4.	Curve Fitting: deals with finding an equation that fits a set of points by linear least-square and nonlinear regression. Include polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, general linear least-square regression, QR factorization and the backslash operator, and nonlinear regression.
5.	Interpolation: include Newton interpolation, Lagrange interpolation and splines.
6.	Numerical Integration: give the formula for integrating a function that can not be analytically integrated. Include Newton-Cotes formula, the trapezoidal rule, Simpson’s rule, Romberg integration and Gauss quadrature.
7.	Ordinary Differential Equations: many engineering problems are solved in ODE form. This is always the most difficult parts of numerical methods. This chapter gives the technique for solving ODE. Include Euler’s method, Runge-Kutta method, multi-step method. 
8.	Eigenvalues: gives the technique for finding eigenvalues. Include polynomial method and power method.

syllabi.outline:
Engineering problems always involve complicated mathematics. Traditionally, solving mathematical equations requires elaborating process of derivation and induction of formula which require students to spend a long time to learn and master the skills and still not every student can achieve the level of expertise to solve these complicated equations. Moreover, many of these equations are not able to solve analytically. With the advance of computing technologies, an ordinary student, when helped by suitable software, can solve those equations which only gifted students could solve before. Not only that, those equations not solvable analytically can be solved today numerically. The purpose of this course is to train undergraduate students to solve engineering problems by using computers. Students will learn not only the theoretical background of numerical methods but also the popular engineering software MATLAB in this class. The choice of MATLAB instead of programming language like FORTRAN, C, or C++ is because MATLAB not only provides an abundant repertoire of programs for solving all kinds of engineering problems but also is a programming language that students use to create his own programs. This will equip students with a powerful tool no matter for higher study or an engineering career in the future. The contents include the following topics.
1.	Introduction to numerical method and MATLAB: give introductory examples, useful background material, identification of some basic issues and an introduction of computation and programming with MATLAB.
2.	Roots of Equations: deals with finding the zeros of a nonlinear function of one variable, as well as methods for minimization of such a function.
3.	Linear Algebra and Matrices: treat topics from numerical linear algebra. Include solving systems of linear equations, factorization of matrices and matrix inversion.
4.	Curve Fitting: deals with finding an equation that fits a set of points by linear least-square and nonlinear regression. Include polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, general linear least-square regression, QR factorization and the backslash operator, and nonlinear regression.
5.	Interpolation: include Newton interpolation, Lagrange interpolation and splines.
6.	Numerical Integration: give the formula for integrating a function that can not be analytically integrated. Include Newton-Cotes formula, the trapezoidal rule, Simpson’s rule, Romberg integration and Gauss quadrature.
7.	Ordinary Differential Equations: many engineering problems are solved in ODE form. This is always the most difficult parts of numerical methods. This chapter gives the technique for solving ODE. Include Euler’s method, Runge-Kutta method, multi-step method. 
8.	Eigenvalues: gives the technique for finding eigenvalues. Include polynomial method and power method.

Class website: http://www.aiotlab.org/teaching/oop.html 

Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of "objects", which usually defined as “class” in programming language like C++ and Java. In this class we will introduce the basic concepts of OOP, such as object, class, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Java is the primary language used in the class, but we will also cover OOP in C++. We hope this class will help you understand OOP concepts as well as be ready for developing high-quality software.

description.en: This course contains the medium access control layer(MAC) and physical layer(PHY) of the mose recent IEEE 802.11 standards for wireless local area networks. Thechniques employed by the standards, e.g.,craier sense multiple access/collision avoidance (CSMA/CA),orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDA), will be discussed in details.

syllabi.outline: The standards of WLANs, including IEEE 802.11a, IEEE 802.11g, and IEEE 802.11e are discussed. Both MAC layer and PHY layer techniques are covered. Topics include access technology, framed format, network management, channel coding, and OFDM modulation.

description.zh:
在過去的60年裡，生物醫學工程學科發展已成為明確的，多樣化的，內容無所不包的領域；包括生物電現象、生物信息學、生物材料、生物力學、生物儀器、生物傳感器、生物信號處理等領域，以及生物技術、計算生物學和複雜多樣性、基因組學、醫學影像學、光學和雷射激光、輻射影像、組織工程等。
本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體生物學及生物物理學？
人體生物學及生物物理學是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。

學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架：
1.根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。
2.展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。

在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程目標：
1.人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。

人體生物學及生物物理學課程的學習評估：
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  

人體生物學及生物物理學的課程實踐體驗：
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！

本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

description.zh: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

syllabi.outline:
通過“職場英文溝通”這門課，強化英文單字能力，熟記字彙片語。除了拼寫及發音外，協助學生用單字片語造句。熟悉會話容後，學生做角色扮演活動或課堂討論，增加師生互動機會。教師在課堂上指導學生分組搜集傳統產業現況，將實際職場情況融入于課堂學習。

嘗試從商業溝通角度，探討個人如何從溝通角度建造職場人完整的競爭籌碼，以溝通力創造個人職場價值與優勢，協助個人在職場不同色扮演中，培養受人信任，溝通無礙的職場性格，建立屬於自己的職場口碑與競爭力。溝通是所有人與人之間互動與建立關係的基礎。商業溝通是職場成功的黃金武器；優質的溝通能力是職場人邁向成功舞臺的關鍵能力。

Through the course of "Communication in English in the Workplace", strengthen the ability of English words and memorize vocabulary and phrases. In addition to spelling and pronunciation, help students make sentences with single-word phrases. After being familiar with the content of the conversation, students can do role-playing activities or classroom discussions to increase opportunities for teacher-student interaction. Teachers guide students in groups to collect the current situation of traditional industries and integrate actual workplace situations into classroom learning.
From the perspective of business communication, try to explore how individuals can build a complete competitive bargaining chip in the workplace from the perspective of communication, create personal value and advantages in the workplace with communication skills, and assist individuals in different role-playing in the workplace to develop a workplace character that is trustworthy and has no barriers to communication. Establish your own workplace reputation and competitiveness. Communication is the foundation of all human interactions and relationships. Business communication is the golden weapon for success in the workplace; high-quality communication skills are the key to success in the workplace.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

syllabi.outline: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
syllabi.schedule:
Week One: Unit 6: Does Advertising Help or Harm us? 
1.	Explication of related vocabulary (131)
2.	Reading I: p113-118
3.	Questions and Answers from the text 
Week Two: 
1.	Reading Part II: p119-127
2.	Grammar and Rhetoric (127: Compound sentence)
3.	Group assignment(s): Research information connected to this topic in verbal form 
Week Three:
1.	Group Presentations (Shared paper)
2.	Questions and Answers
3.	Summation(s) 
Week Four: 
		   Unit Seven: Why Do People Take Risks?
1.	Related Vocabulary and Thesis of statement (135-6)
2.	Reading I: P127-8
3.	Test Students’ comprehension (Can students detect the main idea of this article and point out the supporting ideas here?) 
Week Five:
		  Unit Seven: To be continued
1.	Reading II: P140-144
2.	Grammar Analysis (Shifts between past and present) 
3.	Group Assignment: Research related topics and share 
Week Six: 
1.	Group presentations 
2.	Interactions and responses 
3.	Summations 
Week Seven:
		Unit Eight: How Can We Make Cities Better Places to Live 
1.	Questions discussed in advance
2.	Possible vocabulary that flashes through students’ mind (collective brainstorming)
3.	Reading I: p157-160 (analysis of texts and thesis statement/supporting ideas)
Week Eight: 
1.	Reading II: 164-166
2.	Grammar and Rhetoric (Particles as Adjectives) 
3.	Group Research
Week Nine: 
1.	Group presentations
2.	Questions and answers 
3.	Summations 
Week Ten: 
1.	Outside Readings (adapted from monthly magazine, Ivory)
2.	Analysis—What is the thesis statement here? How many ideas does the writer bring up to support? 
Week Eleven: 
	 Unit Nine: How Can A Small Amount of Money Make a big Difference?
1.	Motivation of this article
2.	Thesis statement and supporting ideas 
3.	Reading I: 181-184
4.	Related Vocabulary and Idioms/Phrases 
Week Twelve 
1.	Reading II: p186-190; 194-5
2.	What are the Main Ideas?
Week Thirteen
1.	Students’ Research: Share 
2.	Collective Discussions 
3.	Summations 
Week Fourteen 
	Unit Ten: Do People Communicate Better Now Than in the Past?
1.	Reading I: 203-7
2.	What is the thesis statement? What are the supporting ideas?
3.	What are the related words that pop up in your mind? 
Week Sixteen 
1.	Reading II: 211-214
2.	Main Ideas
3.	Grammar and Rhetoric (Sentence Fragments)
syllabi.materials: LiveABC多益教材
syllabi.consultation: Contact me via email:richardlovebear@hotmail.com LineID:0930754638
syllabi.notes: 由於配合三教教室修繕事宜,因此課程於第十七週與十八週採取線上教學形式

description.zh: 本課程目的在增進學生英文學術寫作與口語簡報及討論能力，以適應全英語授課環境，內容包括多元化的學術寫作與口說練習活動，並由各類文本中分析並熟練英文句型結構及段落結構；亦包含簡報製作、內容架構以及實用線上資源應用等內容，以增強學生學術英文表達技巧。

Students will also learn the structure, vocabulary, as well as strategies of delivering a successful presentation for academic purposes.

description.zh: 設計與生活是自古以來就相生相隨的一項行為，生活型態的變化，對生活器具的要求也就不同。故本課程主要在探討研究設計行為與生活型態之關係，進而提供新思維作為設計行為之參考。
description.en: Design is a part of human life. Demands in design changes with lifestyle. This course focuses on general review of lifestyle research that is practically constructive in the process of product planning and design.

syllabi.outline:
Scholars from disciplines such as sociology, economics, literature, drama, and design have offered diverse critiques of lifestyles from various perspectives, including individuality, social roles, consumer behavior, experiences, life satisfaction, and values. This course aims to shift students' focus toward the user context and employ different research methods to study three common integrative elements of lifestyle: cognition, behavior, and context. The course introduces persuasive design and behavior design patterns across different lifestyle scenarios by applying creative, reorganizing, and additive design techniques. The design theme focuses on creating products (both physical and digital) that 'change lifestyles' to achieve Sustainable Development Goals, while also reflecting on the technical difficulties and ethical challenges of applying design to behavior change.
Starting from 'lifestyles', this course focuses on considering different lifestyles/groups to design objects under a 'research-driven design' process to change behaviors while avoiding design pitfalls.
Students will learn to:
1. Understand the various aspects of lifestyles.
2. Consider the diversity of groups.
3. Apply several common design research methods in practice.
4. Acquire a wide range of professional design terminology.
5. Grasp the techniques and ethical considerations for persuasive design in behavior change.
6. Aim for sustainable development through design objectives.

社會學、經濟學、文學、戲劇、設計等學科的學者都從不同的角度對生活型態做出了不同的評論，如個人、社會角色、消費行為、經驗、生活幸福、價值觀等。本課程試圖將學生的眼光拉到使用者的情境，並利用不同的調查方法，研究生活型態的三個常見的整合元素：認知、行為與情境。以創造、重組與附加的不同設計手法，在不同生活型態的場景中，導入說服設計與行為設計模式。設計主題為設計「改變生活型態」以達到永續發展目標的設計成品（不限實體或數位）。同時，也反思設計應用於行為改變的技術困難與道德挑戰。
以「生活型態」出發，考慮不同生活型態/族群，在「研究驅動設計」流程下設計出目的在於改變行為的設計物並避設計陷阱。

學生將學會：
1. 理解生活型態的不同面向
2. 考量群體的多樣性
3. 實務中常應用之數種設計研究方法
4. 習得設計領域多種面向的設計專業用語
5. 說服性設計行為改變的技術與道德思考
6. 永續發展的設計目標

金屬鑄造( metal casting )可定義為:以適當材料作成鑄模,該鑄模內具有和鑄件相同形狀及相當尺寸之模穴,再將熔融金屬澆入模穴中, 待其凝固得到鑄件的方法。本課程內容:
    (1)概論。(2)主要鑄造材料。(3)鑄造用模型。(4)砂模鑄造。(5)砂心製造。(6)鑄造金屬之熔化及澆鑄。(7)特殊鑄造法。(8)鑄件清理、檢驗及鑄疵分析。(9)精密鑄造法。
     Metal casting can be defined as: making a mold with appropriate materials, the mold has a mold cavity with the same shape and size as the casting, and then pouring molten metal into the mold cavity, and waiting for it to solidify to obtain a casting.Contents of this course:(1)Introduction. (2) Main casting materials. (3) Models for casting.(4) Sand mold casting. (5) Sand core manufacturing.(6) Melting and casting of cast metal. (7) Special casting method.(8) Casting cleaning, inspection and casting defect analysis.
(9) Precision casting method.

name.zh: 設計學研究方法與實踐策略
name.en: Design Science Research Methods & Practical Strategies

description.zh:
設計科學研究重視創造與解決現實世界問題相關且實用的成品或服務。目標是開發具有實用價值並可在實務中實施的解決方案或進一步進行設計驗證。課堂進行方式，除了方法講解，將於課堂採用方法卡與結構化的課堂互動模式，深化學生對設計學在學術研究方法的認識與應用。學生將學會：
1.理解設計學的範疇與趨勢
2.理解如何擬定研究命題與設計研究方法
3.理解量化與質性研究方法
4.理解研究結果的詮釋與視覺化
5.擬定研究命題、研究框架、研究流程與方法
description.en:
Design science research values the creation of finished products or service that are relevant and useful in solving real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions that have practical value and can be implemented in practice or for further design verification. In addition to method explanations, method cards and a structured classroom interaction mode will be used in class to deepen students' understanding and application of design methods in academic research. Students will learn:
1.Understand the scope and trends of design
2.Understand how to formulate research propositions and design research methods
3.Understand quantitative and qualitative research methods
4.Understand the interpretation and visualization of research results
5.Formulate research propositions, research framework, research processes and methods

syllabi.outline:
Course Overview:
This course aims to familiarize students with research methods in the design field, balancing academic outputs with practical applications. Students will understand current research trends through the latest literature produced under the concept of research-driven design. The course will gradually guide students to become proficient in research methods.

Course Objectives:
Design science research emphasizes creating and solving practical, real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions with practical value that can be implemented in practice or to validate designs further. 

Students will learn to:
* Understand the scope and trends of design science.
* Comprehend how to formulate research propositions and design research methods.
* Grasp quantitative and qualitative research methods.
* Interpret and visualize research findings.
* Formulate research propositions, frameworks, processes, and methods.

description.zh: 結晶學已經是成為當今科學研究領域的一門重要知識與技術。至目前為止至少有20位諾貝爾獎得主其貢獻都與結晶學有關。在這課程，我們將闡述結晶學的相關基本知識，例如: 晶格、對稱、原子散射、結構因子及解結構。此外，這門課程也將涵蓋實際操作解結構。所有基礎知識與實作，涵蓋單晶繞射與粉末繞射。也將涵蓋部分蛋白質結晶學的基本知識。
description.en: Crystallography has become an important field in scientific knowledge and technique in physics, chemistry, materials, and biology, which has been recognized by more than 20 winners of Nobel prize. In this course, we will illustrate the fundamental knowledge about crystal lattice, symmetry, atomic scattering, structure factor, and structure determination. In addition, the course also includes practices in structure determination by single crystal x-ray diffraction and powder x-ray diffraction. All fundamental knowledge and practices are mainly in small molecular cases, but part of knowledge of protein crystallography will also be included.

description.zh: 固態化學是一門涵蓋物理、化學、與材料的跨領域科學。在此課程，我們將講述如何應用化學的知識與概念來了解固態材料，這包含晶體結構，化學鍵結、繞射、光譜、與熱分析技術。此外，我們也將用物理化學的觀念，來討論固態材料的光、電與磁的特性。
description.en: Solid state chemistry is a multidisciplinary filed which covers the physics, chemistry and material science. In this course, we will illustrate how to use chemistry knowledge to approach the solid state materials, which includes the crystal structure, chemical bonding, diffraction techniques, spectroscopy, and thermal analysis. Moreover, the electrical, magnetic and optical properties of solid state materials will also be discussed by the point of view of physical chemistry.

syllabi.outline:
Nanomaterials are materials with a single unit small sized between 1 and 100 nm.  They have unique optical, electronic, thermo-physical or mechanical properties. Since some nanomaterials have properties of enzyme-like characteristics.They are artificial enzyme, which can be used for many applications in such as biosensing, bioimaging, tumor diagnosis and so on.  We will also discuss about the safety issues, regulation and public percpetin on nanomaterials. 
Students are expected to learn the types, the basic theory, unique properties of nanomaterials, the syntehsis and characterization of nanomaterials. This class is for upper level undergraduate students, with interested on material science and nanotechnology.

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc.  It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc. Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

syllabi.outline:
With the aging population trend, healthcare-related industries are already witnessing significant growth, and biomedical engineering plays a crucial role in this expanding market.

Biomedical engineering is an interdisciplinary field that leverages various engineering knowledge and technologies to contribute to biological research. Its primary goal is to provide information beneficial for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases in medicine.

Within the broad category of biomedical engineering, our focus will be on the field of medical electrical engineering, particularly in laser medicine. This specialization aims to offer information that aids in diagnosis and assists in the treatment and prevention of diseases.

Laser technology, recognized as one of the three great inventions of the 20th century, has found widespread applications in various medical fields. This course will delve into the following topics:

1. Basic principles of laser
2. Diverse applications of laser in medicine
3. Laser applications in dentistry
4. PBM PhotoBioModulation applications in Medicine and Dentistry
5. Advanced thesis writing in laser medicine

Join us to explore the cutting-edge advancements and applications of laser technology in the medical field.

syllabi.outline:
工業4.0智能工廠因為大量使用電腦資訊流進行智慧控制達到產線無人化境地，雲端資料庫技術是智能工廠的核心技術，從智慧排單到網頁控制，達到智能聯網與控制。本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠連線。
Industry 4.0 intelligent factory because of the heavy use of computer information flow for intelligent control to achieve the production line unmanned situation, cloud database technology is the core technology of intelligent factory, from smart single to web control, to achieve intelligent networking and control. This course to the landing industry application technology-based, imported into the German University of Technology task-oriented learning model, the course teaches students from the construction of a cloud database server to write a three-machine integrated web control program for factory CPS production and marketing information management system, series factory man-machine materials and production lines and quality control, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, factory-wide factory connection.

description.en: It is a fundamental course concerning the theories of robotic manipulators. Topics contain frame transformations, manipulator kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, manipulator design, control of manipulators, robot programming languages.

syllabi.outline: This course will teach students kinematic analysis methods, trajectory motion technologies, dynamic analysis methods, and force control methods for manipulators and robot arms. It will enable students to perform robotics research and develop applications in the future. This course first introduces the architectures and industrial applications of various fix-based manipulators and robot arms. Subsequently, this course will cover detailed methods and technologies including kinematic analysis, path and trajectory planning, dynamic analysis, and control design and analysis.

description.zh: 彈性力學為固體力學的重要分支，研究彈性物體在外力和其他外界因素（包括外力、溫度、電磁場等）作用下產生的變形和內力。彈性力學廣泛應用於建築、機械、化工、航太等工程領域，是學習有限元素法、複合材料力學、破裂力學和疲勞等的基礎課程，對於培養學生的專業基礎，思維方法和獨立工作能力有著重要意義。
description.en: Elasticity is a branch of Solid mechanics that deals with determination of the stress, strain, and displacement distribution in an elastic solid under the influence of external forces. This subject has applications in many engineering and scientific fields such as civil engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, and aeronautical and aerospace engineering. The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

The course contents will include topics on computer aided design and draft including the creation of 3D solid model, computer simulation, Optimization technique, and finite element analysis techniques

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

syllabi.outline: Granular material flows are commonly occurred in many industrial applications and nature hazards, such as fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, and debris avalanche. To provide a comprehensive understanding for granular materials flows, this course will be divided into three parts. We start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials and its rheological models. Then, we will move to the simulation approaches for granular material flows in view of continuum and discrete description. Finally, the two-phase suspension system will be introduced, followed by the demonstration of practical industrial and geophysical applications for these complex flows.

17. Final Examination

description.zh: 課程目標在於教授 CG 軟體於多媒體產業上的應用， 並使學生具備建置素材庫 (Game-Ready Models)之能力。透過專案式教學,讓學生了解建模、材質、綁定、渲染的進階應用及銜接遊戲引擎的工作流程，並搭配Unity Animator、UML、C#， 去完善模型素材在遊戲引擎中的控制呈現，讓學生具備銜接設計端與程式端的技術，並為後續客製化虛擬實境應用的素材做出準備。  CG 軟體教學將著重在視覺化程式工具的使用, 讓學生利用程式思維、節點編程加速專案的進行；程式教學部分將使用Unity Animator、C#以完成遊戲Assets的設置。最終評量將以期末的專案呈現為主要評分方式。
description.en:
The course objective is to teach the application of CG software in the multimedia industry and equip students with the ability to build a material library (Game-Ready Models). Through project-based learning, students will understand advanced modeling, texturing, rigging, rendering, and the workflow of integrating with game engines. Together with Unity Animator, UML, and C#, they will refine the control and presentation of model materials in game engines, enabling students to connect design and programming skills and prepare for customizing virtual reality applications.
The CG software instruction will focus on the use of visual programming tools, enabling students to accelerate project progress using programming thinking and node programming. The programming instruction will use Unity Animator and C# to configure game assets. The final assessment will primarily be based on the presentation of the end-of-term project.

syllabi.outline:
課程目標為教授動畫與遊戲引擎軟體(Unreal)於多媒體產業上的應用，並使學生具備建置素材庫 (Game-Ready Models)之能力，內容包含美術設計與程式的建置。
  透過專案式教學，讓學生了解建模、材質、綁定的進階應用及銜接遊戲引擎的工作流程，並搭配Unreal Blue Print、State Machine、 State Tree、HLSL Code 等等程式工具的使用，完善素材在遊戲引擎中的控制呈現，讓學生具備銜接設計端與程式端的技術。
  期末以產出一件簡單的遊戲專案為目標，並以此為主要評分方式。 

The course aims to teach the application of animation and game engine software in the multimedia industry, and to equip students with the ability to build a repository of Game-Ready Models. The content includes the construction of artistic design and programming.
Through project-based learning, students will understand advanced applications of modeling, texturing, and binding, as well as the workflow for integrating game engines. They will also utilize programming tools such as Unreal Blue Print, State Machine, State Tree, and HLSL Code to enhance the control and presentation of models in the game engine, enabling students to have the technical skills to connect the design and programming aspects. The final goal is to produce a simple game project, which will be the primary evaluation method.

description.zh: 智慧製造意旨透過資通訊及數位技術（例如數位控制、智慧機器人、自動光學檢測、雲端運算、人工智慧與物聯網等）的輔助，讓生產系統更具智慧，減少生產成本、提升產品品質與增加客戶滿意。本課程透過問題導向學習(PBL)方法，引導學生學習關於智慧製造之核心技術。
description.en: English description：The objective of smart manufacturing is to reduce manufacturing cost using information and communication technology, including digital control, industrial Robotics, automated inspection, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and internet of thing (IOT). description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式(如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技)的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

description.zh: 本課程介紹複合材料的原理，包括複合材料的高分子化學、複合材料的加工方法、複合材料的力學分析與設計、以及複合材料在高科技上的應用。加工方法包括真空袋成型法、壓力釜成形法、樹脂移送成型、編織法、纏繞成形法、拉擠成型法、模壓法…等，本課程詳述這些加工方法的原理及應用，同時介紹力學分析及設計，應力和應變之關係，複材之彎曲、靜態和動態之強度、脫層、耐久性、及以力學觀點設計複合材料，最後討論複合材料如何應用於高科技及民生工業上。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the principle and potential application of composite materials. It includes polymer chemistry, design and analysis of composite, and processing methods. The composite processings include autoclaves,vacuum vags, resin transform molding, braiding, filament winding, pultrusions, sheet molding compound,…etc. The principles and application of the methods will be elucidated. The analysis and design, strain-stress relationships, extension and bending, static and dynamic strengths, and delamination, will also be discussed. Finally, the potential application of the composite in high-tech industries will be elucidated.

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

syllabi.outline:
學術英語
本課程專為本科生設計，旨在培養他們的學術英語語言技能，以便在英語授課的大學課程中取得成功。 本課程將讓學生積極參與在現實生活中的學術大學講座和專業工作場所環境中遇到的各種學術聽、讀、寫和口語活動。 本學期的主題是體育與文化。

English for Academic Purposes
This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.  The theme of this semester is Sport and Culture.

description.en:
This class starts from the review of random process and mainly provides an introduction to information theory. The following is a rough description of the material covered in this class.

    (1) Entropy, Relative Entropy, and Mutual information

    (2) Asymptotic equipartition theorem

    (3) Entropy rates of stochastic processes

    (4) Data compression (Huffman coding, Shannon codes, Kraft

inequality, etc.)

    (5) Information theory and gambling

    (6) Channel Capacity

    (7) Differential entropy

    (8) Gaussian Channels

syllabi.outline: This course aims to study basic and advanced topics in information theory. The course focuses on the concept of information theory,  including entropy, source coding, channel capacity, rate distortion theory, and differential entropy, ...etc. The calculation of channel capacity and rate distortion will be used as computer projects for real implementation. Advanced topics will further cover Gaussian channel and some coding theory.

description.zh: 係利用物理機械整理及化學處理方式，改善紡織品之吸引性、服務性和最終用途之機能性。整理加工技術包括結構穩定性(諸如壓縮、煮呢、蒸呢、熱定型)；表面特性改質(諸如平滑性、粗糙性、光澤性及其他美觀性質)與功能性改質(諸如防縐、防縮、防火、防污、防水、防微生物與昆蟲、耐光、耐冷熱、耐污染質及化學藥劑、耐氣候、耐摩擦、抗起球、抗靜電)。
description.en: The attractiveness, serriceability and end-use performance of textiles are imporved by the application of physical mechanical and chemical processes.  Finishing techniques include dismensional stabilization(such as, sanforization, crabbing, decatizing, heat-setting),modification of surface characteristics(such as, smoothness, roughness, luster, other esthetic fabric qualities) and functional property modification (such as, resistance to wrinkle shrinkage, fire, soils and stains, water, microorganisms and insect, light, heat and cold, air pollutants and chemical agents, weathering, abrasion, pilling and static change).

description.zh: 本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本、小說、電影來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒被世俗蒙塵的沉睡心靈，以重返純真的赤子心境。 教學方式以互動為主，期待藉由討論兒童文學名著，閱讀相關論文，來帶領同學進入兒童文學的殿堂。 除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教導同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。希望透過作品的完成，來喚起學生的創作興趣，並建立學生創作的信心。
description.en: This course will lead the students to read the poems, picture books, novels and films of children literature, and hope to find out the beauty of the children's world. Wish in this way can help the sleeping soul to wake up, and return to pure childhood state. This course will try to lead the classmates to appreciate the children's literature by discussing and questioning the masterpieces, hope in this happy way to help the students to get enter the children's literature. Besides reading and discussing, the course will also teach students how to write. The content of writing course would include the poem and the story which would ask the students to finish the work by themselves. Hope through the works, can arouse students' creation interest, and build up students' confidence of creation.

syllabi.notes:
本課程會讓學生創作關於環境永續的繪本，會涉及到聯合國可持續發展目標（Sustainable Development Goals, SDGs）的面向如下：

1. 目標 4 - 優質教育：通過創意和環境省思的教學方式，促進學生的全面發展，這正是實現優質教育的關鍵。

2. 目標 11 - 可持續城市與社區：由於繪本中會探討如何建立更綠色、更可持續的城市和社區，來提高生活質量並減少環境影響，是以符合此面向。

3. 目標 12 - 負責任消費與生產：繪本創作可以包含關於減少浪費、可持續消費和生產的信息，教育學生如何做出更環保的選擇。

4. 目標 13 - 氣候行動：關注氣候變化及其影響，並通過繪本來提高學生對這一全球性議題的認識。

5. 目標 15 - 陸地生物多樣性：繪本可以展示如何保護生態系統和生物多樣性，強調保護自然環境的重要性。

description.zh: 蛋白質與醣類科學課程是為進階研究所學生所設計的。這堂課的目標是在教導學生蛋白質科學和醣類科學最近的發展，以具體應用在醫療和生物科技產業為例子。學生必需要先修以下的課程： 一般有機化學， 生化， 蛋白質結構和醣質科學基礎科學。學生將預計學習蛋白質與醣類之結構， 蛋白質與醣類之生物合成，相關之具生物活性之醫療和生物科技蛋白質和多醣類。
description.en: The course is designed to teach upper level graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specific application in medical and biotechnological industries. The prerequisite classes for this course are: general organic chemistry, biochemistry, protein structure and glycobiology. Students are expected to learn the structure, biosynthesis, chemistry and cell biology in related to bioactive protein and glycconjugates.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹微生物及其應用，學生將可習得何謂微生物，微生物如何運作，以及微生物的應用。課程內容包括: (1)微生物的分類、型態、結構及一般特性; (2)微生物的生長與控制; (3)微生物的生理與代謝; (4)微生物的應用，例如生物轉換、一次及二次代謝產物的生產、基因重組蛋白的生產、核酸藥物的生產等。
description.en: The objective of the course is to introduce the major concepts, principles and applications of microbiology. Students will learn about what microorganisms are, how they function, and their industrial applications. The course include the following topics: (1) Classification and structures; (2) Microbial growth and control; (3) Microbial physiology and metabolism; (4) Applications, such as biotransformation, production of primary and secondary metabolites, production of recombinant proteins, etc.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

name.en: ESP(Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) II

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調電資專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Electrical Engineering and Computer Science students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.en: The Principles and Applications of Machine Vision

description.zh: 機器視覺檢測乃結合光學設備 ` 影像處理 ` 與電腦輔助計算處理 , 藉由擷取受測物影像之特徵進行後續各種應用(如檢測 ` 辯識等)。 為確保機器視覺應用之精確度及速度,受測物影像必須依用途進行不同前處理以突顯特徵 , 後以不同之演算法則判斷之擷取特徵是否符合應用要求。 機器視覺近年來大量使用於各產業,除提昇製造業之產品品質外,對人身安全認證之生物科技亦功不可沒 。
description.en: Machine vision has been extensively used in inspection and biometrics in recent years. This course provides the fundamentals and practical applications of machine vision for graduate students. Increasing the knowledge and capability in machine vision for a well-trained industrial engineer is the final goal of this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為程式語言之延伸，主要以python為程式語言，學習以下之相關主題
1. CPU 及 GPU-based DIP(影像處理)  - CV2 及 Kornia: 為PyTorch之延伸 ，主要介紹: Image Load/Save/Display、enhancement、Filtering、Edge detection、Morphology、Warp * Geometry Transformation、Color、Segmentation、Data augmentation等

2. 深度學習: 以PyTorch、TorchVision為主，介紹基本Torch語法，再深入介紹CNN網路架構 (LeNet、ResNet、DenseNet、EfficientNet)，Object Detection網路 (FRCNN、Mask RCNN、Yolo)、AutoEncoder、UNet(Semantic Segmentation)、Anomaly Detection、GAN等應用 (視課程進度)

主要工作包括：課堂作業、期末考、期末競賽 (Project)、Paper Reading

description.zh: 本課程將透過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性是如何與文化傳統同步或是超出文化傳承。本課程將介紹及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件、議題和趨勢，旨在培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en: This course examines the social and political dynamics of contemporary culture by reading a variety of texts, including news articles, editorials, reports, and research papers. Students will be guided to observe, analyze and understand the complexity and ambiguity of how contemporary / popular cultural phenomena may move in lockstep with the cultural traditions or fall out of sync in the cultural continuity. The course introduces plenty of fascinating culture stories, event, issues and trends to be studied, aiming to develop students’ critical analysis ability and cultural literacy.

This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Global Issues and Trends
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Spring 2024
Course Description: 	This course aims to prepare students for collaborative participation in global activities by exploring global topics, issues and critical agenda of actions. In the process of cultivating engaged global citizens, the utmost task is to advance students’ understanding and critical evaluation of compelling evidence to apprehend the nature as well as complexity of issues and trend. With panoramic views of global agendas, comprehensive reviews of research studies, and social, cultural, political and economic assessments, global learning underscores collective awareness and brings in an analytical approach with emphasis on individuals’ global accountability, interconnectedness, and rigorous actions. More importantly, this current course provides the opportunity for students to be familiarized with the narrative / discourse style, language use and data description that will support their future pursuit for a global career. Reports adopted are available at major news outlets, research institutions and organizations.
