syllabi.assessment:
Course Requirements: 	Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time (See Grading Policy)
(2)	Presentations and discussions 
i.	Students (w/ or w/o partners) can volunteer and/or will be conveniently selected to present on issues and topics through the infographics provided in reports with fully-elaborated explanations and analyses on data / concept exhibits. 
ii.	Students who prepare to give a presentation need to post handouts / study notes on Google Classroom a day before the scheduled presentation. 
iii.	Students are obligated to participate in class discussion by Q&A.
(3)	Quizzes will be administered at the instructor’s discretion, and will not necessarily be announced in advance. 
(4)	All student panelists videotape their sessions for further revisions. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings will be considered for extra credit bonus at the end of the semester.
Grading Policy: 	(1) Academic honesty is prioritized in this class. Plagiarism will not be tolerated. Students will fail the course without contention once an incident of plagiarism is identified in their work. 
(2) Final grades will be determined by a point system (X out of 100 total points). Students will be evaluated by their panel discussions, submitted materials and debates. (Adjustments will be made if necessary.) 

Presentations (voluntary and/or assigned)
(study notes and interactive feedbacks)	10% X 2 /3 = 20% / 30%
Quizzes 	20%
Midterm Oral and Final Written Exams 	20% X 2 = 40%
Attendance 	20% 
*Students are obligated to attend all class sessions on time. Each absence / lateness will generate 10% / 5% deduction of the semester grades on the 100% scale. A university approved leave of document is accepted as one absence penalty waiver in the entire semester. AWOLs will be marked and entered into the penalty calculation if not corrected in two weeks of time, and lateness upon class dismissal. 
*This syllabus is subject to change at the instructor’s sole discretion. Changes made to the grading policy will be discussed in class. 
Scoring Criteria
1.	Research & analysis: understanding information introduced in the report and seeking additional support or discovering alternative or opposing studies; selection of important information from the report, with coherent and accurate presentation of such information in relation to other information /ideas in the reading and/or concerning issues in question; highly intelligible with exhibition of a sustained discourse 
2.	Content and structure: presenting a clear progression of ideas and conveying the relevant information required by task by providing and explaining substantive ideas and arguments in the reading; making necessary clarifications on facts and data introduced and critical analyses 
3.	Language use: demonstrating good control of basic and complex grammatical structures to allow coherent, efficient expression of ideas; using advanced and domain-specific and topic appropriate registers // Delivery and session management: speech being clear, concise, fluid and sustaining; maintaining the flow of discussions, stating and explaining ideas, arguments, facts and data as planned, asking and answering questions
4.	Study notes: clear and concise outline of content in the reading (report); language support, definitions of terms, and other useful information to enhance comprehension for ensuing discussion

description.zh: 本課程探討衛星通訊系統收發機設計，介紹衛星端與地球站通訊收發資料流。課程涵蓋的主題包括：通訊協定、通道編碼演算法、調變技術、多天線設計、軟體無線電技術、通訊數據機實現。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解衛星通訊收發機設計的技巧，並學習以軟體無線電實現通訊數據機。
description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.zh: 設計與生活是自古以來就相生相隨的一項行為，生活型態的變化，對生活器具的要求也就不同。故本課程主要在探討研究設計行為與生活型態之關係，進而提供新思維作為設計行為之參考。
description.en: Design is a part of human life. Demands in design changes with lifestyle. This course focuses on general review of lifestyle research that is practically constructive in the process of product planning and design.

syllabi.outline:
Scholars from disciplines such as sociology, economics, literature, drama, and design have offered diverse critiques of lifestyles from various perspectives, including individuality, social roles, consumer behavior, experiences, life satisfaction, and values. This course aims to shift students' focus toward the user context and employ different research methods to study three common integrative elements of lifestyle: cognition, behavior, and context. The course introduces persuasive design and behavior design patterns across different lifestyle scenarios by applying creative, reorganizing, and additive design techniques. The design theme focuses on creating products (both physical and digital) that 'change lifestyles' to achieve Sustainable Development Goals, while also reflecting on the technical difficulties and ethical challenges of applying design to behavior change.
Starting from 'lifestyles', this course focuses on considering different lifestyles/groups to design objects under a 'research-driven design' process to change behaviors while avoiding design pitfalls.

Students will learn to:
1. Understand the various aspects of lifestyles.
2. Consider the diversity of groups.
3. Apply several common design research methods in practice.
4. Acquire a wide range of professional design terminology.
5. Grasp the techniques and ethical considerations for persuasive design in behavior change.
6. Aim for sustainable development through design objectives.

社會學、經濟學、文學、戲劇、設計等學科的學者都從不同的角度對生活型態做出了不同的評論，如個人、社會角色、消費行為、經驗、生活幸福、價值觀等。本課程試圖將學生的眼光拉到使用者的情境，並利用不同的調查方法，研究生活型態的三個常見的整合元素：認知、行為與情境。以創造、重組與附加的不同設計手法，在不同生活型態的場景中，導入說服設計與行為設計模式。設計主題為設計「改變生活型態」以達到永續發展目標的設計成品（不限實體或數位）。同時，也反思設計應用於行為改變的技術困難與道德挑戰。
以「生活型態」出發，考慮不同生活型態/族群，在「研究驅動設計」流程下設計出目的在於改變行為的設計物並避設計陷阱。

學生將學會：
1. 理解生活型態的不同面向
2. 考量群體的多樣性
3. 實務中常應用之數種設計研究方法
4. 習得設計領域多種面向的設計專業用語
5. 說服性設計行為改變的技術與道德思考
6. 永續發展的設計目標

description.zh: 本課程介紹水文地質的一般原理、概念和分析方法及地下水在實用上的一些問題。主要內容有: 水的來、源分、佈與循環、地下水的賦存、地下水的物理性質及化學成分、地下水運動的基本規律、地下的地質作用、地下水的補給、排泄與徑流、地下水資源概況，與地下水有關的環境問題，地下水與工程開發的工程地質問題，水文地質調查概要等。
description.en: The content of this class includes general principles, concepts of hydrological geology and analyzing methods for practical problem related to this subject. It includes: origin of water, distribution and circulation, reserve of underground water, physical and chemical properties of underground water and the relationship between hydrology and engineering geology.  It also discuss environmental concerns of engineering to the hydrology system.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. name.zh: 自然語言處理與情感計算
name.en: Natural language processing and affective computing

description.zh:
未來的自然語言處理技術應該是能讓機器以人為本的角度來了解人類語言。尤其人類是富有感情的，所以，機器必須能理解與應對人類的情感。

本課程內容將從心理語言學出發，探討、比較人和機器如何處理語言。尤其是人如何透過文字和語音來表達不同情緒，然後運用機器學習、深度學習和人本資料資料探勘等技術，進行語音與文本分析，偵測辨識實際人類語言中的情緒，進而培養如何讓人工智慧能夠更貼近使用者需要的洞察力與處理能力。
description.en:
In future natural language processing technologies, machines should understand language from a human-oriented perspective. Especially given that human beings have emotions, machines must be able to understand and respond to human emotions.

The content of this course will be based on psycholinguistics. We will first explore and compare how people and machines deal with language, especially in terms of how people express different emotions through words and voices. We will then apply machine learning, deep learning and human-centered information data mining techniques to detect emotions in real human language.

syllabi.outline: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and its application in the realms of information Intelligence (II) and Information Intelligence (II). Aimed at providing students with practical skills and theoretical knowledge, the course covers a range of topics from the fundamentals of NLP and II to advanced techniques in machine learning and deep learning. Students will engage in hands-on projects and case studies to apply NLP in real-world business scenarios, focusing on market analysis, customer relationship management, and ethical considerations in AI.

description.zh:
深度學習數位影像分析，在近代的製造、醫藥、農業、太空探索、運輸和通信系統等應用領域，正迅速發展中。本課程主要介紹深度學習數位影像分析基本理論基礎，以此概念實際應用到各領域中。課程將探索最先進的深度學習模型，如物件偵測、影像分類，和影像分割，提供實用的實務練習；最後討論數位影像分析深度學習的未來挑戰。課程也將介紹最新的公開影像數據集(例如MNIST，CIFAR-10和ImageNet)，並涵蓋用於深度學習中的影像數據前處理和樣本標籤註記，詳細探討深度學習模型的評估指標。本課程將使用Matlab和Python範例，實作教學練習，課程單元包含:
●數位影像分析簡介
●深度學習基礎
●影像分析領域之深度學習基本介紹
●卷積神經網絡
●訓練卷積神經網絡
●遷移式學習
●深度學習數位影像數據標籤註記
●深度學習模型評估方式
●深度學習在數位影像分析領域之挑戰
●超引數優化
●激活函式
●損失函式
●優化函式
description.en:
This course covers the basics of deep learning for digital image analysis, including theoretical concepts and practical applications. Students will learn about object detection, image classification, and segmentation using state-of-the-art deep learning models. The course will also address the challenges of using deep learning in digital image analysis and cover popular image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. Additionally, students will gain hands-on experience in image data preparation and labeling, and learn about evaluation metrics for deep learning models. Programming examples will be provided in Python or Matlab. The course includes:
●A gentle introduction to digital image analysis and deep learning.
●Convolutional neural networks.
●Transfer learning.
●Image data labeling for deep learning.
●Evaluating deep learning models.
●The challenges of deep learning in the field of digital image analysis.
●Activation functions.
●Loss functions.
●Optimizers.

description.zh: 本課程目的在提升學生在科技與服務創新的知識及了解其各種不同的特性本課程旨在討論服務業可能衍生的經營策略，尤其是與網際網路相關的各種新興的服務產業。
description.en: This is an advanced course for Master students to enhance their theoretical foundation in Technology and Service Innovation. Issues involved are: Systematic View of Technology Innovation; Service Innovation; Service Management; New Service Development

syllabi.outline:
在「服務經濟」的時代中，如何透過「創新」促成服務業的轉型與升級，同時提升「附加價值（Value-added)」，進而確保企業與國家競爭力，已成為為發展的重要課題。新經濟的發展中，企業應以「消費者」為中心，創造優質的客戶價值與體驗，來帶動業務快速的增長。特別在科技技術極巨發展、外在環境變遷及數位轉型的時代來臨，有更多的企業透過數位科技（ 3D列印、半導體、顯示科技、IoT 、AI、雲端、大數據、邊緣運算、5G等），創造出許多創新的服務模式。
本課程內容將讓同學了解創新的基本概念，並介紹國內科技產業發展趨勢、及主要服務業的面臨問題、利用ICT結合創新應用的發展與服務模式；另因應數位轉型的時代來臨，亦讓同學了解何謂數位轉型、智慧製造、案例分享與討論（包含智慧醫療、智慧零售、智慧娛樂與運動科技）。透過課堂案例介紹與討論使同學能充分瞭解科技與服務創新的本質與未來的發展趨勢。

              化/國際化、傳統產業特色化）

description.zh: 本課程是針對高科技產業行銷管理的進階課程，目的是以行銷管理理論及案例討論方式，幫助學生熟悉高科技產業分析與行銷管理策略。關鍵概念包括傳統的行銷管理、高新技術產業B2B行銷管理、高科技導論、高科技企業之策略與企業文化、關係行銷、高科技企業之市場導向及研發與行銷的互動、高科技市場的行銷研究、了解高科技市場之顧客、高科技市場之後配銷通路與供應鏈管理、高科技市場之定價考量、高科技市場之廣告及促銷、及電子化企業及電子商務等研討。
description.en: This is an advanced course in marketing management for high-tech firms. The objective is to help students become familiar with industrial analysis and marketing management through marketing theories and cases. The key concepts include traditional marketing management, B2B Marketing Management, the introduction of high-tech Industry marketing, high-tech company's strategy and culture, relation marketing, marketing-R&D interaction, marketing research in high-tech markets, understanding high-tech customers, distribution channels and supply chain management, pricing consideration on high-tech marketing, advertising and promotion, E-business, case study, and term project.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

description.zh: 本科目將由不可壓縮流體在各種流動環境所產生之流體分子流動現象之認識，進而利用各種有關因次群，熟習包含可壓縮流體在內之實際應用上所必須具備之基礎方法；如雷諾數．伯努力方程式等。利用流利基礎分析，流體機械之流場與動力，及管路內流場與壓力之變化。
description.en: Introduction to flow phenomena of incompressible flow, discussion on the dimensionless groups and their applicants, derive the conservation equations such as the Bernoulli equation, using fluid mechanics to analyze the field and the dynamics of fluid machinery, pipe and duct flow are also discuss.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：物理或負責教授同意。不可壓縮流體、質量不滅、非黏性流體之運動、柏努力定律、線性及角動量定理及其應用、渦流與勢流、黏性流、納維爾－史脫克斯方程式及應用、管中壓力頭損失及增加、邊界層與分離升力與阻力及雷諾方程式之應用。

Required: Physics

This course teaches Japanese basic grammar, in order to establish students' ability to read and understand Japanese technical articles. The first half of the course teaches Japanese syllabary, auxiliary words, adjectives and verb conjugations, and then introduces Japanese grammar structure, common sentence patterns, etc… Focusing on the concepts and methods necessary for Japanese reading so that students can still enhance themselves and apply in work and daily life to read instructions and manuals of equipment or products.

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

description.zh: 高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程,其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。
description.en:
1.	熱傳導定律之推導
2.	一維及多維的穩態與暫態熱傳分析，
3.	散熱片之設計，利用數值方法解熱傳導問題，
4.	對流原理之推導
5.	強迫對流方面的分析及應用-層流邊界層，管道內層流熱傳
6.	自然對流方面的分析及應用-管道外與封閉空間內自然對流        熱傳
7.	紊流的基本性，紊流邊界層，管道內紊流
8.	具相變化的熱對流:凝結與沸騰
9.	熱交換器設計介紹
Advanced Heat Transfer  Credit: 3 

Course Outline
1.	Derivation of heat conduction principles 
2.	One and multi-dimentional steady and transient heat         conduction analysis
3.	Heat transfer from extended surfaces, numerical heat         conduction analysis
4.	Derivation of convection principles 
5.	Forced convection - laminar boundary layers and     laminar heat transfer in ducts
6.	Nature convection over external surfaces and in internal enclosures 
7.	Fundamentals of turbulence, turbulent boundary layers, turbulent flow in ducts
8.	Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation
9.	Introduction to heat-exchanger design

name.en: The technology and application of solar thermal energy system

description.zh: 本課程目的為訓練學生獲得在太陽熱能系統與製程應用領域上高階智識理論。課程教材含蓋數種太陽熱能轉換系統用以產生電能、熱水、冷暖氣與照明等用途，主要內容包括太陽輻射幾何學、追日型太陽能聚光器、太陽能史特靈發電系統、太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷暖氣系統、太陽能海水淡化、太陽能照明系統等等章節。期使學生未來能實際應用於各種不同太陽熱能轉換系統之規劃與設計。
description.en: This course aims to give graduate student a resource on the advanced principles and application of solar thermal energy system and processes. The material presented in the course covers several technologies for the conversion of solar thermal energy to provide electricity, hot water, heating, and desalination. The course outline mainly includes analysis of solar geometry and radiation, performance of sun-tracking solar concentrating collectors, solar stirling power system, solar water heating system, solar space heating and cooling system, solar optical lighting system. It hops that the student can apply the learned knowledge to the plan and design of many types of variable solar thermal energy system in year to come.

syllabi.outline:
太陽能熱能工程應用，是一門利用太陽能之能量來提供人類能源之科學，太陽能為取之不盡用之不絕，且為乾淨又穩定之來源，在油價高漲且地球環境保護需求日益殷切的今日，太陽能之能源應用，已成為今日最熱門之學科。本學科之教學目標，在使學生了解基本之太陽能轉換為熱能、電能及照明之基本原理，並且經實際之能量轉換過程,以及熱力學之運用, 使學生對以太陽能為熱源之機械設備,如太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷凍空調設備、太陽能發電機、太陽能電池、太陽能照明設備等之應用，作深入之瞭解與認識，並可對相關產品做能量之計算及規劃設計,以使學生日後能為相關產業提供基礎人才。
本科目將由認識太陽、地球與太陽互動關係、地球上太陽能之基本熱輻射理論，結合各種不同形式之利用太陽能源有效裝置，討論太陽能之有效利用方式及相關系統技術。以期在既有太陽能利用技術上，發揮更有效率的太陽能源工程系統設計，奠定未來21世紀太陽能源利用之高效率化基礎。本門課主要為太陽能應用的原理分析及系統設計，課程內容包括太陽熱能系統的熱力熱傳及流體力學分析與系統設計、成本分析(為主)；太陽能光電系統的組成與設計分析(為輔)。

The application of solar thermal energy engineering is a science of using solar energy to provide human energy. Solar energy is inexhaustible, and it is a clean and stable source. Today, when oil prices are rising and the demand for environmental protection is increasing, The energy application of solar energy has become the most popular subject today. The teaching goal of this subject is to enable students to understand the basic principles of the conversion of solar energy into heat, electrical energy and lighting, and through the actual energy conversion process and the application of thermodynamics, to enable students to understand mechanical equipment that uses solar energy as a heat source, such as solar energy. In-depth understanding and understanding of the application of water heaters, solar refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, solar generators, solar cells, solar lighting equipment, etc., and energy calculation and planning and design of related products, so that students can provide for related industries in the future Basic talents.
This subject will discuss the effective use of solar energy and related system technologies by understanding the sun, the interaction between the earth and the sun, and the basic thermal radiation theory of solar energy on the earth, combining various effective devices for using solar energy sources. It is hoped that in the existing solar energy utilization technology, more efficient solar energy source engineering system design will be used to lay the foundation for the high efficiency of solar energy source utilization in the future 21st century. This course is mainly for the principle analysis and system design of solar energy applications. The content of the course includes thermal heat transfer and fluid mechanics analysis of solar thermal energy system and system design, cost analysis (mainly); composition and design analysis of solar photovoltaic system (secondary)

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。探討專利相關法規及其應用：專利重要法規，專利實體審查基準，專利案例閱讀與分析，專利舉發 ，專利行政救濟，專利侵權鑑定，專利迴避性設計，簡易專利地圖製作，專利應用範例。
description.en:

●A few important patent laws
●Guidelines for substantive examination for invention patent
●Practices in applying for patents
●Practices in patent invalidations
●Patent administrative remedy
●Theories in patent infringement assessment
●Innovative designing around patent

Patent cases study

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用分析。

description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

syllabi.outline:
教學目標：
(1)培養學生基礎體能及肢體協調能力。(2)瞭解運動保健常識。(3)瞭解自我體能狀況及限制。(4)培養自我鍛鍊方法。
教學大綱：
(1)健康體適能定義。(2)介紹健康體適能五大要素。(3)評估健康體適能。(4)瞭解自我體適能鍛鍊方法。(5)瞭解健康保健方法。

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。另外，為了讓企業經理人了解衍生性金融商品，本課程亦以深入淺出方式介紹選擇權之基本觀念、交易實務與決策應用。本課程目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識，培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才

The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. In addition, in order to let corporate managers understand the derivatives, this course introduces the basic concept of option, transaction practice and decision-making applications. The purpose of this course is to provides knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value, so as to cultivate financial management talents with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

syllabi.outline:
為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構。將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. It can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

description.zh: 化學是富挑戰性且具教學難度之科目，使這個複雜的學科讓學生易於接受化學教育家的挑戰，特別是基礎化學。嘗試推展關鍵的化學概念，並以觀察現象為主，再討論理論模式，並用以解釋所觀測的現象是本課程的重點。希望學生實踐"如同一個化學家的思考方式"來仔細觀察，而不是跳入公式或模型中。此外，舉例證明化學在現實生活中的重要性與最新的應用及發展並以簡易明瞭的方式呈現於授課內容。
description.en:
Chemistry is fascinating and important subject that is challenging to teach and even more challenging to learn. Marking this complex subject accessible to students without distortion is challenge of the chemical educator, especially at the introductory level.
In this lecture I try to develop key chemical concept in the same way to show the observations first and then discuss the models that have been constructed to explain the observed behavior. I hope students will practice "thinking like a chemist" by carefully studying the observation to see if they can follow the thought process, rather than just jumping head to the equation or model that will follow.
In addition, to demonstrate the importance of chemistry in real life, I have incorporated throughout the book a number of applications and recent advances in essay form.

syllabi.outline:
The class will be taught in-person. In-person sessions will include active gameplay with another student or coach. This is an introductory course teaching the fundamental skills of table tennis. It is assumed that students enrolled in the class have little or no experience in table tennis. Class will be focusing on developing the following skills: racket grip, possible racket holding angles, basic strokes, rules, scoring, strategy, etiquette, practice drills, spin, singles play.
Not limited to a students with advance level would like to join. For those of who should notice, some advance techniques would not be included in the course.

Present the student fundamental skills and knowledge of table tennis.
Improve each student's skills in hitting all of the basic strokes: forehand counterhit; backhand
counterhit(drive); backhand flick(flip); backhand block; service return, and footwork.
Introduce each student to the basic rules, scoring, and footwork.
Offer each student an opportunity to apply their skill and knowledge in match play.
Make each student aware of the primary differences in strategies for singles and doubles and provide an
opportunity to implement this information in actual match play.
Provide each student with information about current table tennis trends, specifically regarding local
table tennis programs, professional tournaments and equipment selection.
Encourage each student to pursue table tennis as a lifetime leisure activity.

**Consistent attendance and participation are extremely important in order to develop the necessary skills for improvement. All students will be held accountable for any work missed when absent. Please be prepared each day with proper equipment and attire.

In this period, all students are randomly assign to a groups for competitions. For the final grade, to 40 points in total is requires for student to pass the class.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.notes:
＊課程對應SDGs指標：3.健康福祉
＊指標對應授課內容：本課程設計，對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景等，探索音樂美感構成標準，充實賞析音樂藝術知識，將音樂美學思想延伸到生活內涵，達到提升身心靈的健康喜樂與調劑紓壓的功能。

＊課程對應SDGs指標：16.和平與正義
＊指標對應授課內容：
1.第3、4週課程，講述1812序曲，俄國作曲家柴可夫斯基以發生於1812年法國拿破崙大軍攻打俄國戰役為背景所創作的音樂作品，樂曲中呈現戰爭情緒，百姓面對戰爭來臨的聖詠祈願和平到來！
2.第10、11週課程「合唱藝術」主題，講述《黃河大合唱》-現代大型中文聲樂創作合唱作品，創作背景於二次世界大戰時期，組曲描述八年抗日戰爭的情形。

＊課程對應SDGs指標：5.性別平等

1.第12週授課：介紹波希米亞狂想曲的創作影響，認識波希米亞狂想曲創作者Freddie Mercury，探討其背景創作歌曲，歌詞自述同性世界的心路歷程。

description.zh: 此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同學科能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠擁有更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能引用到管理上實質的層面。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand sociology. It covers theory and practicability, and make students consider the current society, and understand the generated factors of diversity . Expect students' study can have more for the community as a whole different way of thinking, in order to strengthen their academic needs, not only has the theoretical depth of insight, but also on the substance applied to the management level.

syllabi.outline:
本堂課透過社會學理論的知識與實踐，向同學們引介理解社會的觀點與方法。
極大多數人的生活，都處在「社會」當中。我們必須不斷地與人、與環境互動，才能維繫生命與生活。人們的各種關係在社會中相互構成，影響了社會資源的生產方式、分配與消費。
因此，掌握人們分析社會的方式，才有可能知道社會關係與結構是怎麼運作起來的。藉由本課程所涉及的多樣議題，讓同學們接觸生活圈內及舒適圈外的不同樣貌，並據此反身質問：我們如何參與及想像社會？社會又如何影響著我們的言行與思考？

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

description.zh: 西藥及中草藥是中華民族的傳統藥，也是中國藥學寶庫的重組成成分，中草藥包括中藥、草藥（即民間藥）以及少數民族地區使用的民族藥，在中國，使用中草藥防病治病已有數千年之歷史，寶鑑證明，中草藥療效確切，副作用較合成中藥少，力來深受群眾喜愛。當前，人類健康需要傳統醫藥之觀點正為越來越多之國家和人民接受，開發傳統要已成為當今藥物發展的潮流。同時，近年來科學研究成果表明，從中草藥發展出療效好，毒性低的新藥是一條成功的捷徑。因此，學習中草藥之人員日漸增加。本課程共分：西藥概論、中草藥概論、內科中草藥、兒科中草藥、男科中草藥、婦科中草藥、美容養生中草藥等。
description.en: The Drugs on Life is a two credit hours course and design especially for technology students. This curriculum emphasizes on the clinical applications and action mechanisms of various western and Chinese drugs. The curriculum trends will start from more details and bring a completely concepts. The subjects include neuropharmacology, autacoids, cardiovascular drugs, analgesics, anaethesia and drugs actiong on the central nervous system, chemotherapy of microbial disease and neoplastic disease, hormones and hormone antagonists, drugs acting on the blood and some Chinese drugs.

syllabi.outline:
在西藥使用之前，人類對疾病的治療均使用天然藥物。而在西藥盛行的今日，天然藥物並未示微，反而是養生保健的最佳良方，對於體質改善、慢性病的控制、延年益壽甚至美容美髮方面都遠較西藥為佳。

在課程內容方面，包括中草藥、西洋草藥、植物精油與香料等在養生保健的應用，均有所著墨。課程中搭配生活實作DIY，以加深同學的學習體驗。

description.zh: 古蹟、歷史建築和聚落為台灣地區文化資產的一部份，亦是台灣社會發展和多元文化交融的歷史見證。這些建築物表出各項的歷史價值與意義，其類型包括了史前遺址、荷西城堡、清代祠廟、墳墓、民居，以及日治時代以後的官署、學校、官舍住宅、土木設施等。本課程的目的，一方面希望讓修課同學對台灣各期建築歷史與形式風格特徵，能有清晰的架構與認識，以作為欣賞台灣古蹟的基礎；另一方面則是養成同學對身處文化環境的關心與歷史人文精神的培養。
description.en: Cultural property, historic building and settlement are the evidence of history development and multiple cultural interaction of Taiwanese society. The types of architecture include excavation, castle, temple, tomb, folk settlement before the Ching dynasty, and official building, school, house and civil engineering facility after the Japanese occupied period. This course hope to help students to understand the architectural history briefly, and get some basic skill about the formative characters of each period. Furthermore, it will train them to give more concern on the cultural environment of Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:
「古蹟」是人類社會發展過程中的遺留物；是歷史的見證，代表不同時期文化的象徵；是國家重要的資產；是實體的歷史教材；是「歷史」這首歌裡的一個個音符，也可以說是歷史洪流的見證者。
「古蹟」也是無所不在的人類遺跡，有無可取代的文明寶藏；是豐富的文化史課本；是人類思考與想像的泉源。
本課程的目的，一方面希望讓修課同學透過古蹟，可使我們驗證過去、瞭解過去，並建立一個連續不斷的臺灣歷史文化命脈。
另一方面，則是養成同學對身處文化環境的關心與歷史人文精神的培養。所以以史前、荷西、明鄭、清代、日治、民國等六個時期為經、古蹟為緯，脈絡分明，欣賞古蹟。

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data structures commonly used in programming languages which include ADT (abstract data type) and complexity, static structures and their storage representations, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, and searching.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域資安之應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence Cross-domain Applications in Information Security

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，在零信任安全的概念上，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，接著探討人工智慧安全的基礎知識，包括機器學習、深度學習等技術，並介紹如何將這些技術應用於資安領域。此外，在人工智慧在安全的應用上，將導入人工智慧在入侵偵測、漏洞掃描、安全威脅評估等方面的應用案例，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，將介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。最後，課程還將介紹API安全，包括API安全的風險與漏洞、API保護措施等方面的內容，並介紹如何使用人工智慧技術保護API的安全性。
description.en: This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. First, the course will introduce the concept of zero-trust security and discuss how this method can be used to safeguard data security. In addition, the course will also explore the application of AI in security, including case studies in intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, security threat assessment, and how AI can be used for network security defense and protect personal data and privacy. In addition, the use of AI technology for detecting cybersecurity incidents, including detecting network attacks using techniques such as anomaly detection and intrusion detection. It will also explore fraud detection using AI, such as credit card fraud or malicious top-up fraud. Lastly, the course will introduce API security, including risks and vulnerabilities, API protection measures, and how to use AI technology to protect API security.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，課程將介紹零信任安全的概念，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，並深入探討其相關技術及應用案例。課程還將探討人工智慧在安全的應用，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在隱私保護方面，介紹有關個人資料與隱私保護的法律、標準與指引，以及如何在人工智慧應用中保護個人資料和隱私。課程也將深入探討人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。
This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. It will delve into topics such as zero trust security, AI security, personal data and privacy protection, AI in the detection of information security incidents, AI in fraud detection, AI-assisted computer auditing, AI-assisted digital forensics, and API security. Initially, the course will introduce the concept of zero trust security, discussing how to use this method to ensure data security, and will explore its related technologies and application cases in depth. The course will also examine the application of AI in security, and how to use AI technologies for network security defense. In terms of privacy protection, it will cover laws, standards, and guidelines related to personal data and privacy protection, as well as how to protect personal data and privacy in AI applications.

description.zh: 電腦稽核已廣泛的應用在金融交易，企業財務與進銷存流程與資訊系統的各項領域來協助找出瑕疵，降低與防範風險，並能做趨勢預測。本課程的目的將機器學習與人工智慧的技術應用在電腦稽核領域，主題包含: 電腦稽核的流程，大量資料的整理與萃取，監督式與非監督式學習在稽核的應用，資料視覺化技術等。
description.en: Computer auditing has been widely used in financial transactions, enterprise business processes, and information systems, which is to help find flaws and reduce risks, and be able to predict trends. The purpose of this course is to apply machine learning technology in the field of computer auditing. Topics include Computer auditing related processes, the extraction and manipulation of large-scaled data, supervised and unsupervised learning in auditing applications, data visualization technology.

description.zh: 生態與環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解生態環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境污染問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Ecology and Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize its importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand the connection between our ecological environment and our living condition, the environmental pollution problems and their classification, the environmental problems in Taiwan, and the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems after the situation introduction.

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
林懷民說：「不管看的懂，看不懂，只要是看了可以讓你感動、喜愛的，對你而言，就是好的藝術」。這句話聽起來雖然很簡單，但提到「藝術」兩個字，對非藝術科系的同學而言，似乎還是很高深，很難懂 ! 所以這門課在課程設計上，主要就是針對非藝術科系同學們的學習需要，以深入淺出的方式來介紹藝術，讓同學們能夠在沒有壓力和負擔的狀態下，輕輕鬆鬆的接觸藝術、欣賞藝術、甚至喜歡上藝術。
在十八週的課程中，我們會從藝術史上的第一幅畫開始介紹，接著，再依序介紹世界上最有名的畫家如 : 達文西、米開蘭基羅、米勒、莫內、梵谷、馬諦斯、畢卡索…等等畫家生活中和藝術作品背後的有趣故事，並欣賞相關的藝術電影。
衷心希望這樣的課程安排，能夠讓同學們輕鬆學藝術，體會欣賞藝術的樂趣，敬請期待。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週  導論
第2週  如何欣賞藝術
第3週  藝術的起源：洞穴壁畫、巨石柱群
第4週  埃及藝術：金字塔、獅身人面像
第5週  希臘藝術：擲鐵餅者雕像、帕特農神殿、希臘劇場
第6週  羅馬藝術：奧古斯都雕像、羅馬競技場
第7週  中世紀藝術：拜占廷鑲嵌畫、羅馬式、哥德式

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解企業在創立前需考量的面向與創業後所面臨的財務問題以及企業創立之後，如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下主要內容:(1)創業管理(2) 會計基本概念(3)公司四大財務報表與財務報表的組成項目(4)運用既有的財報數字，對公司經營結果進行全面性的財務分析 (5)公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

description.zh: 本課程能夠讓修課學生靈活的運用各種大數據探勘與分析演算法、社群文字探勘及機器學習演算法等技術，分析各項金融資料。透過實際金融數據分析案例及實務資料操做，補強資訊背景學生之金融產業知識，並讓修課同學了解資訊科技於金融資料分析之實務應用，以培育業界金融科技人才。課程內容以模組的方式進行，包括：「數據分析」、「機器學習」以及「金融大數據實務」。課程也將擷取網路中的開放財經數據，進行金融資料之預處理、分析及預測結果之驗證，協助修課學生建構高預測能力及穩定性之數據探勘模型。
description.en: This course teaches students to use various techniques of big data mining and analysis algorithms, text mining of social media, and machine learning algorithms to analyze financial data. In this course, by case study and open software operation (such as R ), we will strengthen the financial knowledge of information background students. Also, the students can understand how to select and well organize various information technologies (particular the data analysis technique) to analyze financial data. The course is organized in modules, including "Data Analysis", "Machine Learning" and "Big Data Practice for Financial Data analysis." The course will also teach students to collect open financial data from the Internet, and experience the KDD process, including: data pre-processing and data analysis, to establish a prediction model with high forecasting ability and stability.

name.en: The Evaluation for Bulding’s Carbon Footprint

description.zh: 國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳(低蘊含碳)建築評估(Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。
description.en: IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System(LBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool to evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是研究人與環境互動的關係，介紹環境心理學發展的過程及相關的理論。並藉由觀察與評估現有生活環境中的行為，增進我們對環境心理學中在理論與經驗上不同取向的瞭解。課程內容包括1.緒論2.研究方法及理論架構 3. 建成環境，由家環境到城市空間4.社會行為及實質環境5.自然環境與行為6.使用者用後評估7. 結論
description.en: The purpose of this course is to explore the interaction relationships between human and environment, introducing the development and theory of environmental psychology. Via observing and evaluating the behavior of present living environment, enhance our knowledge about environmental psychology through various approaches to theories and experiences. The course includes:1. Introduction  2. Research methods and theory framework 3. The built environment from home environment to city space 4. Social behavior and the physical environment 5. The natural environment and behavior 6. Post-occupancy evaluation 7. Conclusion

description.zh: 本課程重點在探討人們日常生活與工作時，置身其間的理想環境及適用的器物設備；在從事建築、室內及產品等環境相關設計時所應考慮的人體特徵、心理反應、動作行為及人類心理和生理上可承受的負荷，特別是人/環境系統間的相對配合問題，以獲得安全、效率與舒適為目的。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures. And then apply it to the design of architecture, interior, product, systems and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重於實踐人因設計，讓學生通過操作眼動儀、3D掃描儀、膚電阻感測器、慣性測量元件等先進設備，直接體驗人因科學如何融入產品設計。學生將學會如何藉由這些工具收集、分析、並運用數據來優化產品設計，從而提高設計的實用性與創新性。
This course focuses on practical human factors design, allowing students to experience the application of human factors science in product design through the use of advanced equipment such as eye trackers, 3D scanners, galvanic skin response sensors, and inertial motion units. Students will learn how to collect, analyse, and apply data with these tools to enhance the efficacy and innovation of product design.

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

syllabi.outline: 本課程從中美貿易戰美方指控中國竊取營業秘密及強制技術移轉談起，再以我國營業秘密法與公平交易法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；除重視營業秘密法與公平交易法之基礎內涵外，將以國際比較法的視野，論述二法律與智權行使密切相關的課題，並輔以專題探討或案例分析的方式進行之。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學需求進行調整---從中美貿易戰至台積電赴美、日設廠談營業秘密保護與強制技術授權及合作技術移轉
第2週：營業秘密法與公平交易法的立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢。
第3週：營業秘密法的法理基礎。
第4週：營業秘密的標的、歸屬與應用。
第5週：營業秘密的侵害、保全程序、救濟與保護（台積電海外投資合作案之營秘保護、區塊鏈與營秘保護等）。
第6週：營業秘密與競業禁止（台積電跳巢案、美光科技挖角案）。
第7週：侵害營業秘密之刑事處罰（穩懋半導體公司營秘遭竊案、英業達公司營秘案、美光控訴聯電及中國晉華竊取半導體DRAM營秘案）。
第8週：侵害營業秘密之損害賠償（先進光賠償大立光15.22億元案）。
第9週：侵害營業秘密案件的審理與秘密保持命令。
第10週：公平交易法與智慧財產權法規範的對象、方法及競合。
第11週：公平交易法對獨占、結合及聯合行為之規範。
第12週：公平交易法對不公平競爭行為之規範。
第13週：違反公平交易法之民事、刑事及行政責任。
第14週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（警告函、高通案）。
第15週：公平交易法與專利(授)權之行使（標準必要專利(SEP)、公平及合理非歧視條款(FRAND)）。
第16週：公平交易法與商標權之行使（攀附著名商標、仿冒商標〈表徵〉）。 
第17週：公平交易法與著作權之行使（電視節目版式、AI創作及AI+大數據）。 
第18週：兩岸及國際公平交易法與營業秘密之保護。


※ 實際授課內容將依同學之興趣、程度，擇要或增修主題後進行之。

※ 本課程重視問題意識之引導及積極參與式的學習，2/3以上的主題將以案例探討或業師協同教學方式授課。

平時成績(含出席率、提問及參與報告、討論之綜合表現)50％、期末報告50％

6. 林洲富，營業秘密與競業禁止案例式，五南，2021年9月。

9. 劉傳璽、林洲富、陳建宇，半導體產業營業秘密與智慧財產權之理論與實務，五南，2021年1月。

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

description.zh: 本課程著重於隨機流量網路(stochastic flow network)的可靠度評估、分析和決策。在整個課程中，我們將介紹與隨機流量網路相關的數值分析方法、模擬技術和最佳化問題。此外，我們將在隨機流量網路模型的框架內深入探討最快路徑、多商品、路由政策和負載管理問題等主題。學生將有機會將這些方法和模型應用到實際系統中，包括電腦網路、電信、城市交通系統、電力傳輸網路和製造系統。
description.en: This course emphasizes the reliability evaluation, analysis, and decision-making aspects of stochastic flow networks. Throughout the course, we will introduce analytical methodologies, simulation techniques, and optimization problems related to stochastic flow networks. Furthermore, we will delve into topics like quickest path, multi-commodity, routing policies, and load management issues within the framework of stochastic flow network models. Students will have the opportunity to apply these methodologies and models to practical systems, including computer networks, telecommunications, urban traffic systems, power transmission networks, and manufacturing systems.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生了解現今專利權授予上較具爭議之課題。透過案例閱讀與討論，除使學生明白專利熱門議題外，也了解未來專利之發展趨勢。
description.en: The course provides some important issues, including animal and plant patents, traditional knowledge and genetic resources, computer software, business methods, as well as some recent cases, such as Apple sued HTC.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將在專利法的基礎上，以案例為教材進行討論，案例包含電腦軟體、醫藥、生物、中草藥之專利申請審查，以及新型專利形式審查和舉發審查和其他個案研討。
This course will be based on patent law and will use cases as teaching materials for discussion. The cases include patent application review for computer software, medicine, biology, Chinese herbal medicine, as well as prosecution issues and other special cases.

description.zh: 本課程重點在探討人們日常生活與工作時，置身其間的理想環境及適用的器物設備；在從事建築、室內及產品等環境相關設計時所應考慮的人體特徵、心理反應、動作行為及人類心理和生理上可承受的負荷，特別是人/環境系統間的相對配合問題，以獲得安全、效率與舒適為目的。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures. And then apply it to the design of architecture, interior, product, systems and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重於實踐人因設計，讓學生通過操作眼動儀、3D掃描儀、膚電阻感測器、慣性測量元件等先進設備，直接體驗人因科學如何融入產品設計。學生將學會如何藉由這些工具收集、分析、並運用數據來優化產品設計，從而提高設計的實用性與創新性。
This course focuses on practical human factors design, allowing students to experience the application of human factors science in product design through the use of advanced equipment such as eye trackers, 3D scanners, galvanic skin response sensors, and inertial motion units. Students will learn how to collect, analyse, and apply data with these tools to enhance the efficacy and innovation of product design.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

description.zh: 本課程教導及訓練研究生有關英文在管理領域內特定專題的溝通運用，學生將在本課程中以英文學習: (1)管理常見之專有名詞，(2)英語備忘錄的草擬與撰寫，(3)會議資料如：議程、動議、記錄等的準備與撰寫，(4)企業計劃書的編寫，及(5)現代化全球管理相關專題英文資料的閱讀與溝通討論。學生必須在課堂上就選定的管理題材以英文做報告與其它同學討論。
description.en: This course teaches students the communication in English on the special topics within the context of management. Students are expected to learn the followings in English: (1) Terminologies commonly used in management; (2) Draft and write-up of English memorandum; (3) Development of meeting materials such as agenda, motions, minutes, etc.; (4) Business proposals and plans; and (6) Contemporary topics and trend in global management issues. Students will be required to make group presentations and discussions on the selected management topics in English.

description.zh: 這門課程主要是介紹資料庫系統的理論與應用，內容包含有： 1. 資料庫系統的介紹與架構 2. ER 資料模式 3. 檔案儲存結構 4. 關連式資料模式 5. SQL 查詢語言 6. ER資料模式與關連式資料模式之間的轉換 7. 資料庫正規化 8. 最佳化查詢 9. 交易處理
description.en: This course provides introduction to both database system theory and application. These are the following : o 1. Database System Concepts and Architecture -2. Data Modeling Using the Entity-Relationship Model --3. Record Storage and Primary File Organizations -4. -The Relational Data Model -5. SQL -6. ER- and ERR-to Relational Mapping -7. Functional Dependencies and Normalization for Relational Databases -8. Query Processing and Optimization -9. Transaction Processing Concepts

description.zh: 本課程是研究所程度進階的巨量資料探勘與應用課程，主要介紹巨量資料探勘概念和原理、分散式計算基本架構、及各種應用包括: Link Analysis、Social Network Graph Mining、推薦系統等, 並且將介紹在處理巨量資料時常用的機器學習方法, 如: 類神經網路、SVM等，除了觀念的介紹外，透過平行化程式設計的練習以及期末專題，能讓學生認識實際巨量資料探勘的程式設計以及機器學習等工具的應用方式。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程是研究所程度進階的巨量資料探勘與應用課程，主要介紹巨量資料探勘原理、方法與各種應用。並且介紹在處理巨量資料時常用的機器學習方法，如: 類神經網路、SVM等，和處理巨量資料的分散式計算基本架構。除了觀念的介紹外，透過程式設計的練習以及期末專題，能讓學生認識實際巨量資料探勘的程式設計以及機器學習等工具的應用方式。
This course introduces the concepts of big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, methodologies, and various applications. Introducing machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks and support vector machines, etc., as well as the basic architecture of distributed computing. In addition to the concept introduction, programming exercises, and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data analytics.

description.zh:
本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。
藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入ISO/IEC 29100的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑(PIA)，接下介紹ISO/IEC 27701個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。

name.en: Application of Investment Decision and Information

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, this course combines information and software tools to use, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

name.en: Ergonomics evaluation and redesign in products

description.zh: 本課程期望學生能夠能有獨立思考的能力，對產品建構出合理的實驗設計架構，透過採集人的生理與心理數據對產品進行人因工程評估，最後將實驗發現應用於產品的重新設計上，讓產品能夠更符合使用者的需求與認知。
description.en: In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

description.zh: 逆向工程已成為電腦輔助產品開發技術重要的一環，透過三次元量測或掃瞄技術，取得工件表面的點資料，據以建構3D CAD幾何模型(Geometric model)，以供後續設計、電腦輔助工程分析(CAE)與電腦輔助製造(CAM)之應用。逆向工程的程序分為三個階段：(1)擷取工件表面的點資料；(2)點資料的前置處理；以及(3)建構或更新幾何模型。依此流程，本課程首先講述各類運用於逆向工程中的量測與掃瞄技術，並以設計應用觀點為基礎，討論其間的差異與優缺點，隨著運用領域的不同，而採取不同的量測技術；其次介紹點資料前置處理的理念與方法，從現有文獻中，解析的相關的技術，因量測技術與策略的差異，而發展出不同的處理技術；至於，重建或更新原有的幾何模型的部分，將著重設計實務的應用，並與現有的CAD系統整合的策略。課程之目標，為使修習本課程之學生能對逆向工程的相關理論與技術，有全盤的認識與瞭解，並透過實際案例的操作，訓練學生能具備實務作業能力。
description.en: Reverse engineering has become an important tool for geometric model construction in 3D CAD based on the data points, digitized from an existing part, for the downstream applications such as CAE and CAM. The process of reverse engineering can usually be subdivided into three stages, i.e. (1) part digitization for capturing the data points; (2) data point pre-processing; and (3) CAD modeling and/or updating. In this course, the relevant techniques in the three stages of reverse engineering procedure are introduced firstly. Through the project practice, the student is able to adept to the techniques of reverse engineering.

description.zh: 本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

syllabi.outline:
The class will be taught in-person. In-person sessions will include active gameplay with another student or coach. This is an introductory course teaching the fundamental skills of table tennis. It is assumed that students enrolled in the class have little or no experience in table tennis. Class will be focusing on developing the following skills: racket grip, possible racket holding angles, basic strokes, rules, scoring, strategy, etiquette, practice drills, spin, singles play.
Not limited to a students with advance level would like to join. For those of who should notice, some advance techniques would not be included in the course.

Present the student fundamental skills and knowledge of table tennis.
Improve each student's skills in hitting all of the basic strokes: forehand counterhit; backhand
counterhit(drive); backhand flick(flip); backhand block; service return, and footwork.
Introduce each student to the basic rules, scoring, and footwork.
Offer each student an opportunity to apply their skill and knowledge in match play.
Make each student aware of the primary differences in strategies for singles and doubles and provide an
opportunity to implement this information in actual match play.
Provide each student with information about current table tennis trends, specifically regarding local
table tennis programs, professional tournaments and equipment selection.
Encourage each student to pursue table tennis as a lifetime leisure activity.

**Consistent attendance and participation are extremely important in order to develop the necessary skills for improvement. All students will be held accountable for any work missed when absent. Please be prepared each day with proper equipment and attire.
syllabi.schedule:
#1~4weeks 
Introductory phase: learning fundamental skills and knowledge.
  EX., racket holding,  techniques of forehand, backhand, server.

#5~10weeks
Gameplay phase: game rules introduction and practicing.
During this phase, all students are required to play with other classmates in both single and double game match to familiar processes of the play.

#11~18weeks
Matching phase: single an double game competitions.
In this period, all students are randomly assign to a groups for competitions. For the final grade, to 40 points in total is requires for student to pass the class.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生學習網球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確網球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞網球運動賽事，提升對於網球運動之興趣。
3. 了解網球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

syllabi.schedule:
壹、教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:增強健康適能，內容含肌肉適能、心肺適能、柔軟度:進而了解身體組成，提高運動適能；並藉由舞蹈作品展演體現肢體美感，與提升現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)肌肉適能:皮拉提斯與彈力帶(Pilates and Exercise band):
*提升肢體覺察力與覺知力，進而正確運用肢體達到健康安全的行為模式；並增強肢體協調性、敏捷性、反應力與專注力。
*增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二)柔軟度:伸展與滾筒運動(Stretching and Foam roller exercises)
*藉由伸展運動達到身心放鬆與休息，並增進肢體柔軟度。
(三)心肺適能:階梯舞蹈 (Step dnce)
*體驗階梯舞蹈並能展演:學生在階梯舞蹈過程，強化肢體協調性、敏捷性、反應力與專注力。創作時，從舞蹈經驗學習中，開發對自我認同、自信及美感體現。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

貳、教學進度
一	
1-教學規劃說明，含目標、內容、進度、應備知識基礎、評量方式。
2-測驗基礎肌肉適能與柔軟度。
二	
1-身體評估。
2-了解肌肉、骨骼及神經關係。
3-剖析及了解自己日常生活時身體姿勢的狀況，躺、坐、站、走、跑、跳的正確姿勢。
三
肢體觀察與覺知能力培養
1-練習健康正確的身體姿勢。
2-Pilates Mat Work與彈力帶初級動作分解。學習保養身體及改善不良的體態（肌肉適能）。 
3-滾筒與伸展運動（增進柔軟度）。
四	
肢體觀察與覺知能力培養
1-Pilates Mat Work與彈力帶初級動作分解。學習保養身體及改善不良的體態（肌肉適能）。

五

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. syllabi.schedule:
第1週：籃球運動之比賽規則與裁判法簡介。
              基本運球：1.換手 2.背後 3.胯下 4.轉身	  
第2週：接球動作要領:三重威脅動作
              基本傳球：1.胸前 2.過頂 3.地板 4.單手地板 5.背後	  
第3週：個人上籃：1.左右手上籃 2.墊步上籃 3.單步上籃	  
第4週：團體上籃：1.二人跑傳上籃 2.三人跑傳上籃 3.3人８字跑傳上籃	  
第5週：進階傳球：1.單手長傳上籃 2.雙手長傳上籃	  
第6週：定點投籃：1.罰球線 2.左右45度
              移位跳投:1.罰球線 2.左右45度	  
第7週：大隊接力比賽。一對一進攻防守：1.個人防守 2.動作要領.方法 3.防守姿勢.防守位置 4.防守步伐
第8週：一對一單打練習	  
第9週：期中測驗:1分鐘3分線定點上籃測驗。	  
第10週：二人進攻組合技術：1.pick & roll 2.pick & pop 3.give & go
第11週：二人防守組合技術：1.二人防守技術介紹.演練 2.二對二攻守練習	  
第12週：三人進攻組合技術：1.上擋組合 2.下擋組合 3.橫擋組合	  
第13週：三人防守組合技術：1.防守技術介紹.演練 2.三對三攻守練習
第14週：影片觀賞：1.籃球勵志電影介紹 2.觀賞經典比賽影片 3.規則講解	  
第15週：半場比賽一：3對3比賽	  
第16週：半場比賽二：3對3比賽	  
第17週：期末測驗：1分鐘中距離跳投測驗。
第18週：筆試測驗：籃球規則測驗

All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.outline:
本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
一、確立運動與健康的價值觀，養成喜好運動的習慣，並提升自我的身體健康適能與體能。 (身體活動量提升與價值觀建立)
二、以自身的參與體驗來達到健康促進與疾病預防，並了解運動與健康的觀念。(做中學、學中做)

本堂課程有申請教育部教學實踐計畫，並核可執行。因此本課程同時是教學實踐研究之課程。

syllabi.assessment:
一、平時成績&出勤成績：30%
曠課第一次扣2分、第2次扣4分、第3次扣8分…，以此類推。
事假視為曠課，特殊原因請附證明，斟酌不扣分。
遲到、早退及服裝不整各算半次曠課。
病假2次以內不扣分但請附醫生證明，第3次起前2次病假及後續病假皆算曠課。
運動推廣: 借由社群空間，推廣自身的運動成效，把運動好處散發出去。酌量加分。

二、運動習慣 : 50%
1. APP使用成績 (40%)：
從第7周至第15周，有氧運動須累積完成20KM  (20%)，重訓或居家肌力與體能訓練需每周一次 (20%)。完成門檻即獲得80%分數，超標者分數加上去。
2. 身體活動量紀錄 (10%)：
有按照本門課完成2周一次的身體活動紀錄，有完成紀錄即獲得分數。共3次


三、期末學術科測驗: 20% 
1. 心肺耐力測驗
10分鐘跑步測驗或10分鐘划船測驗，由同學自選擇一來進行考試。

2.肌力測驗
臥推重量/自身體重

本門課程適合具有下列特質者:
1. 喜歡運動流汗、不畏懼運動疲勞。
2. 每次上課時，願展現運動活力。
3. 願配合任課老師課堂教學。
有意願加選本課程者，請針對本身人格特質，對上述四項之要求進行自身描述，並寄信給老師 (寄信不代表一定能加選成功)

本課程對應 SDGs 項目
為學生提供多樣化的運動課程以促進身體健康。這可與SDG 3（良好健康和福祉）相關。
有活力的校園活動和運動可幫助學生保持身體健康，同時也可以增強社區參與感，與SDG 11（可持續城市和社區）相關。

貳.課程說明
一、教學目的
（一）藉由籃球競賽做為培養個人競爭、合作的社會化過成程。
（二）培養籃球課程高階技術能力、享受競賽所給予的樂趣。

二、主要內容
（一）基本動作、綜合技術、規則常識。 
（二）小組攻防配合、團隊戰術（區域防守）、競賽理論與操作。 
（三）裁判實務。 
（四）職籃規則、歷史、介紹

syllabi.assessment:
參.評量方式
一.給分標準
(一)技能學習（包括運動技術）：佔總分百分之四十（40﹪）。
(二)情意學習（包括學習態度、體育服裝的穿著、上課出席率及參與活動）：佔總分百分之四十（40﹪）
(三)認知學習（包括運動理論與常識）：期末運動理論與常識測驗佔總分百分之二十（20﹪）
包含:
(1)體育服裝的穿著、上課出席率及參與活動
(2)缺課
(3)遲到早退
(4)無故不參與學習活動視同缺課
(5)代替簽名
(6)基本運動常識認知

3.其他加分
(1)擔任體育股長並主動借用器材及整理場地等服務工作（加學期成績5分至10分）
(2)非擔任體育股長並主動借用器材及整理場地等服務工作（加學期成績3分至8分）
(3)參加校內獲校外各項運動競賽（需提出證明）（加學期成績3分至5分）
(4)參加校內獲校外各項運動競賽並獲得優成績（需提出證明）（加學期成績5分至8分）
(5)主動協助同學學習並互相合作（加學期成績5分至10分）

4.其他扣分
(1)製造或遺留垃圾（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(2)蓄意遺失或損毀器材或場地（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(3)違反體育室規定於館內飲食或吸菸（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(4)刻意欺瞞老師或同學（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(5)出言不遜或肢體暴力（一次扣學期成績30分至50分）

1、提昇排球運動風氣，增進學生排球技能
2、培養團體合作精神及良好的社會行為規範 
3、養成欣賞他人表現的精神
課程概述：
1、排球基本技術介紹練習 
2、比賽規則講解與操作
3、分組比賽
4、學習成果分享與講評

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.
