description.zh: 電腦稽核已廣泛的應用在金融交易，企業財務與進銷存流程與資訊系統的各項領域來協助找出瑕疵，降低與防範風險，並能做趨勢預測。本課程的目的將機器學習與人工智慧的技術應用在電腦稽核領域，主題包含: 電腦稽核的流程，大量資料的整理與萃取，監督式與非監督式學習在稽核的應用，資料視覺化技術等。
description.en: Computer auditing has been widely used in financial transactions, enterprise business processes, and information systems, which is to help find flaws and reduce risks, and be able to predict trends. The purpose of this course is to apply machine learning technology in the field of computer auditing. Topics include Computer auditing related processes, the extraction and manipulation of large-scaled data, supervised and unsupervised learning in auditing applications, data visualization technology.

Topics include Computer auditing related processes, the extraction and manipulation of large-scaled data, supervised and unsupervised learning in auditing applications, data visualization technology.

name.en: Generative Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia Applications

description.zh: "生成式人工智慧與多媒體應用"這門課程主要探討如何將生成式AI技術應用於商業創作和多媒體製作流程。我們將介紹生成式深度學習模型，例如生成對抗網絡（GANs），探討人工智慧生成內容（AIGC）的議題，並著重於它們如何提升創作流程與工具操作的效率。我們將教授學生使用生成式人工智慧模型和多媒體相關平台，並將這些技術應用於內容產出，如圖像生成、影片內容和音樂創作等。此外，我們也將探討如何將這些新技術與傳統多媒體製作流程結合，以及如何操作相關軟體，並將討論相關的企業道德、社會和法律議題。這門課程適合對人工智慧、多媒體應用，以及如何將這些技術應用於商業環境有興趣的學生。
description.en: The "Generative AI and Multimedia Applications" course explores applying generative AI in business and multimedia production. It introduces generative deep learning models like GANs, discussing AI Generated Content (AIGC) and its role in enhancing creative processes. Students learn to use generative AI models and multimedia platforms for content production like image generation, video content, and music. It also covers the integration of these technologies with traditional multimedia production, software operation, and explores business ethics, social and legal issues. It's ideal for students interested in AI, multimedia applications, and their business applications.

syllabi.outline:
This course mainly explores how to apply generative AI technology to commercial creation and multimedia production processes. The course introduces commonly used generative deep learning models, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), discusses the topics of AI Generated Content (AIGC), and focuses on how they can enhance the efficiency of the creative process and tool operation.

The purposes of this course are fourfold:

1. Understand the relevant business processes of multimedia development.
2. Use generative AI models and multimedia-related platforms, and apply these technologies to content output, such as image generation, video content, and music creation etc.
3. Discuss how to combine these new technologies with traditional multimedia production processes, and how to operate related multimedia software.
4. Discuss relevant intellectual property rights, ethics and other social issues.

This course is suitable for students who are interested in artificial intelligence, multimedia applications, and how to apply these technologies in a business environment.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

syllabi.outline:
區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

description.zh:
「民事訴訟法」第一個部分，此部分旨在向修課同學作民事訴訟法之概括介紹，而此一介紹包含下列三個重點： 一、民事訴訟法之立法背景 二、民事訴訟法之理論 三、民事訴訟法之解釋方法 參與此部分乃理解民事訴訟法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
第二個部分，此部分會聚焦在民事訴訟法之細節上，尤其是下列三個重點：
一、對於民事訴訟法之進一步闡述
二、民事訴訟法於案例事實之適用
三、民法與民事訴訟法之結合
於此部分課程結束時，修課同學應有能力依據民事訴訟法來處理常見之民事法律問題。
description.en:
“Civil Procedure Law” the first part of this course, is aiming to give participants a general introduction to the Civil Procedure Law, and the introduction contains the following three points: 1. The legislative background of the Civil Procedure Law. 2. The theories of the Civil Procedure Law. 3. The interpretive methods of the Civil Procedure Law. Attending the part is the critical step to understanding the Civil Procedure Law and benefits participants a lot.
The second part of this course, is focusing on the details of the Civil Proce-dure Law, especially the following three points: 
1. Further elucidation of the Civil Procedure Law.
2. Application of the Civil Procedure Law to the facts.
3. Combination of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
At the end of the part, participants are supposed to be able to deal with common civil legal problems according to the Civil Procedure Law.

syllabi.outline:
不論是一般之契約或車禍事件，或者是跨國之高科技侵權案件，我們生活中之大小事均與民事訴訟程序息息相關，無論是否從事法律業，皆有學習民事訴訟法之必要，以維護自己的權益。本課程即旨在以淺顯易懂之方式，介紹民事訴訟法之基礎理論及規範，並輔以案例來加以說明，俾使修課同學能對於民事訴訟建立基本之了解，並進而能作初步之實務應用。
本課程除了民事訴訟法的規定本身外，也會教授相關的民法規定，故即使無民法基礎的同學亦歡迎修課。

description.zh: 本課程主要關注台灣發明、新型與設計專利申請的程序觀點。由於涵蓋範圍較廣，故分為專利申請實務(1)與專利申請實務(2)兩門課講授，本課程為先行之專利申請實務(1)。其相關的主題包括發明人身份、專利權人（專利申請權人）身份、優先權、申請格式、發明人訪談、專利標的、專利要件、專利分類與檢索、專利說明書及請求項之閱讀與撰寫等。此外，國際專利申請的實務觀點也會在課堂上討論以做為比較。本課程教材包括專利申請教科書、各國專利申請實務與審查基準、和法院判決等。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspect of invention patent, utility model and design patent prosecution in Taiwan. As a wide range of different topics are designed to be covered, two courses named “Practice in Patent application (1)” and “Practice in Patent application (2)” are being offered and this is the first course (1). The topics cover inventorship, ownership (including a right to file a patent application), priority, formality, inventor interview, patentable subject matter, patentability, patent classification and search, patent specification and claim reading and writing, etc. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented for comparison. The class materials include a patent prosecution textbook, patent prosecution and examination guidelines from different counties, and court decisions.

name.en: Seminar on Intellectual Property Right Cases

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過案例研析介紹智慧財產權之理論與實務問題。課程進行的方式是邀請學界或實務界專家學者，以演講的方式講解相關智慧財產權案例所涉法律問題，並安排參訪智慧財產權實務單位（如專利事務所、智慧財產局、智慧財產法院等），讓同學們得以一窺智慧財產權實務工作的全貌，以達實務與理論相輔相成的功效。
description.en: The course offers introduction to the practice and theory knowledge of Intellectual Property by case study . The course is conducted through lectures of practical subject . It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the practice of Intellectual Property is performed in our country .

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在透過案例研析介紹智慧財產權之理論與實務問題，授課內容將以貼近生活和商業活動的「商標法」為主軸，並針對相應主題補充著作權、專利權及營業秘密等智慧財產法律知識，進行個案報告及分析，並於學期中邀請學界或實務界專家學者，以專題講座方式講授實務案例，以達實務與理論相輔相成的功效。

This course aims to introduce the theory and practical issues of intellectual property rights through case studies. The course will primarily focus on "Trademark Law," which is closely related to everyday life and business activities. Additionally, it will supplement the knowledge of intellectual property laws, such as copyright, patent rights, and trade secrets, on relevant topics. Throughout the semester, several experts and scholars from academia or the industry will be invited to give special lectures on practical cases, aiming to achieve a complementary effect between theory and practice.

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧與多媒體應用
name.en: Generative Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia Applications

description.zh: "生成式人工智慧與多媒體應用"這門課程主要探討如何將生成式AI技術應用於商業創作和多媒體製作流程。我們將介紹生成式深度學習模型，例如生成對抗網絡（GANs），探討人工智慧生成內容（AIGC）的議題，並著重於它們如何提升創作流程與工具操作的效率。我們將教授學生使用生成式人工智慧模型和多媒體相關平台，並將這些技術應用於內容產出，如圖像生成、影片內容和音樂創作等。此外，我們也將探討如何將這些新技術與傳統多媒體製作流程結合，以及如何操作相關軟體，並將討論相關的企業道德、社會和法律議題。這門課程適合對人工智慧、多媒體應用，以及如何將這些技術應用於商業環境有興趣的學生。
description.en: The "Generative AI and Multimedia Applications" course explores applying generative AI in business and multimedia production. It introduces generative deep learning models like GANs, discussing AI Generated Content (AIGC) and its role in enhancing creative processes. Students learn to use generative AI models and multimedia platforms for content production like image generation, video content, and music. It also covers the integration of these technologies with traditional multimedia production, software operation, and explores business ethics, social and legal issues. It's ideal for students interested in AI, multimedia applications, and their business applications.

syllabi.outline:
This course mainly explores how to apply generative AI technology to commercial creation and multimedia production processes. The course introduces commonly used generative deep learning models, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), discusses the topics of AI Generated Content (AIGC), and focuses on how they can enhance the efficiency of the creative process and tool operation.

The purposes of this course are fourfold:

1. Understand the relevant business processes of multimedia development.
2. Use generative AI models and multimedia-related platforms, and apply these technologies to content output, such as image generation, video content, and music creation etc.
3. Discuss how to combine these new technologies with traditional multimedia production processes, and how to operate related multimedia software.
4. Discuss relevant intellectual property rights, ethics and other social issues.

This course is suitable for students who are interested in artificial intelligence, multimedia applications, and how to apply these technologies in a business environment.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，課程將介紹零信任安全的概念，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，並深入探討其相關技術及應用案例。課程還將探討人工智慧在安全的應用，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在隱私保護方面，介紹有關個人資料與隱私保護的法律、標準與指引，以及如何在人工智慧應用中保護個人資料和隱私。課程也將深入探討人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。
description.en: This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. It will delve into topics such as zero trust security, AI security, personal data and privacy protection, AI in the detection of information security incidents, AI in fraud detection, AI-assisted computer auditing, AI-assisted digital forensics, and API security. Initially, the course will introduce the concept of zero trust security, discussing how to use this method to ensure data security, and will explore its related technologies and application cases in depth. The course will also examine the application of AI in security, and how to use AI technologies for network security defense. In terms of privacy protection, it will cover laws, standards, and guidelines related to personal data and privacy protection, as well as how to protect personal data and privacy in AI applications.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，在零信任安全的概念上，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，接著探討人工智慧安全的基礎知識，包括機器學習、深度學習等技術，並介紹如何將這些技術應用於資安領域。此外，在人工智慧在安全的應用上，將導入人工智慧在入侵偵測、漏洞掃描、安全威脅評估等方面的應用案例，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，將介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。最後，課程還將介紹API安全，包括API安全的風險與漏洞、API保護措施等方面的內容，並介紹如何使用人工智慧技術保護API的安全性。
This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. First, the course will introduce the concept of zero-trust security and discuss how this method can be used to safeguard data security. In addition, the course will also explore the application of AI in security, including case studies in intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, security threat assessment, and how AI can be used for network security defense and protect personal data and privacy. In addition, the use of AI technology for detecting cybersecurity incidents, including detecting network attacks using techniques such as anomaly detection and intrusion detection. It will also explore fraud detection using AI, such as credit card fraud or malicious top-up fraud. Lastly, the course will introduce API security, including risks and vulnerabilities, API protection measures, and how to use AI technology to protect API security.

name.zh: 創業講座—創業是一場馬拉松
name.en: Entrepreneurship Lectures- The persistance that makes the great entrepreneur

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. description.zh: 本校為強化學生的就業能力，加強學生的職場競爭力，開設「職涯講座課程」，藉由業界主管與人員介紹不同種類的工作模式，如派遣、公職、舒活族、獵人頭公司、國外企業等，提升學生對於國內外職場的認識，並進一步提升學生的就業率與競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance student’s competitive ability in the workplace. The course contents include tips of interview, self-marketing in the workplace and the planning of the career life etc. By the topics, students will be equipped with a variety of presentation skills that needed in the workplace to raise the employment rate.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 數理邏輯是理論計算機科學各領域重要的基礎。在本課程中，重點關注於數理邏輯在軟體程式驗證與機器可檢驗之證明等的應用。透過各種如SAT/SMT求解器與輔助證明工具Coq等，本課程將涵蓋以下主題：比例邏輯、一階邏輯、可滿足性模組理論、模型檢查與程式驗證。
description.en: Mathematical logic is an important foundation of various fields in theoretical computer science. This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.

description.zh: 科技的進步不僅利於人類文明的創新，也考驗當代法律制度是否能確保法正義的理念與法秩序的維持。本課程主要是探討我國與先進國家智慧財產權、公平交易法、消費者保護法、電子商務、網路犯罪與生物科技法律等問題。
description.en: The advance of technology facilitates an innovation of human civilization; in addition, it also proves to be a test of the modern legal system-seeing whether a balance between legal justice and legal order can be maintained. Some important topics available for class discussion are: intellectual property, fair trade law, consumer protection, e-commerce, internet crimes and biological technology.

syllabi.outline: 近年由於j科技發展，衍生許多議題，例如網路資訊、基因科技、能源科技等，莫不對現行法律制度提出挑戰。主要原因在法律無法預先為未來科技所生問題先為提出規範標準，造成法律只得事後防補。因此，本課程擬分別探討科技發展對現行社會產生的影響，期望學生能對科技發展所生問題有所認識，能依既有法律找出適用可能，並展望未來法律的訂訂方向。將於每週指定討論主題與閱讀內容，修課同學需於上課前閱讀，並於課堂中參與討論。

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程經由研究、分享、討論，瞭解科技創新轉型發展之趨勢，進行科技創新之思維與實例教學，使學生能瞭解創新之模式及相關理論，以啟發學生之創意，促進學術與產業之互動與交流。內容包含科技未來趨勢和創新挑戰，企業核心技術、來源和取得，科技管理與風險，國家科技政策之影響，企業發展生存之道，全球創新產品之開發與技術策略與戰略。
Through research, sharing, and discussion, this course aims to understand the trend of technological innovation, its transformation and development, to tell technological innovation, thought and examples, to enable students to understand the mode of innovation and related theories. The course will inspire students' creativity, and will promote the interaction between academia and industry. The course content includes the future trend of science, technology and innovation challenges, enterprise core technology with its source and acquisition. It also includes the science and technology management and risk which impact the national science and technology policy for enterprise development and survival, and the development of global innovative products and technology strategies and tactics.

3.	創新轉型案例分析(四.五週)

3.6	科技業與金融業合作發展之案例與分析。
3.7	科技創新轉型示範的挑戰與風險。

name.en: Development of global perspective: Korean I

description.zh: 本課程將教導學生韓文字母結構、發音方法及基礎詞彙、文法與句型、韓國現況及文化等，透過文化與語言的習得，培養學生與韓籍人士溝通或在韓國生活所需要的最基本的溝通能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce beginners to basic spoken and written skills in Korean. Students will develop basic skills with a focus on effective communication and enjoyment through listening, speaking, reading and writing. By the end of the course, students will be able to hold a simple conversation in Korean, comprehend basic Korean texts and write about their everyday lives.

description.zh: 課程藉由傳授馬來西亞語言以協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖，旨在培養學生的馬來西亞語基本溝通能力，運用馬來語與當地母語者打招呼、了解馬來文化、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物等，以此來協助學生前往馬來西亞就業，作為兩國的經濟橋樑。
description.en: In order to embrace economic development of globalization, especially in Asian and Southeast Asian countries, there is a need to introduce and equip our students not only with the basic local language but also to understand the local culture so as to strengthen the economic tie between Taiwan and the Asian countries and to enhance the employment opportunities of our students in these Asian countries. This course aims to help students to understand and develop basic communication skills by utilizing Bahasa Malaysia (Malaysian language) to communicate with Malaysian in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, etc. Historical and geographical backgrounds of Malaysia and their local cultures will also be introduced.

syllabi.outline:
為了迎接全球化的亞洲國家與東南亞國家之間的經濟發展,藉由傳授印尼語言,讓學生掌握印尼語同時也了解印尼文化作為兩國的經濟橋樑，以此來協助學生前往印尼就業。本課程是培養學生的溝通能力，以運用印尼語來跟印尼母語者打招呼、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物…等。
In order to embrace economic development of globalization, especially in Asian and Southeast Asian countries, there is a need to teach Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) and equip students not only with the language but also to understand the culture as an economic bridge between the two countries. And, it is hoped that assisting students in employment in Indonesia. This course will aim to help students to develop communication skills by utilizing Indonesian language to speak to native speakers in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, and descriptive usage…etc.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:泰國文化與語言(一)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Thai culture and language I

description.zh: 1. 在臺灣與東南亞交流日益增加的情況下，東南亞語言的學習需求也會隨之提高。而「泰國」所擁有的社會經濟條件優勢，以及泰國政府有意推動的文化創意產業，相信也將為臺灣帶來一陣「泰語學習風潮」。 2. 課程以培養基礎泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通基本實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。 3. 泰語教學方面，秉持聽、說、讀、寫同時並進的教學理念，由字母的發音、寫法、唸法、聲調、順序及拼字系統的學習開始，奠定良好的泰語基礎，搭配最常用的單字、句型、文法與日常實用會話，使學生可以拼寫、閱讀泰文短文，並能以泰語進行日常對話。 4. 泰國文化方面，以專題的方式，講述政治、經濟、社會、地理、歷史與文化等各個層面的泰國，呈現出不同於一般刻板印象中的泰國，培養學生對泰國的正確認識及態度。本學期先針對泰國目前的經濟與文化面進行概說；下學期則探討泰國歷史、地理、政治與社會。
description.en: 1. With the interaction between Taiwan and Southeast Asia getting more and more frequent, the need for learning Southeast Asian languages has been highly increasing. Thailand owns the advantages of social economy; moreover, Thailand government intends to promote cultural creativity industries. Hence, learning Thai definitely becomes a new trend in Taiwan. 2. This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking basic Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc. 3. In terms of learning Thai, listening, speaking, reading and writing, these four skills are equally important. Student will be trained to learn all these four skills together.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:越南文化與語言(二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Vietnam culture and language II

description.zh: 在全球金融海嘯後，已開發國家經濟成長趨緩，新興亞洲國家-東協國家經濟成長迅速，本課程將以越南語教學為主，越南經貿、觀光文化及越語字母拼音教學，讓學生在學習越語的同時，深入了解越南文化，協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖。
description.en: This series of courses aim to provide students with opportunities to understand emerging markets in a global context. Global economy in the post-recession world relies heavily on emerging economies, in particular countries in Southeast Asia known as ASEAN. Seeing the greater potential for economic gains and development, we build up the courses from introducing the fundamentals, including but not limited to, their economy, culture, tourism and people with special emphasis on the use of the language for communication along with its relevance to Taiwan as a trading partner.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:日語與文化(一)

description.zh: 本課程提供學生養成基本日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life.In addition , using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

syllabi.outline:
我國與日本在經濟、學術、文化上之交流早已是不爭的事實。因此，
專業領域之外，如能再習得第二外國語文必定能擁有更大的競爭力。
從入門開始來了解日本的產業、經濟和文化，並探討日本在國際商場
上致勝的關鍵。並且藉由課程學習來加強日語的聽、說、讀、
寫之能力也是本課程追尋的目標。

共有2項作業
作業一:
每課之日語語法、發音發聲、句型應用講解後請學生利用相同句形做1對1或1對2、3之會話練習。

作業二:為加深印象與訓練日文書寫能力，每課內容必須做筆記。

name.zh: 國際觀培養:日語與文化(二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Japanese Ⅱ

description.zh: 本課程為日語與文化(一)之進階課程，提供學生養成進階日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course is designed for students who has basic Japanese knowledge or who passed the language course: Japanese (I) in the previous term. This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life. In addition, using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

name.en: Development of global perspective: Vietnam culture and language I

description.zh: 在全球金融海嘯後，已開發國家經濟成長趨緩，新興亞洲國家-東協國家經濟成長迅速，本課程將以越南語教學為主，越南經貿、觀光文化及越語字母拼音教學，讓學生在學習越語的同時，深入了解越南文化，協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖。
description.en: This series of courses aim to provide students with opportunities to understand emerging markets in a global context. Global economy in the post-recession world relies heavily on emerging economies, in particular countries in Southeast Asia known as ASEAN. Seeing the greater potential for economic gains and development, we build up the courses from introducing the fundamentals, including but not limited to, their economy, culture, tourism and people with special emphasis on the use of the language for communication along with its relevance to Taiwan as a trading partner.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:泰國文化與語言(二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Thai culture and language II

description.zh: 課程以培養泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。
description.en: This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc.

syllabi.outline:

This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc.

description.en: This course aims to introduce beginners to basic spoken and written skills in Korean. Students will develop basic skills with a focus on effective communication and enjoyment through listening, speaking, reading and writing. By the end of the course, students will be able to hold a simple conversation in Korean, comprehend basic Korean texts and write about their everyday lives.

name.zh: 鐵道車輛系統與維修基地
name.en: Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統….等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與AR技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

name.zh: 應用人工智慧於教育專題製作
name.en: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Educational Data Analysis Projects

description.zh: 本課程主要透過人工智慧相關技術主題的介紹與業界實例之分享，包括: 知識表達、機器學習、深度學習等，並實際運用機器學習工具如: TensorFlow、Keras、PyTorch等，並整合校務研究資料於專題課程，參與校務分析研究：考量資安的個資議題，擬將校內部份去識別化後之資料，經過編碼變造處理後於課堂使用，以教育相關大數據進行專題實作與分析。透過分組討論以及專題實作競賽，讓學生實際應用人工智慧工具與方法於教育資料分析。
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the technical topics and share industrial examples related to artificial intelligence, including: knowledge representation, machine learning, and deep learning. The students are required to utilize machine learning tools such as: TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch, to participate in the institutional repository research and analysis of related data in term projects. In consideration of privacy issues of personal information, the data will go through de-identification process for the usage purpose of educational big data analytics in term projects. With group discussions and project competition, students will be able to apply artificial intelligence tools and methods in educational data anlaysis.

name.zh: 校務研究：教育場域數據分析實作
name.en: Institutional research: the application of data science in education

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院(MIT)的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組專案，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平臺，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, practical applications, and case studies to provide students with an in-depth understanding of AI and robotics technology. Students will have the opportunity to engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and robot platforms.

description.zh: 本課程介紹科學和工程數值分析的理論，應用，和程式編撰，包括初步誤差分析、方程式求解、逼近法、微分方程、線性代數、線性和非線性回歸，與離散傅利葉變換。本課程著重於使用目前廣泛採用的數值分析開發環境與程式語言，並透過動手練習讓學生體驗數值分析技術在人工智能中的應用。 本課程學生應至少已完成微積分第一年的學生而設計。
description.en: This course introduces the theory, applications, and programming implementation of numerical analysis for science and engineering, including preliminary error analysis, solutions of equations, approximation, differential equations, linear algebra, linear and nonlinear regression, and discrete Fourier transform. Programming implementation is also intensed in the lectures using a current popular development environment for numerical analysis. The application of numerical analysis techniques on artificial intelligence is also introduced with hands-on exercises. This course is designed for engineering majors who have completed at least the first year of the calculus sequence.

syllabi.outline: 數值分析是人工智慧與機器學習的重要數理基礎。有了數值分析的知識，學習人工智慧與機器學習的過程將更為順利。本課程以電腦遊戲的方式，讓學員透過有趣的遊戲程式撰寫，體會數值分析的原理與重要性。本課程的目標以程式語言撰寫實用的電腦遊戲，學習數值分析的基本概念和方法。

description.zh:
本課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，運用問題分析能力進行實作與相關應用，以企業出題學生解題PBL模式導入人工智慧跨域專題實作，目的在幫助學生瞭解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。
本課程透過導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例，並以通用人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域。透過本課程的修習，學生將獲得實際的跨學科專題實作能力，掌握人工智慧技術的應用和發展趨勢，養成專業職能和研發實力，並培育具有創業與創新精神人才，了解產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en:
This course integrates resources from Microsoft Azure's Open AI cloud services, utilizing problem analysis skills for practical implementation and related applications. It introduces an industry-proposed, student-solved Project-Based Learning (PBL) model into the interdisciplinary project implementation of artificial intelligence. The aim is to help students understand how to apply AI technology to solve real-world problems.
Through the introduction of artificial intelligence applications in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, and smart manufacturing, the course enables students to gain practical interdisciplinary project implementation skills. This course also helps students understand the difficulties and challenges faced by industries in digital transformation.

name.zh: 校務研究：教育場域數據分析實作
name.en: Institutional research: the application of data science in education

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

syllabi.outline:
校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

name.zh: 應用人工智慧於教育專題製作
name.en: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Educational Data Analysis Projects

description.zh: 本課程主要透過人工智慧相關技術主題的介紹與業界實例之分享，包括: 知識表達、機器學習、深度學習等，並實際運用機器學習工具如: TensorFlow、Keras、PyTorch等，並整合校務研究資料於專題課程，參與校務分析研究：考量資安的個資議題，擬將校內部份去識別化後之資料，經過編碼變造處理後於課堂使用，以教育相關大數據進行專題實作與分析。透過分組討論以及專題實作競賽，讓學生實際應用人工智慧工具與方法於教育資料分析。
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the technical topics and share industrial examples related to artificial intelligence, including: knowledge representation, machine learning, and deep learning. The students are required to utilize machine learning tools such as: TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch, to participate in the institutional repository research and analysis of related data in term projects. In consideration of privacy issues of personal information, the data will go through de-identification process for the usage purpose of educational big data analytics in term projects. With group discussions and project competition, students will be able to apply artificial intelligence tools and methods in educational data anlaysis.

name.zh: 進階科技政策與國家競爭力
name.en: Advanced Science and Technology Policy and National Competitiveness

description.zh: 本課程探討當今新科技產業發展趨勢與國家政策推動，進階觀察科技政策與國家競爭力的影響，並以全球化的產業觀點、現今前瞻新科技的運用發展及各國案例討論方式，幫助同學了解地緣政治、科技創新及科技與人文間之發展與國家推動策略，進而培養國際觀及全球化、區域化視野。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容。
description.en: This course explores the development trends of today's new technology industries and the promotion of national policies, and further observes the impact of technology policies and national competitiveness. It also uses a global industrial perspective, the application and development of current forward-looking new technologies, and case discussions from various countries to help students understand Geopolitics, technological innovation, the development between science and technology and humanities, and national promotion strategies, thereby cultivating international perspectives and global and regional perspectives. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with drills and case studies as the main teaching content.

description.en: This course aims to develop and reinforce students' strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive,  argumentative, reflective, and expository.  Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class.  Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

This course aims to develop and reinforce students' strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive,  argumentative, reflective, and expository.  Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class.  Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

description.zh: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

syllabi.outline:
通過“職場英文溝通”這門課，強化英文單字能力，熟記字彙片語。除了拼寫及發音外，協助學生用單字片語造句。熟悉會話容後，學生做角色扮演活動或課堂討論，增加師生互動機會。教師在課堂上指導學生分組搜集傳統產業現況，將實際職場情況融入於課堂學習。

嘗試從商業溝通角度，探討個人如何從溝通角度建造職場人完整的競爭籌碼，以溝通力創造個人職場價值與優勢，協助個人在職場不同角色扮演中，培養受人信任，溝通無礙的職場性格，建立屬於自己的職場口碑與競爭力。溝通是所有人與人之間互動與建立關係的基礎。商業溝通是職場成功的黃金武器；優質的溝通能力是職場人邁向成功舞臺的關鍵能力。

Through the course of "Communication in English in the Workplace", strengthen the ability of English words and memorize vocabulary and phrases. In addition to spelling and pronunciation, help students make sentences with single-word phrases. After being familiar with the content of the conversation, students can do role-playing activities or classroom discussions to increase opportunities for teacher-student interaction. Teachers guide students in groups to collect the current situation of traditional industries and integrate actual workplace situations into classroom learning.
From the perspective of business communication, try to explore how individuals can build a complete competitive bargaining chip in the workplace from the perspective of communication, create personal value and advantages in the workplace with communication skills, and assist individuals in different role-playing in the workplace to develop a workplace character that is trustworthy and has no barriers to communication. Establish your own workplace reputation and competitiveness. Communication is the foundation of all human interactions and relationships. Business communication is the golden weapon for success in the workplace; high-quality communication skills are the key to success in the workplace.

description.zh: 本程主要教授學生熟悉：(1)結構之穩定與靜定性、(2)靜定結構之分析、(3)梁之剪力、彎矩圖、(4)影響線與移動力、(5)結構之彈性變形、(6)靜不定結構分析─諧合變位法、(7)靜不定結構之影響線。
description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要教授學生：(1)結構分析原理、(2)結構物穩定度判別、(3)靜定結構的分析、(4)虛功法、(5)靜定結構影響線的分析與(6)共軛梁法。

This course provides the students an insight into structural analysis. Some essential classical analysis methods are described. The purpose of this course is to make the students a better understanding of analytical principles of structures. The practical applications to structural engineering are also discussed.
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程介紹 (Introduction) 
第二週：結構分析原理 (Background of Structural Analysis)
第三週：結構物穩定度判別(一) (Justification of Stability Degree of Structure I)
第四週：結構物穩定度判別(二) (Justification of Stability Degree of Structure II)
第五週：靜定結構反力的分析 (Analysis of Reactions of Statically Determinate Structure)
第六週：靜定梁剪力與彎矩的分析 (Analysis of Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Beam)
第七週：靜定剛架軸力、剪力與彎矩的分析 (Analysis of Axial Force, Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Rigid Frame)
第八週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(一) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss I)
第九週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(二) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss II)
第十週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(三) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss III)
第十一週：期中考試 (Midterm)
第十二週：虛功法 (Virtual Work Theory)
第十三週：靜定梁與剛架影響線的分析 (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Beam & Rigid Frame)
第十四週：靜定桁架影響線的分析(一) (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss I)
第十五週：靜定桁架影響線的分析(二) (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss II)
第十六週：共軛梁法(一) (Conjugate Beam Method I)
第十七週：共軛梁法(二) (Conjugate Beam Method II)
第十八週：期末考試 (Final)

name.en: English Communication and Application II (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skills by giving explanations of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

name.zh: 地面站網路切片與服務品質保證
name.en: Network Slicing and Quality of Service Technology for Ground Stations

description.zh: 本課程探討地面站網路切片技術及其在實際應用中的服務品質保證方法。課程將涵蓋地面站網路的基本概念，包括結構、架構，以及與通訊系統相關的各種技術。學生將透過深入理論學習和實務案例，瞭解地面站網路切片的原理及其在提供不同服務的情境中的優勢。在課程中，學生將學習如何實施地面站網路切片，包括網路資源分配、優先權設定，以及切片之間的隔離。透過實作專案，學生將有機會實際設計、配置和管理地面站網路切片，以應對不同應用場景下的需求。此外，課程將探討服務品質保證技術，包括流量管理、延遲優化、及網路監控等方面。學生將學習如何測量、分析和改進地面站網路切片的服務品質，以確保滿足各種應用的需求。最後，課程也將討論地面站網路切片的未來趨勢，包括與新興技術的整合、標準化發展，以及面臨的挑戰。透過該課程，學生將具備地面站網路切片及服務品質保證的專業知識和實作技能。
description.en: This course explores practical applications and methods of network slicing for ground stations, emphasizing service quality assurance. It covers fundamental concepts, implementation techniques, and hands-on projects related to ground station network slicing. Students learn to design, configure, and manage slices, ensuring effective communication for various applications. The course also addresses Quality of Service (QoS) technologies and discusses future trends in ground station network slicing.

description.zh: 本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹NTN的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究NTN網路的架構和應用，使學生了解NTN在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討3GPP對NTN網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解NTN在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著5G的發展，課程也將討論NTN在B5G/6G系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解NTN如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論NTN的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對NTN技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹衛星通訊原理、無人機系統架構，與如何整合衛星和無人機來開發新的應用。課程內容包括衛星通訊、無人機原理與基本操作、開源機載控制軟體(ArduPilot)、通訊協定(MAVLink)、地面控制站(Mission Planner)、飛行模擬與影像傳輸等。基礎之外將介紹進階應用，例如結合4G/5G網路遠端控制多台無人機、嵌入式AI影像辨識等。
description.en: This course will introduce satellite communication, Unmanned Aircraft Systems, and how to integrate satellites and drones to create new applications. Students will learn satellite communication theory, UAV basic operations, open-source embedded control software (ArduPilot), communication protocol (MAVLink), ground control station (Mission Planner), VR simulation and video transmission, etc. Additionally, we will introduce advanced topics and new applications, such as combining 4G/5G networks to control multiple drones, embedded AI models for drone image recognition, etc.

name.zh: 網路行銷研究與資料分析

description.zh: 網際網路與相關應用程式從根本上改變了消費者日常生活的各個方面。行銷從業人員也已經將他們的工作轉移到了網路上。本課程的目的在於幫助學生認識網路資料分析在數位行銷領域中的作用，並實際應用網路分析工具和技術來監控網路行銷活動的績效。課程主題包括：Web數據分析與行銷簡介、Web日誌分析、網站表現指標和關鍵績效指標、網站監控和趨勢分析、網路廣告及網路分析的未來趨勢。
description.en: The Internet and web applications have fundamentally changed nearly every aspect of our daily lives. Marketing practitioners have shifted their efforts online. This module aims to help students recognise the role of web analytics within the digital marketing landscape, and practically apply web analytics tools and technologies to monitor performance of web based marketing activities. Topics to be covered include: Introduction to web analytics and web data driven marketing; Web server log analysis; Web metrics and key web performance Indicators; Web monitoring and trends analysis; Dashboard design; Navigation analysis; Online advertising; Future trends of web analytics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要目的培養同學實務的數據分析與洞察力. 因此本課程讓同學實際操作數據平台進行數據的分析與解讀, 以培養如何獲取消費者洞察與行銷意涵的能力. 特別是導入Eastern Integrated Consumer Profile (E-ICP) 與QSearch兩大數據分析平台. 因此課程將需要使用網路與電腦查詢資料. 同時也特別邀請實務經理人以成功商業案例分享從數據分析到行銷方案擬定的流程, 以促使同學學習的理論與實務並重效益.

Practical managers are also specially invited to share the process from data analysis to marketing plan formulation with successful business cases, facilitating the learning effect.

name.zh: 偏極合成孔徑雷達影像處理

description.zh: 偏極雷達影像是合成孔徑雷達影像分析中的一種特殊應用，透過不同偏極電磁波對於地物結構散射的差異，使得傳統單頻率的合成孔徑雷達，能以類似彩色光學影像的假色形象呈現，也能進一步對地物結構特徵進行物種分類。本課程分為基礎與應用兩區塊，基礎區塊從雷達影像與電磁波偏極幾何出發，並加入偏極雷達影像資料統計；後期應用區塊則是介紹主流的偏極雷達資料分解、分類模型以及應用。
description.en: Polarimetric radar image processing is a special application of synthetic aperture radar image analysis. Using the polarimetric scattering information of EMWave, a monochrome radar image can be extended to color image. It also provides another way to find target structure difference and classification. The course will be divided in two parts, basics and applications. The basic part will introduce synthetic aperture radar image, radar polarization descriptors, operators, and speckle statistic for polarimetric signals. The application part will focus on the famous polarimetric radar decomposition, classification methods and others.

description.zh: 本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹NTN的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究NTN網路的架構和應用，使學生了解NTN在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討3GPP對NTN網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解NTN在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著5G的發展，課程也將討論NTN在B5G/6G系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解NTN如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論NTN的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對NTN技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

description.zh: 這門課程將深入探討遙測影像處理的核心概念與技術，旨在培養學生對於遙測數據的理解和應用能力。課程將包括遙測影像的獲取、前處理、分類、變遷偵測等主題。學生將學到如何使用先進的遙測工具和軟體，以處理多光譜、高光譜和合成孔徑雷達等不同類型的遙測數據。
description.en: This course will provide an in-depth exploration of the core concepts and techniques of telemetry image processing, with the aim of developing students' understanding and application of telemetry data. The course will cover the topics of remote sensing image acquisition, pre-processing, classification, and change detection. Students will learn how to use advanced remote sensing tools and software to process different types of remote sensing data such as multispectral, hyperspectral and synthetic aperture radar.

syllabi.outline:
當高解析度的數位微波影像以成趨勢後，下一世代各國之間在遙測影像的競爭上已經不再局限於光學影像中。然而無論是光學或微波影像，都是以傳統的影像處理為基礎，然後再根據彼此間的數位訊號間的差異，而有不一樣的處理方法。在國際上，越來越多實務上的應用不再只局限於傳統的數位光學影像。利用更多輔助的數位影像資料，例如數位微波影像，能獲取更高效能、更高精度的結果。本課程會以數位微波影像發展趨勢與應用介紹起，並說明影像的特性、訊號模型與處理方法，並搭配實務上的操作，達到理論與實務兼具的目的。

When high resolution digital microwave image becomes the trend, the competition of remote sensing image among countries in the next generation is no longer limited to optical image. However, both optical and microwave images are based on the traditional image processing, and then have different processing methods according to the difference between digital signals. Internationally, more and more practical applications are no longer limited to traditional digital optical imaging. The use of more complementary digital image data, such as digital microwave images, can lead to more efficient and accurate results. This course will introduce the trends and applications of digital microwave imaging, explain the characteristics of the image, signal model and processing methods, and provide practical operation to achieve both theoretical and practical purposes.

name.zh: 地面站網路切片與服務品質保證
name.en: Network Slicing and Quality of Service Technology for Ground Stations

description.zh: 本課程探討地面站網路切片技術及其在實際應用中的服務品質保證方法。課程將涵蓋地面站網路的基本概念，包括結構、架構，以及與通訊系統相關的各種技術。學生將透過深入理論學習和實務案例，瞭解地面站網路切片的原理及其在提供不同服務的情境中的優勢。在課程中，學生將學習如何實施地面站網路切片，包括網路資源分配、優先權設定，以及切片之間的隔離。透過實作專案，學生將有機會實際設計、配置和管理地面站網路切片，以應對不同應用場景下的需求。此外，課程將探討服務品質保證技術，包括流量管理、延遲優化、及網路監控等方面。學生將學習如何測量、分析和改進地面站網路切片的服務品質，以確保滿足各種應用的需求。最後，課程也將討論地面站網路切片的未來趨勢，包括與新興技術的整合、標準化發展，以及面臨的挑戰。透過該課程，學生將具備地面站網路切片及服務品質保證的專業知識和實作技能。
description.en: This course explores practical applications and methods of network slicing for ground stations, emphasizing service quality assurance. It covers fundamental concepts, implementation techniques, and hands-on projects related to ground station network slicing. Students learn to design, configure, and manage slices, ensuring effective communication for various applications. The course also addresses Quality of Service (QoS) technologies and discusses future trends in ground station network slicing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討地面站網路切片技術及其在實際應用中的服務品質保證方法。課程將涵蓋地面站網路的基本概念，包括結構、架構，以及與通訊系統相關的各種技術。學生將透過深入理論學習和實務案例，瞭解地面站網路切片的原理及其在提供不同服務的情境中的優勢。在課程中，學生將學習如何實施地面站網路切片，包括網路資源分配、優先權設定，以及切片之間的隔離。透過實作專案，學生將有機會實際設計、配置和管理地面站網路切片，以應對不同應用場景下的需求。此外，課程將探討服務品質保證技術，包括流量管理、延遲優化、及網路監控等方面。學生將學習如何測量、分析和改進地面站網路切片的服務品質，以確保滿足各種應用的需求。最後，課程也將討論地面站網路切片的未來趨勢，包括與新興技術的整合、標準化發展，以及面臨的挑戰。透過該課程，學生將具備地面站網路切片及服務品質保證的專業知識和實作技能。

Students learn to design, configure, and manage slices, ensuring effective communication for various applications. The course also addresses Quality of Service (QoS) technologies and discusses future trends in ground station network slicing.

name.zh: 大數據與人工智能應用系統設計
name.en: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Application System Design

description.zh: 本課程透過原理解說與系統實作，使學生熟悉GCP(Google Cloud Platform)及AWS(Amazon Web Service)提供之雲端開發框架，以設計大數據與人工智能應用系統。課程內容包括：資料擷取、轉換與儲存流程，資料建模、探勘與分析技術，語音、文字、影像等機器學習演算法設計，氣象、交通、互聯網、零售、金融與製造等領域人工智能應用系統開發案例。藉由實務個案教學及期末專題設計，讓學生掌握大數據分析方法，並能運用軟體工程技術，設計人工智能應用系統。
description.en: This course provides students with the knowledge and skills to design big data and artificial intelligence application systems using GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or AWS (Amazon Web Service) cloud platform services.  Course spans a variety of big data processing technologies such as capturing data, data transfer, data storage, data analysis, model assessments, machine learning algorithms, and business application systems for artificial intelligence.  Programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the basic ideas and practical tools in big data analytics and artificial intelligence system design.

syllabi.outline:
當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料處理與分析、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。本課程以分組操作為主，每組需挑選各自關切的都市議題，進行相關分析作業。內容包括：都數據獲取與處理、資訊視覺化、地理運算、都市建模、策略形塑，並包含一次期中報告，與一次期末成果報告。

Contemporary urban issues are often complex, interdisciplinary, and open-ended. In terms of data collection and analysis, they require the integration of geographical, spatial, and temporal dimensions. In analysis and strategy formulation, it is necessary to balance the interests of multiple stakeholders such as the public sector, private sector, and the general public. It is a highly complex yet crucial field of study. This course starts from real urban issues, teaching students to master skills in geographic information, data processing and analysis, information visualization, strategic discourse, and other comprehensive abilities. It aims to cultivate students' observation and analysis of complex urban issues, thereby enabling them to propose insights and creativity for real environments. This course primarily involves group work, where each group selects urban issues of their concern for relevant analysis tasks. The content includes data acquisition and processing, information visualization, geographic computation, urban modeling, and strategic shaping. It also includes one midterm report and one final project report.

第九～十三週：都市數據建模
第十四～十七週：都市策略形塑
第十八週：期末分組報告

description.zh: 本課程內容包括邏輯閘的特性與功能測試，能利用積體電路完成各種基礎邏輯電路的組裝及設計，並能利用電子儀器進行量測、檢修。探討最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CAD軟體工具介紹。基礎邏輯閘實驗、組合邏輯實驗、加法器及減法器實驗、組合邏輯應用實驗、正反器邏輯實驗、循序邏輯電路應用實驗。
description.en: 1.Properties and function tests of logic gates. 2. Implementations of and designs of basic logic circuits using ICs. 3.Algorithms for the optimization of combinational logic circuits. 4.Programmable logic devices. 5.VLSI design of combinational logic circuits. 6.Multi-layer logic circuits using MSI and standard circuit  elements. 7.Gate array design. 8.Sequential Logic components. 9.Analysis and synthesis of sequential Logic circuits. 10. Technologies of VLSI design and test. 11. CAD software tools. 12.Basic logic gate experiments. 13.Combinational logic experiments. 14. Adder and subtractor experiments. 15. Combinational logic application experiments. 16. Flip-flop experiments. 17. Sequential circuit application experiments.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 這門課程將深入探討遙測影像處理的核心概念與技術，旨在培養學生對於遙測數據的理解和應用能力。課程將包括遙測影像的獲取、前處理、分類、變遷偵測等主題。學生將學到如何使用先進的遙測工具和軟體，以處理多光譜、高光譜和合成孔徑雷達等不同類型的遙測數據。
description.en: This course will provide an in-depth exploration of the core concepts and techniques of telemetry image processing, with the aim of developing students' understanding and application of telemetry data. The course will cover the topics of remote sensing image acquisition, pre-processing, classification, and change detection. Students will learn how to use advanced remote sensing tools and software to process different types of remote sensing data such as multispectral, hyperspectral and synthetic aperture radar.

syllabi.outline:
當高解析度的數位微波影像以成趨勢後，下一世代各國之間在遙測影像的競爭上已經不再局限於光學影像中。然而無論是光學或微波影像，都是以傳統的影像處理為基礎，然後再根據彼此間的數位訊號間的差異，而有不一樣的處理方法。在國際上，越來越多實務上的應用不再只局限於傳統的數位光學影像。利用更多輔助的數位影像資料，例如數位微波影像，能獲取更高效能、更高精度的結果。本課程會以數位微波影像發展趨勢與應用介紹起，並說明影像的特性、訊號模型與處理方法，並搭配實務上的操作，達到理論與實務兼具的目的。

When high resolution digital microwave image becomes the trend, the competition of remote sensing image among countries in the next generation is no longer limited to optical image. However, both optical and microwave images are based on the traditional image processing, and then have different processing methods according to the difference between digital signals. Internationally, more and more practical applications are no longer limited to traditional digital optical imaging. The use of more complementary digital image data, such as digital microwave images, can lead to more efficient and accurate results. This course will introduce the trends and applications of digital microwave imaging, explain the characteristics of the image, signal model and processing methods, and provide practical operation to achieve both theoretical and practical purposes.

description.zh: 有鑒於國內的教育制度主張男女擁有平等的權利，但實際結果卻是女學生在理工科系方面成為少數族群，本課程以增進女性參與人機互動為主要目標，結合一連串的研習營教學與展示技術的引入，教導有關互動科技技術等相關應用，並透過了解性別研究的主要流派與其理論，來確認性別研究與互動設計的性質與功能，期待學生能再了解性別研究的主要理論後，能把它應用於互動設計以及創意發想上，以因應未來女性經濟力的快速掘起。

The outdoor education and the indoor education; the two complement each other and expecting this exhibition to encourage more female students to discovery the science and have better achievements in this field.

description.zh: 本課程針對在不同物理和化學機制下顏色產生的原因，如振動和簡單的激發解釋了白熾（如：火焰）、氣體激發（如：霓虹管、極光）和震動與旋轉（如：藍冰和水）的顏色等，以及染料和顏料之化學結構、製造方式和基本化性予以闡述，以便對色料的相關應用有較為明晰的瞭解。
description.en: This course targets at the color derived from a variety of physical and chemical mechanisms are summarized. Includes vibrations and simple excitations to explain the colors of incandescence (e.g., flames), gas excitations (neon tube, aurora), and vibrations and rotations (blue ice and water). And also chemical structure, manufacturing and properties of main dyes and pigments are studied. Further applications of the color stuff are explained.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授並彙交所屬系所保存。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on-site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，向指導教師提出計畫審查。指導教師同意後，學生於加退選週結束前向系辦公室登記申請。
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 

In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities, and submit to their instructors for approval. With instructors’ approval, they need to make registration to the departmental office for application by the end of the add/drop course selection weeks of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

description.zh: 為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。
description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

syllabi.schedule:
第 1 週 RLC諧振的基礎介紹/介紹零電壓/零電流。 
第 2 週 FHA 介紹分析。 
第 3 週~第 4 週 電路分析動作，介紹SRC LLC 的動作區間，請用MATLAB描述
每一個區間的方程式，繪製每一個區間的波形，與電路模擬對照。 
第 5 週~第 6 週 介紹諧振電路各參數代表的意義與對增益造成的影響(Q K R… ) 
/ 繪製電路的增益。 
第 7 週 設計規格下的諧振參數與透過模擬驗證。 
第 8 週~第 9 週 研讀CLLC電路拓樸與區間分析。 ---------------------------------------------------------------------- 
第 10 週~第 11 週 針對本研究題目決定電路架構與各參數值/繪製增益曲線/理
論、模擬驗整。 
第 12 週 學習變壓器與諧振電感設計方式。 
第 13 週 設計變壓器形狀與繞組結構並透過模擬軟體與理論驗證。 
第 14 週~第 15 週 透過模型參數化方式找出合適磁材設計點/優化磁材(繞組、磁
芯結構)。 
第 16 週 將設計磁材與電路作結合驗證電器功能是否符合預期。 
第 17 週 損耗分析與元件選用/透過模擬驗證功能。 
第 18 週 整理理論與模擬數據。

syllabi.schedule:
第1週~第8週:AI基礎知識預習：包括AI概念、Web3.0、眼底攝影技術、AI在預防性維護(PHM)的應用等。
第8~12週:AI應用探討與模型設計：深入探討工業和醫學領域中AI的輔助應用，並嘗試設計或最佳化AI模型。學習AI模型的運行架構。
第12~16週:研究項目執行與完成：根據設定的研究目標，完成之前階段設定的研究項目。
第16~18週:成果整合與報告製作：統整研究成果並製作成果報告。
syllabi.assessment:
A（優秀）：超出預期完成課程要求，展現出色的創意與技術實現能力，項目具有高度的創新性和實用性，積極參與課程互動和同儕評價，提供有價值的反饋。
B（良好）：滿足課程要求，項目展現良好的技術實現和一定程度的創新，能夠有效溝通和展示工作成果，積極參與課程互動。
C（中等）：基本滿足課程要求，項目實現基本功能，但缺乏創新或技術深度，參與課程互動但較少提供反饋。
D（及格）：未完全滿足課程要求，項目完成度低，展示和報告未能清楚傳達工作成果，參與課程互動不積極。
F（不及格）：未達到課程基本要求，項目未提交或質量極差，幾乎沒有參與課程互動。
syllabi.materials:
為了提升本課程的學習效果和針對性，我們將採用自編教材。這些教材經過精心設計，旨在深化學生對AI技術的理解，並與當前工業和醫學領域內最前沿的應用相結合。自編教材將包含豐富的案例研究、實用的技術指導以及最新的行業動態，以幫助學生建立堅實的理論基礎，並能將所學知識應用於實際問題解決中。

此外，自編教材還將提供互動式學習元素，如線上討論、實時反饋和項目導向的任務，以促進學生的主動學習和深度參與。我們相信，通過這種量身定制的學習材料，學生將能夠更有效地掌握AI相關知識，並準備好將這些知識應用於未來的學術或職業生涯中。
syllabi.consultation: 為方便學生直接接觸教師和業界專家，我們提供一種直接且靈活的諮詢管道。學生可透過指定的電子郵件與教師或專業人士直接聯繫，請求諮詢並提出具體問題。此外，學生也可與教師和專業人士約定面對面諮詢的時間，以便進行更深入的討論和指導。請在諮詢請求中包含您的姓名、聯絡資訊、討論主題和希望諮詢的時間。我們鼓勵學生充分利用這個管道，以獲得最大的學習支持和專業指導，促進自主學習的發展。

description.en: This course is the extended course and designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程為「彈性工時學期校外實習」之延續性課程，主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，工時可彈性安排週間但每週不得低於32小時。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is the extended course and designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程為「學期校外實習」之延續性課程，須先修習過學期校外實習，始能修習本課程。本課程主要培養學生的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: This is the extended course to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期至土木工程相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業機構之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
